title: Do you know about 100% ownership in Dubai?
content:
Following the amendments to the UAE Commercial Companies Law (CCL), 100% foreign ownership is now permitted for most business activities in the UAE Mainland, subject to the activity’s regulatory approval. This reform has significantly enhanced Dubai’s attractiveness for global investors.

In this article, you will learn about 100% ownership in Dubai. We are going to discuss DED foreign ownership and other matters related. Let us observe:

What has Changed so far regarding foreign ownership?

The new laws emphasize the regulation of provisions for the formation of commercial companies with limited liability structures. A single person or a group can own a Limited Liability Company (LLC).

Previously, foreign investors were required to partner with a UAE national holding 51% of shares for mainland companies. However, under the amended Commercial Companies Law, this requirement has been removed for most commercial and industrial activities. Only a few activities in the professional services sector and certain free zones permitted foreigners to own 100% of a company.

However, the amendments now exempt foreign investors from the UAE nationals’ minimum percentage ownership requirement. As a result, natural and legal persons can now establish businesses on the UAE Mainland without the need for a local partner.

Who is eligible for full ownership of a business in the UAE?

Dubai

The revised laws in Dubai will apply to 1,061 of the 2,300 total economic activities listed by the Department of Economic Development (DED). As a result, roughly half of all business activities, including trading and manufacturing, qualify for 100 ownership in Dubai.

However, for professional services activities, foreign investors with 100% ownership in the UAE continue to benefit entrepreneurs. However, they require a local service agent and strictly adhere to the sole establishment legal structure rather than an LLC.

Abu Dhabi

Abu Dhabi has also implemented the amended Commercial Companies Law, allowing 100% foreign ownership for most commercial and industrial activities, subject to regulatory approvals. However, certain strategic sectors may still require additional approvals from relevant authorities.

Other emirates

The implementation of the 100% ownership of business varies by Emirate. While Dubai and Abu Dhabi have already implemented the new regulations, all UAE emirates have aligned with the amended Commercial Companies Law framework. However, eligibility for 100% foreign ownership depends on the specific activity and regulatory authority in each emirate. Foreign investors will be able to enjoy complete ownership of their businesses once the relevant jurisdictions implement the regulations.

Connect FZ becomes your business partner at an affordable cost, assisting you with all of the procedures involved in establishing a company with 100 ownership in Dubai.

Why were laws changed to allow for full ownership of a company?

  • Creating a favorable legal environment for the establishment of businesses.
  • Facilitating 100% ownership of businesses in the UAE will improve the country’s economic readiness.
  • Making it easier to do business.
  • Increasing investment and commercial opportunities to help prepare for the future.
  • Increasing the competitiveness of the business environment in response to rapid economic changes and global economic developments.
  • Responding to the UAE business community’s changing needs.
  • Increasing the country’s appeal to ex-pat investors, businesses, and even startups.
  • Allowing foreign investors to exercise complete operational and legal control over their businesses without interference.
  • Attracting business aspirants from around the world looking for a home for their company and enjoying UAE 100% foreign ownership.

4. Mainland Vs Free Zone company

The UAE has approximately 45 economic zones where you can trade goods and services at preferential tax and customs rates. The rest of the area in the UAE, excluding free zones, is the Mainland. From a business standpoint, the UAE is divided into three regions – Mainland Area (onshore), Free Zone, and Offshore – where you can establish a company.

Each jurisdiction has its own set of advantages and disadvantages when it comes to business setup. While the free zone area only allows companies to trade within the free zones, the Mainland area allows companies to conduct business not only within the UAE (including free zones); but also anywhere in the world.

Not only that, but establishing a business in a free zone has several other advantages, such as 100% foreign ownership, 100% repatriation of capital and profits, 100% corporate and personal income tax exemptions, and exemption from all import and export duties.

4.1. Further details

However, import into the UAE is not permitted. A Dubai Mainland company formation, on the other hand, must have office space and obtain government approval to incorporate. Aside from that, a Dubai Mainland company formation may require physical office space and regulatory approvals depending on the activity. Today, most mainland commercial and industrial activities allow 100% foreign ownership without the need for a local sponsor.

Most business people prefer free trade zones in the UAE because they can benefit from 100% foreign company ownership, which is not available with a Mainland company. But not any longer. As you are aware, following the amendment to the CCL by the UAE cabinet to boost the country’s competitive edge and facilitate doing business; you can incorporate a company in Dubai mainland with full ownership.

Benefits of Having a Business Setup in UAE Mainland

The most significant advantage of having a Mainland firm is that their business activities are not limited to any specific area/s, unlike free zone companies; this allows them to freely trade. This means they can trade with any firm, public or private, and no matter where they are located within and outside of the UAE – free zones, onshore and offshore.

The broader the scope, the better the opportunities for global expansion, opening the door to a plethora of opportunities and higher profits. Furthermore, who would not want to work on government projects with less competition? Other advantages of establishing a Mainland company in the UAE include no minimum capital requirement and the possibility of obtaining a residence visa.

Although there are numerous advantages to doing business on the UAE Mainland, just one disadvantage, 49% ownership, appears to be a deal-breaker. Because of the new law, this is no longer applicable. And they have added one more benefit to the list: complete ownership.

6. Significance of full foreign ownership in the UAE

100 ownership in Dubai is certain to increase investment in the UAE and contribute to the nation’s economy. This step by the UAE government will also strengthen the UAE’s position on the global investment map, where industrial activities can be carried out with complete ownership by a foreign and legal non-citizen.

Hence, gaining 100% foreign ownership in the UAE is extremely important. You, as an ex-pat business owner:

  • You do not need to look for an Emirati partner to join your company, which means you can fully own it.
  • It is no longer necessary to negotiate and debate with UAE partners to obtain a 51% stake in the company’s capital.
  • You will have more control over how you manage and plan your work.
  • Have more freedom to expand your business outside of free zone areas throughout the UAE.
  • Furthermore, the previous 49% ownership law cannot prevent you from materializing your dream of opening your own business in Dubai or any other UAE emirate. Bonus? Following the issuance of the long-term investor visa, you will be able to enjoy a long-term stay in your preferred emirate.

7. Updates on the UAE Mainland establishment’s 100% foreign ownership

Before the implementation of the new law, ex-pats were required to find a local sponsor and appoint them to the company that would hold 51% of the total shareholding. The local sponsor would also have additional duties and rights, and in some cases, the parties would enter into a side agreement to ensure that the foreign ex-pat has complete operational control.

However, beginning June 1, 2021, a foreign entity or person may invest and own up to 100% of the total shareholding in a company in the UAE; removing the previous mandatory requirement of a local sponsor.

The Dubai Economic Department, on the other hand, explained that full ownership does not bring any change to current procedures or licensing requirements, except that it is no longer mandatory to have a local sponsor or specify a fixed quota ratio for him/her.

So, according to the legal procedures followed, a reduction in the percentage share of the Emirati partner from 51% of his/her withdrawal from the partnership is possible. With the most recent changes to CCL, the majority of the previous restrictions imposed on foreign entities have been lifted.

7.1. More information

You may be wondering if any hidden surprises are lurking behind this new law. And if not, why would one form a company in a free zone? After all, this was one of the main reasons people chose free zones over the Mainland to trade. Continue reading for more information.

  • Get some advice that 100 foreign ownership in Dubai has been approved for certain business activities (under commercial and industrial licenses), but only for a limited number of companies. And yours is almost certainly one of them.
  • The best part is that there are no additional fees to request that changes be made to existing trade licenses.
  • You do not even have to pay any extra money to make these changes to existing trade licenses.
  • Many professional activities now allow 100% foreign ownership; however, some may still require a Local Service Agent depending on regulatory classification. Ownership and licensing conditions vary by activity.
  • In addition to full ownership in mainland UAE companies, foreign company branches in the UAE no longer need to find a ‘National Service Agent’ (NSA).
  • Commercial activities that are now eligible for 100% foreign ownership in the UAE include, among others, general trading, gold, pearls, jewelry, cars, luxury watches, food, and others.
  • Among the industrial segments that now qualify for 100% foreign ownership in the UAE are construction, building materials, water production, paint, food, flooring, flooring metal, and so on.
  • In light of the new changes, the steps for reducing the Emirati partner’s share capital from 51% of their complete withdrawal from the company’s trade license can be taken.
  • With a limited liability structure and 100% foreign ownership, limited liability companies can be converted to single-person ownership.

8. The UAE allows for full foreign ownership in thirteen industries

The UAE Cabinet adopted a positive list of activities for 100% ownership in the UAE covered by Article 7-3 of the UAE Federal Law No. 19 of 2018 on Foreign Direct Investment. In this sense, the UAE offers 100% foreign ownership in 122 economic activities activities across thirteen sectors:

  • Transportation and storage.
  • Agriculture.
  • Space.
  • Manufacturing.
  • Renewable energy.
  • Hospitality and food services.
  • Information and communication.
  • Professional.
  • Scientific and technical activities.
  • Administrative and support services.
  • Educational activities.
  • Healthcare.
  • Art and entertainment.

9. How can Connect FZ help you get 100 ownership in Dubai Mainland?

Foreign 100% ownership in the UAE is taking a revolutionary step. The UAE’s supportive government has amended the Federal Commercial Companies Law (CCL). Connect FZ will keep you updated on these changes. Furthermore, we evaluate your business model and make recommendations to ensure that your venture is eligible for 100% foreign ownership in Sharjah or Dubai, or any other emirate.

Moreover, because the law is relatively new, integration between various governmental departments will take time. To avoid confusion and learn more about how Connect FZ can assist you in obtaining 100% ownership of a business in the UAE; you can schedule a free consultation with one of our Legal Corporate Advisors. On the other hand, we invite you to look at our value-added services.

 

Do you have any questions for us? You can contact us. Let us know any inquiries you may have regarding the DED 100% foreign ownership list and how we can assist you. We can also talk to you about the foreign ownership restrictions to solve all your doubts. Our contact number is +971 43 316 688. Email us at contact@connectfz.com.

title: 2-Year Investor Visa Dubai: Property Residency Made Easy
content:
Might it be said that you are the one keen on living in Dubai? Know that, you can work and put resources into Dubai with the opportunity and adaptability of a drawn-out visa. All you can accomplish under the Dubai 2-Year Investor Visa. This may be the ideal choice for you. The 2-year investor visa Dubai was presented in 2019. The investor visa takes special care of foreign investors. Particularly the people who are looking to lay out a business presence in Dubai. Likewise, the most ideal choice for investors is to put resources into property.

You can partake in the advantages of residency for a considerable length of time with this visa. This visa type has a choice to recharge. For this, the individual should meet the eligibility criteria

Understanding the Dubai 2-Year Investor Visa

For foreign individuals, the Dubai 2-Year Investor Visa Dubai offers a pathway to residency. This is for those individuals specifically who invest in the dynamic economy of Dubai.

On the other hand, this visa option caters to two main investment routes. This involves:

  • Establishing a company with a minimum capital investment.
  • The second one is purchasing property with a set value threshold.

It provides a residency permit valid for two years. However, you can renew it if you want to meet the requirements.

Eligibility Criteria:

In this section, we have discussed the eligibility criteria for a 2-year investor visa Dubai. In other words, applying for a UAE investor visa requires investment options to be fulfilled.

Investment Options:

For 2-year investor visa Dubai, the eligibility criteria hinge on the investment type you choose. The investment type includes property investment and business investment.

Property Investment:

In this route, you have a option to purchase freehold property in Dubai. The investment amount should be a minimum value of AED 750,000. This equals to approx. USD 204,000. However, you have to meet the additional conditions such as:

  • The property must be fully owned by you. Or jointly owned with a spouse with equal shares
  • In the case of a property mortgage, you’ll need an NOC from the bank or developer. It specifies the paid amount and remaining balance.

Business Investment:

In terms of business venture, establishing a company in the UAE is easy. It can be done with a minimum capital investment of AED 1,000,000. This equals to the amount approx. USD 272,000. However, it is important to note that the capital amount should be reflected in the MOA. But, it doesn’t require immediate full payment.

How to Apply for a 2-Year Investor Visa?

Here’s the procedure to apply for a 2-year investor visa Dubai.

Initial Approval:

In this step, submit an application with the required documents to the relevant authorities. After a short, you’ll receive initial approval to proceed with the next steps.

Medical Fitness Test:

You will need to undergo a medical fitness test, once you receive initial approval. It ensures you meet the health requirements for residency in Dubai.

Emirates ID Processing:

On passing the medical test, you will proceed with Emirates ID processing. It involves capturing biometric data such as fingerprints, and iris scans. Also, a photo of your official Emirates ID card. It serves as your residency permit.

Who is eligible for a 2 Years Investor Visa?

Investor Profile:

The 2-Year Investor Visa Dubai targets foreign individuals. The ones who are serious about investing in the economy of Dubai, include entrepreneurs, business owners, or individuals. They must have a strong financial background seeking property investment opportunities.

Investment Capacity:

Now, demonstrate sufficient financial resources to meet the minimum investment threshold. For either property purchase AED 750,000 or company establishment AED 1,000,000.

On the other hand, you also need documentation. It proves your financial capability and is required during the application process.

Clean Background and Health

Applicants must have a clean criminal record. They should be free from infectious diseases like HIV or tuberculosis. Medical tests are mandatory as part of the application process.

What are the benefits of 2-year investor visa?

There are several benefits to a 2-year investor visa Dubai. The list includes as:

Family Sponsorship

The visa extends residency benefits to your family members. This includes spouses, children, and in some cases, parents. Enabling them to live in Dubai and enjoy the same advantages as you.

Residency and Business Opportunities

In Dubai, the investor visa grants you residency for quite a long time. It accompanies the choice to renew. By having an investor visa, you can live, work, and put openly in the emirate. People are allowed to lay out a business, work for an organization, or seek independent open doors.

Multiple Entry and Exit

The 2-year investor visa allows you the freedom of multiple entries and exits. It can be done throughout the validity period. This allows you to travel freely without restrictions until your visa remains active.

What is the grace period before a 2-year Investor visa expires?

A 30-day grace period is offered to the Investor Visa holder. It follows the official expiry date of your visa. The grace period provides a crucial buffer. It addresses any last-minute tasks or departs the country without facing penalties.

Standard Grace Period

After the visa expires, the 2-year investor visa offers a 30-day grace period. It provides a short window to finalize any necessary procedures or depart the country without incurring penalties.

Utilizing the Grace Period:

You can use the grace period to renew your visa if you meet the renewal requirements. You can finalize business ventures or relocate your belongings. In the end, arrange your exit from the UAE.

Importance of Timely Action:

Before the grace period ends, it’s crucial to take action. However, overstaying a visa will result in fines. On the other hand, you will face potential complications for future UAE visa applications.

Conclusion

In conclusion, the 2-year investor visa presents a compelling opportunity. Especially for individuals who seek residency in Dubai through investment. They have the two main investment tracks. This entails property purchase or company establishment. It caters to a range of investor profiles.

The visa offers a pathway to residency for two years. It also provides a chance to renew and grants attractive benefits. The benefits include business opportunities, family sponsorship, and visa flexibility.

For entrepreneurs and property investors, an investor Visa is definitely worth exploring. It is also beneficial for someone interested in establishing roots in Dubai’s dynamic economy.

However, it is important to carefully consider the eligibility criteria, application process, and renewal requirements. This helps in ensuring a smooth and successful journey.

If you need assistance in Visa Services in UAE, Golden Visa UAE, Visa Benefits in UAE, Pro Visa Services Dubai, Business Consultant in Dubai, you can contact us anytime.

We have consultants to provide you with support in UAE Green Visa, business setup in Dubai Mainland, Freezone Business Setup in UAE, Property Visa Dubai, and UAE Business trade License.

  2. Green Visa
  3. Golden Visa

Standard Work Visa

The standard work visa is the most common type of work visa. This visa is sponsored by an employer in the private sector, government sector, or free zones. The key features of a standard work visa include:

  • It is valid for 2 years of tenure
  • The standard work visa can be renewable
  • This visa is sponsored by an employer
  • It allows workers to work for the sponsoring employer only

Green Visa:

The Green visa was introduced in the year 2022. This Visa targets freelancers, skilled professionals, investors, and entrepreneurs. The key benefits of the Green visa include:

  • The Green visa has a 5-year validity
  • There is no sponsor/employer is required
  • It can be renewable on the same terms
  • The Green visa comes with more flexibility in work and residency

Note that the eligibility criteria may vary for different categories.

The Golden Visa UAE offers long-term residency without a sponsor. The eligible ones for this visa are high-net-worth individuals. Eligibility criteria for this visa include:

  • Investors can apply for this visa with an AED 2 million deposit
  • The real estate investors with properties worth AED 2 million
  • Entrepreneur with projects worth AED 500,000
  • Specialized talents like scientists, doctors, athletes, Ph.D. holders, etc.

Eligibility Requirements for Employment Visas

Non-residents should be aged 18 or older to work in the UAE. Notwithstanding, they should meet the specified necessities illustrated by the MOHRE (The UAE labor law)

Then again, there’s no extreme age limit for work in the UAE. The businesses might cause extra expenses for laborers aged 65 or more.

The educational qualifications and skill levels of foreign workers determine the categories to which they are assigned.

Category 1:

In this category, individuals holding a bachelor’s degree or higher qualification.

Category 2:

The one possessing post-secondary qualifications in any field.

Category 3:

It includes individuals with a high school diploma.

Required Documents for Work Visa Permit

Applicants are required to ensure compliance with the UAE employment visa requirements when applying for a job visa. This includes:

  • Valid Passport: A passport with a minimum validity period.
  • Passport-size photographs: Recent passport-sized photographs as per the specified guidelines.
  • Educational Credentials: Academic certificates attesting to the applicant’s qualifications.
  • Medical Certificate: A valid medical certificate issued by approved medical facilities.
  • Employer’s Documents: Relevant documents pertaining to the hiring company, such as the commercial license and company registration documents.

On the other hand, the employer needs to provide a signed employment contract. This entails:

  • Benefits, and
  • Probation period.

They are responsible for submitting all necessary documents for the visa application. This includes the employee’s passport and medical test results. The employer applies for the entry permit and work visa. They apply with the MOHRE on the employee’s behalf. Covering the associated fees for medical tests, visa processing, and other government charges.

On visa approval, the employer facilitates the entry of employee into the UAE. With the GDFRA, they arrange for the employee’s medical test and residence visa application. The employer is responsible for ensuring the employee obtains their Emirates ID card, a national identification document linked to the visa.

  • It ranges from AED 600 to AED 2000 for Category 2 Depending upon the worker’s skill level, whether skilled or unskilled.

Now, you understand the 2 years employment visa Dubai price with the conditions involved

Employer Application

It is the responsibility of your employer who initiate the process by submitting an application to the MOHRE. It must include all the necessary documents required for processing.

Document Submission:

Employers provide the required documents to support the work permit application.

Review by MOHRE:

The Ministry of Labour reviews the application submitted by the employer.  Ensuring compliance with regulations and requirements.

Approval and Permit Issuance:

Upon approval, the work permit is issued. The approved permit can be downloaded by the employer.

Residence Visa Application:

Within 60 days of arriving in the UAE on a Pink visa (Work Entry Visa), applicants must initiate the process of obtaining a UAE residence visa and an official work permit.

Ministry of Labor Permission:

Once the employer receives the Ministry of Labor permission for the immigration quota. They can proceed with the work license application on behalf of the employee.

Residency Visa Issuance:

The residency visa is issued once the work permit application is approved. This enables the employee to commence official employment.

Medical Screening and Emirates ID:

Applicants undergo a mandatory medical examination, which necessitates presenting an Emirates ID. This process involves submitting the entry visa, original passport, and a copy thereof at the Emirates ID service center.

Work Entry Visa

Upon arrival at the airport, candidates receive a Work Entry Visa (Pink visa), granting them permission to stay in the UAE for a period of two months while completing the resident visa application.

Upon appearance in the UAE, candidates go through biometric testing. They need to submit documents. This includes the entry permit, passport, and work contract. Along with that, they need to continue with the clinical screening.

Conclusion

title: UAE Work Permit: Requirements, Process & Guidelines
content:
Due to the increasing number of foreigners looking for work, the UAE government has developed a strict policy to control the participation of foreigners in the country’s workforce. To work lawfully in the region, one must have both an employment visa and a work permit UAE, according to the country’s rules.

In this article, we will be giving you the necessary information on work permit UAE. For many people, navigating the distinctions between a work permit and an employment visa can be challenging. We have put together a thorough guide to assist you better understand the 3-year UAE work visa in order to remove this uncertainty. Let us observe.

Understanding the UAE Work Permit System

The United Arab Emirates has seen an increase in international investment in recent years. This, thanks to its diverse economy, progressively stable political structure, low tax environment, and open administration.

In order to take account of these possibilities and the promise of open access to the African and Asian markets, many companies are deciding to expand to the UAE. Businesses with international aspirations are turning to this potential sector. All because it provides a robust network of tax treaties internationally and has a healthy cash flow.

Consequently, as they expand to the UAE, they need to establish a workforce in the area. Thus, to legally work in the region, these employees need to have their own work permit UAE. A work permit in UAE is an official document that allows individuals to be hired by enterprises operating in the country.

The employer is responsible for initiating the license application and completing the appropriate processes. Following the completion of the application process, the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratization (MOHRE) is in charge of issuing the official document.

According to a recent declaration, a UAE work visa is normally effective for up to two years. However, there has been a welcome development: the UAE’s Federal National Council (FNC) has granted a three-year renewal of work visas. This move intends to reduce the cost burden of getting work permits. The FNC Committee on Financial, Economic, and Industrial Relations requested that the permission be extended to three years and that work permit payments for job transfers be waived.

A recommendation mandating that employees remain with an employer for at least a year following the probationary term was also adopted by the FNC. It should be noted that if both the worker and the boss agree, this obligation may be waived. The renewal of work permits offers expatriates more flexibility and potential financial advantages.

Types of Work Permits in UAE

The first group of work permits consists of:

  • Under the residence of family: People whose family member is sponsoring their residency visa are eligible for this permit. In this situation, the employer need just apply for a work permit. However, they do not need to sponsor the employee’s visa. With the support of PRO services in UAE, dependents can obtain this permit.
  • Juvenile work permit: This is for underage individuals that want to legally work in the area. Teenagers who want to work for a company in the private sector must present formal permission from a parent or legal guardian. In accordance with the UAE Labour Law, a corporation must also fulfill other requirements before applying for a juvenile work visa. This includes less working hours than an adult worker (a maximum of 6 hours a day) and the prohibition against hiring minors for dangerous or labor-intensive jobs.
  • Student employment permit: Anyone living in the UAE who is 15 years old or older is eligible to work there and receive training. The UAE’s official government website, u.ae, states that this permit is only for students who wish to enroll in a private company for the duration of a three-month training program. A minor’s parent or legal guardian must also give written permission before hiring or training them.

Second group work permits:

  • Foreign work permit: With this permit, companies in mainland or the free zones can recruit employees from abroad.
  • Freelance permit: If you want to work on your own, you can apply for this type of work visa. According to MOHRE, this permit is given to anyone who want to work for themselves but do not have a legitimate employment contract or sponsorship from a particular UAE firm.

Eligibility Criteria for UAE Work Permits

To be employed lawfully in the UAE, expatriates must possess a current employment permit and work visa. No extra resident visas are necessary for anyone who resides in the UAE on a work visa. You are able to live there legally for the predetermined amount of time with the help of a work visa. Here is how to obtain a work visa and permit for Dubai.

Whether or not foreigners require a Dubai working permit depends on three factors. You will require one if

  • You obtain a job while on your country.
  • When you are in the region on a visit or tourist visa, an employment opportunity arises.
  • You work in the area, but want to change your employment company.

In order to expedite this procedure, the MOHRE and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation have initially established centers abroad.

The second option is to leave the UAE and then apply for your Dubai work permit. It is not vital for you to take a flight back to your region. You can stopover in a neighboring nation (like Oman) when traveling with airlines to obtain a work permit in UAE.

The General Directorate of Residency and Foreign Affairs (GDFRA) in Dubai offers the ‘Change Status’ procedure, which the recruiting employer may also use. In this instance, you are not need to leave the nation in order to receive a work permit in Dubai.

You also receive a new work permit for joining a new company in the third situation. A worker whose contract ends due to contract expiration is eligible for a new work visa in Dubai under Article 1 of Ministerial Order No. 766 of 2015, if they are able to acquire a new professional opportunity.

UAE Work Permit Application Process

One of the most important things to realize about jobs in the UAE is that the employer is responsible for providing the work permit UAE and visa. You do not apply for these visas or permits on your own as an employee.

It is important to remember that the work permit and work visa are two different things. Here are the main differences between both:

  • Issuing authorities: The General Directorate of Residency Foreign Affairs (GDRFA) is in charge of providing UAE work visas, whilst the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratization (MoHRE) is in charge of issuing UAE work permits.
  • Function and purpose: The work permit UAE acts as a legal document that enables people to legally work there. A UAE work visa, on the other hand, enables travelers to enter and stay in the nation for employment-related reasons.
  • Cancellation process: These documents are governed by several agencies, thus the processes for canceling them also varies. It is advised that applicants review the rules established by the relevant government to comprehend the specific cancellation procedure.

Employers can easily terminate the work permits of their employees thanks to MOHRE’s easy service. It is essential for the business to satisfy all of the employee’s entitlements before starting the cancellation process and to get the employee’s signature on the permit cancelation form. Employers can visit the MOHRE website to acquire the details and instructions they need for the cancellation process.

It is vital to understand that when a work permit is revoked, employees no longer qualify to work for the same employer. Unless they go through the application procedure again for a new work permit. Therefore, it is important to know how to check work permit status in UAE.

Step by Step Guide to Applying for a Work Permit

As previously stated, the business or organization hiring the person starts the process of getting a UAE work visa. The business must have a current UAE business trade license in order to start the application procedure.

Follow these procedures when applying for a work permit in UAE:

  • On the Tas’Heel web page, the Ministry of Labour’s online system, the employer prints the request for the work permit.
  • They deliver the necessary papers (examples are below).
  • Following a review of their application, the Ministry may request additional information or request to fix mistakes.
  • The approval is given by the Ministry and is available for download by the employer on the Ministry website.

The MOHRE might decide not to grant, renew, or even issue a work permit, depending on the situation. These circumstances include:

  • The firm submitting fake documentation.
  • The corporation being fictitious.
  • Or the company not actively carrying out its legally established business operations
  • Failure of the business to adhere to the “wages protection system” or any other labor market regulation mechanism in place.

Documents Required for UAE work Permit

To apply for the license, employers must obtain the necessary documents to finish the UAE work permit application process:

  • A valid trade license.
  • Application form.

Employees must provide:

  • Valid passport.
  • Headshot pictures.
  • Emirates ID.
  • Entry permit.

Providing the proper employment permits for the staff can be daunting. However, if you hire PRO services in the UAE, you will not have to worry about anything. Connect FZ provides PRO solutions for companies looking to obtain the necessary work permit UAE for their staff. Consequently, with us by your side, you can abide by the laws and let your employees legally work in the region.

If you want to know more about our services, send us an email at contact@connectfz.com. Also, you can give us a call at +971 43 316 688. We are more than ready to provide you with our services and let you establish your business in the UAE compliantly!

In order to expedite this procedure, the MOHRE and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation have initially established centers abroad.

The second option is to leave the UAE and then apply for your Dubai work permit. It is not vital for you to take a flight back to your region. You can stopover in a neighboring nation (like Oman) when traveling with airlines to obtain a work permit in UAE.

The General Directorate of Residency and Foreign Affairs (GDFRA) in Dubai offers the ‘Change Status’ procedure, which the recruiting employer may also use. In this instance, you are not need to leave the nation in order to receive a work permit in Dubai.

You also receive a new work permit for joining a new company in the third situation. A worker whose contract ends due to contract expiration is eligible for a new work visa in Dubai under Article 1 of Ministerial Order No. 766 of 2015, if they are able to acquire a new professional opportunity.

UAE Work Permit Application Process

One of the most important things to realize about jobs in the UAE is that the employer is responsible for providing the work permit UAE and visa. You do not apply for these visas or permits on your own as an employee.

It is important to remember that the work permit and work visa are two different things. Here are the main differences between both:

  • Issuing authorities: The General Directorate of Residency Foreign Affairs (GDRFA) is in charge of providing UAE work visas, whilst the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratization (MoHRE) is in charge of issuing UAE work permits.
  • Function and purpose: The work permit UAE acts as a legal document that enables people to legally work there. A UAE work visa, on the other hand, enables travelers to enter and stay in the nation for employment-related reasons.
  • Cancellation process: These documents are governed by several agencies, thus the processes for canceling them also varies. It is advised that applicants review the rules established by the relevant government to comprehend the specific cancellation procedure.

Employers can easily terminate the work permits of their employees thanks to MOHRE’s easy service. It is essential for the business to satisfy all of the employee’s entitlements before starting the cancellation process and to get the employee’s signature on the permit cancelation form. Employers can visit the MOHRE website to acquire the details and instructions they need for the cancellation process.

It is vital to understand that when a work permit is revoked, employees no longer qualify to work for the same employer. Unless they go through the application procedure again for a new work permit. Therefore, it is important to know how to check work permit status in UAE.

Step by Step Guide to Applying for a Work Permit

As previously stated, the business or organization hiring the person starts the process of getting a UAE work visa. The business must have a current UAE business trade license in order to start the application procedure.

Follow these procedures when applying for a work permit in UAE:

  • On the Tas’Heel web page, the Ministry of Labour’s online system, the employer prints the request for the work permit.
  • They deliver the necessary papers (examples are below).
  • Following a review of their application, the Ministry may request additional information or request to fix mistakes.
  • The approval is given by the Ministry and is available for download by the employer on the Ministry website.

The MOHRE might decide not to grant, renew, or even issue a work permit, depending on the situation. These circumstances include:

  • The firm submitting fake documentation.
  • The corporation being fictitious.
  • Or the company not actively carrying out its legally established business operations
  • Failure of the business to adhere to the “wages protection system” or any other labor market regulation mechanism in place.

Documents Required for UAE work Permit

To apply for the license, employers must obtain the necessary documents to finish the UAE work permit application process:

  • A valid trade license.
  • Application form.

Employees must provide:

  • Valid passport.
  • Headshot pictures.
  • Emirates ID.
  • Entry permit.

Providing the proper employment permits for the staff can be daunting. However, if you hire PRO services in the UAE, you will not have to worry about anything. Consequently, with us by your side, you can abide by the laws and let your employees legally work in the region.

title: Multiple Entry Tourist Visa in the UAE: 5-Year validity
content:
The UAE introduced the 5-Year Multiple Entry Tourist Visa in 2021 as part of its long-term strategy to enhance tourism and attract global visitors. As of 2026, this visa remains one of the most flexible long-term visit options, allowing tourists to enter the UAE multiple times over a five-year period without requiring a local sponsor. Therefore, it aims to create flexibility and diversify business sectors. Also, the UAE has shifted its focus from gas and oil to other areas, implementing regulations to attract investment.

In this article, we will make sure you understand everything about the tourist visa of 5-year validity and why it is so important for the tourism of the country. On the other hand, you will understand everything about the different benefits as well as the application process for this type of visa. Let’s observe:

Overview of the Multiple Entry Tourist Visa

The diversification of all business areas across the UAE is opening new spaces for investment; in addition, it is great for a great economy. Similarly, diversification paves the way for important development in the UAE. And as we mentioned earlier, the UAE has been changing its prime focus from the gas and oil industries.

On the other hand, the introduction of the different programs such as UAE Golden Visa, Green Visa, and tourist visa of 5-year validity has been decisive steps in this direction. In addition, attracting foreign investment to the UAE in the tourism, infrastructure development, digitally, and in the medical sector has been the principal aim of the leaders.

In the same vein, the government implemented a multi-entry visa as a way to increment the tourist area. Similarly, the possibility of visiting the UAE several times with a tourist visa of 5-year validity is definitely a good way to boost the tourism sector in the country.

The UAE is one of the greatest tourist destinations worldwide, similarly, the country has large potential in this sector. For instance, with various exorbitant recreation activities, man-made wonders, and mesmerizing locations, the country surpasses most of the other developed countries.

When was the Announcement Date of the New Visa?

The 5-Year Multiple Entry Tourist Visa was originally introduced during the Expo 2020 period as part of broader reforms to modernize the UAE’s immigration framework. Since then, it has become a permanent and well-established visa category supporting tourism, business visits, and family travel. In the same vein, it led to widespread praise and was expected to be an absolute move in the right direction. On the other hand, the government entities have been working on formulating the right policy amendments, the inclusion, and preparation of guidelines of the procedure.

The government of the country established the official exposition of the introduction of this new visa method on March 21st of 2021. The immigration authority established that the visa has a validity period of 5 years.

In addition, the cabinet summit presided by HH Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Prime Minister, Vice President, and Ruler of Dubai, gave the green light for the multi-entry visa. Moreover, visa eligibility does not rule out any country. That is to say, all individuals regardless of their nationality are able to apply for this tourist visa if they meet the specific requirements.

For instance, the individuals must have at least $4000 in their bank account in the last 6-months period. Although the individuals can take advantage of a single stay up to 90 days; they can continue to stay 3 more months by obtaining approval from the government entity in charge. Further, the ex-pat would self-sponsor their visa.

On the other hand, the individual can enter or leave the UAE an unlimited number of times. However, the calculation of the 5-year period is from the first date of entry of the individual to the country.

These are the most common details about the newly implemented tourist visa in the United Arab Emirates. Moreover, the eligibility conditions are the same with an already existing tourist visa.

How do I apply for the New Multi-Entry Tourist Visa?

The Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP) is the federal authority responsible for visa issuance, regulation, and monitoring of the 5-Year Multiple Entry Tourist Visa. And as we mentioned earlier, the applicant must have a minimum of $4000 (or the equivalent in another currency) in their bank account in the last six months.

In other words, all individuals are able to apply for a visa; however, if you do it yourself it can be a complex process. Thus, in Connect Free Zone we assist you from the beginning to the end of this process; with us, you obtain support from our team of specialized immigration PRO services.

Let’s observe the step-by-step guide for the application of the multi-entry tourist visa:

  1. Firstly, the applicant must fill the application form providing different details such as:
    1. Intended stay address in the UAE.
    2. Service required.
    3. Beneficiary details.
    4. Address of the individuals in their home country.
  2. After that, the applicant must upload all the documents showing proof of the applicant’s statements. Further, these include a passport copy, passport-sized photography, medical insurance, and a bank statement of the past 6 months.
  3. Once the applicant successfully completed the details and uploaded all the documents, review the application.
  4. Pay the established fee for the multi-entry tourist visa.
  5. And then, the authority sends the approved visa to your email.

What are the Different Benefits of Multi-Entry Tourist Visa

Yearly, there are countless individuals visiting the UAE for several reasons such as work or recreational purposes. Therefore, this tourist visa of 5 years is a great way to assist them in this process. For instance, it would decrease the ongoing repeated approval and application process. In addition, it will cut many expenses.

On the other hand, there are several benefits of the multi-entry tourism visa:

  • Visit the UAE multiple times sponsoring yourself and live in the country for 90 days on every arrival.
  • Holders will be able to extend their visit period to 90 days more.
  • This multiple entry visa allows both UAE nationals and residents to bring their family to visit the country; this was very difficult with the previously available visas.
  • It eliminates the hassle of repeating applications for individuals visiting the UAE.
  • There is a new opportunity for more individuals to visit the country.
  • The overall fee for this type of visa is much less than repeatedly applying.
  • Individuals from any country around the globe can take advantage of it.

What is the Purpose of the Multiple-Entry Tourist Visa?

As we mentioned earlier, the 5-year tourist visa announcement was made last year in line with Expo 2020. At the time, Ali Mohammad Bin Hammad Al Shamsi; the head of the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship, stated that this decision was made taking into account the upcoming visitors of the Expo 2020.

In other words, the country receives more than 20 million visitors each year. For example, Dubai contributes massively to welcoming a great number of visitors, so having this innovative 5-year tourist visa will be of great help in the upcoming years.

Further, reducing the amount of paperwork involved in the process and; thus, cutting down most of the fees will certainly attract even more tourists to the country. Given that this opportunity is for individuals from all nationalities, it will be an important decision for the future of the country’s tourism sector.

5 Year Multiple Entry Visit Visa UAE Price

The ICA (Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship) stated that the multi-entry tourist visa application cost is DH 655 (approx. $180). In addition, the applicant must possess at least $4000 in their bank account in the previous six months. Similarly, this is perhaps the only rigid regulations regarding the multiple entry visa established by the government of the country.

On the other hand, the immigration authorities specified it will have a valid period of 5 years; calculated from the first date of entry. In the same vein, the individuals are able to can stay up to 3 months in the country in a single visit. But, if they need an extension, they can put a request to the government authority in charge.

Similarly, the foreign national can stay in the country for a maximum of 180 days in a single stay with approval from immigration authorities.

UAE ‘Golden Visa’

The government of the UAE, in another way of improving the tourism sector in the country; began issuing the new Golden Visas valid for 10-years. In addition, this was introduced last year and it allows applicants to be self-sponsors.

In the same vein, professionals including researchers, humanitarian workers, investors, doctors, innovators, outstanding students, entrepreneurs, CEOs, and specialists in the fields of; engineering, science, business management, technology, health, and education have been so far chosen to be eligible for the new type of visa.

In addition to the tourist visa, the UAE offers long-term residency options such as the UAE Golden Visa, which provides 10-year residency to eligible investors, entrepreneurs, specialized professionals, researchers, and outstanding talents.

Following reforms introduced in recent years, property investors may qualify with real estate investments starting from AED 2 million, subject to eligibility requirements. The Golden Visa allows self-sponsorship and long-term stability for qualified individuals and their families.

How can ConnectFZ Assist you to Acquire this Multiple-Entry Tourist Visa

We understand that establishing a business is sometimes a complicated process. That is to say, in Connect Free Zone we are here to help you successfully find the best pricing, discounts, and packages in the best and popular free zones in the UAE. In the same vein, we can sponsor your company in the UAE so you can easily set up in Mainland Dubai.

Similarly, we have more than 20 years of experience working with businesses in all sectors across the UAE; that allowed us to obtain the best experience we need to properly guide and advise you to achieve your business goals and successfully expand to the country.

In Connect Free Zone we are here to assist you to source the perfect business destination; we allow you to take advantage of all the benefits each offer will offer your business. That is to say, we compare free zones companies, rules, facilities, and locations regarding your business’ objectives and services.

Would you like Connect Free zone to start assisting you with the tourist visa of 5-year validity?

If you have any additional inquiries or you want us to start working with us side-by-side in the immigration process; you can always send us an email via contact@connectfz.com. Or if you prefer, you are able to call us at +971 4331 6688.

Frequently asked questions about the tourist visa of 5-year validity?

What is the fee for this multiple entry visa?

As we mentioned earlier, the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship established that the visa application fee will be DH 655 (approx. $180).

How will the residents of the UAE benefit from this change?

Relatives or family members of UAE residents wishing to stay in the country currently have to apply for different extensions if they want to stay longer than the period mentioned in the visa. However, with this 5-year tourism visa in Dubai and all across the UAE; families can spend more time with their families.

Further, this new visa will reduce all application processing periods. We know that applying for a visa on your own can be a complex process and doing it constantly is a hassle. Therefore, with the 5-year tourist visa, all residents can stay with their family for longer periods. And above all, they only need to make one payment.

And while this new tourist visa of 5-year validity has been announced, the roll-out, and of the procedures and the implementation will take some time. So, those residing in the UAE on a tourist visa may have to apply for a UAE tourist visa extension they want to stay for longer. In Connect Free Zone we recommend you stay legal and safe in the UAE and avoid overstaying fines.

title: How do I find Abu Dhabi business opportunities?
content:
Abu Dhabi is the capital of the United Arab Emirates and is known worldwide for being prosperous and constantly growing. This is a city that is home to many national and international companies. That is to say, currently, it is the ideal place to establish a business due to all the Abu Dhabi business opportunities that you can access. Furthermore, Abu Dhabi is an essential financial center in the Gulf region and thanks to this, there are more business opportunities. Especially for investors and entrepreneurs who want to establish themselves in the country.

In this article, we will provide you with information on how to find and take advantage of Abu Dhabi business opportunities. In principle, it is important to know that there are many business opportunities in Abu Dhabi. The reason for this is that many sectors are interesting for entrepreneurs. For example, oil and gas or tourism and technology. In addition, we will give you some advice on what business events are and how to establish contacts with influential people in the city.

Identifying Key Sectors and Investment Opportunities in Abu Dhabi

Abu Dhabi is known for being one of the most important financial centers in the Gulf. In this way, there are many business opportunities in Abu Dhabi for entrepreneurs and investors. This city is home to many national and international companies, making it a great place if you want to start a business in Abu Dhabi. In addition, this is known for being a very prosperous city with constant growth.

The Abu Dhabi Chamber of Commerce and Industry provides detailed information on key sectors and investment opportunities. For this reason, we will introduce you to some of the key sectors.

Tourism: with more than 11 million annual visitors, tourism is a booming sector in Abu Dhabi; offering unique experiences through a large turquoise sea and the golden desert.

Financial services: It is the financial center that is at the top of the region. In addition, it is distinguished by its access to global markets and talents, complemented by a large favorable regulatory framework.

Logistics: Offers great connectivity at the heart of trade and transportation around the world.

Education: It has a very wide range of educational institutions. Where you can find international schools to universities with great worldwide renown.

Health and biotechnology: Has a growing healthcare industry. In addition, it has several world-class hospitals and clinics. For this reason, it is important that you know everything about the HAAD medical license in Abu Dhabi.

Energy: It is one of the main producers of oil and natural gas worldwide. In this way, it becomes an ideal place for energy companies.

Exploring Strategic Investment Sectors in Abu Dhabi for Growth and Profit

If you want to be successful in the various investment sectors in Abu Dhabi, it is vital that you have a clear and well-defined strategy. In this way, one of the most important strategies is to carry out exhaustive research. Thus, knowing the current trends in the market and what the emerging industries are. Helping you identify the best Business in Abu Dhabi

On the other hand, we find that it is important that you can establish contact with influential people. In this way, business associations and chambers of commerce in Abu Dhabi can be very valuable. Obtaining information and resources for those seeking business opportunities.

Additionally, there are many industry-specific online communities. Focusing on areas such as tourism, technology, and energy. For this reason, these communities can be a great way to connect with other entrepreneurs and find new business opportunities. On the other hand, it is important that they also have a clear strategy for the growth and expansion of your business.

In this way, the Abu Dhabi Growth Fund is a local organization that works to promote and develop the interests of local and national companies in the UAE. In addition, ADG primarily invests in venture capital, private equity, hedge funds, and public equities. Seeking high-performance opportunities by partnering with the best fund managers worldwide.

Research and Networking in Abu Dhabi’s Business Ecosystem

Abu Dhabi offers many opportunities for investors and entrepreneurs. Therefore, if you are looking for business opportunities in Abu Dhabi, there are many ways to find them. First of all, it is important that you know the variety of opportunities that exist in Abu Dhabi. Finding industries such as oil and gas, tourism, and technology.

In this way, if you want to find opportunities, it is necessary to research market trends. Additionally, it is important that you network with influential people. Managing to obtain a lot of valuable information about the city market and investment opportunities.

The Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Abu Dhabi is a local organization that seeks to develop and promote the interests of local and national businesses. In addition, it offers a wide variety of services to its members. This includes government advocacy programs, educational and networking programs, and business services that are personalized.

You find that the chamber is responsible for organizing business events and trade fairs. It is an excellent way to establish contact with other entrepreneurs and be able to observe new business opportunities in Abu Dhabi.

Abu Dhabi’s Thriving Business Ecosystem: A Research Overview

Abu Dhabi has actively fostered its startup ecosystem to position itself as a global leader and an innovation center. Furthermore, in recent years, many organizations in Abu Dhabi have taken important initiatives to support and promote innovation.

In the city, you can find renowned research institutions. An example of this is the Masdar Institute of Science and Technology. This focuses on clean energy and sustainable technologies. In addition, institutions collaborate with new companies, driving innovation and providing access to their research facilities.

To attract new companies, HUB71 has been at the forefront of incentive programs. In this way, startup founders are offered access to a very rich ecosystem of talent and global investor

support networks. Additionally, initiatives such as the UAE Golden Visa program that was launched in 2019 make it even easier for startups to relocate.

One of the great advantages of the Golden Visa is that it allows business owners to retain 100% ownership of their companies. In addition, these visas are issued for a period that is renewable from 5 to 10 years depending on the category in which the visa is. In this way, we can find the great commitment that Abu Dhabi has to positively promote its business ecosystem.

Networking Opportunities in Abu Dhabi’s Business Community

If you want to be successful and get Abu Dhabi business opportunities, you have to understand the importance of networking. This is part of a comprehensive strategy to achieve objectives in the Middle East. Despite the rise of online networking, traditional meetings remain key in the business community in Abu Dhabi. title: What you need to know about DED license in Abu Dhabi
content:
If you want to start a business in Abu Dhabi, one of the most important steps is to obtain a DED license. Which means a permit or license from the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development (DED). This license allows you to conduct various economic activities in the emirate and enjoy many benefits.

In this article, we will explain what a DED license is, what activities you can perform with it, what is an economic license, and what are the benefits of a DED license.

What is DED license in Abu Dhabi?

A DED license is a business license issued by the Department of Economic Development (DED) in Abu Dhabi. The DED is the authority that regulates the business sector in the emirate and leads economic initiatives to achieve a knowledge-based, diversified, and sustainable economy.

You can apply for a DED license online through the website or in person at a customer service center. You will need to submit various documents in the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development. Such as:

  • Certificate of trade name
  • Copies of the passports of all shareholders
  • A letter from the Ministry of Economy and Planning that authorizes the company formation
  • Copy of your residence permit
  • A letter approving proposed business activities signed by the authorities
  • Clearance and no objections from your local sponsor in the form of a letter
  • A copy of your Memorandum of Association with said local sponsor
  • Copy of the letter from your bank that authenticates the claimed finances of the company
  • A copy of your tenancy contract

You may also need to get approval from other relevant authorities, depending on the nature of your economic activity. It depends on Abu Dhabi department of economic development activity list. For example:

If your business operates in the insurance industry, you may need to get approval from the Insurance Authority.

When your business operates in the healthcare industry, you will need to get approval from the Ministry of Health.

If your business operates in the hotel sector, you may need to get permission from the Abu Dhabi Tourism Authority.

Furthermore, for online or remote workers they can also apply for an Abu Dhabi department of economic development freelance license.

Trade License Activities you can perform in Abu Dhabi

With the Abu Dhabi department of economic development (DED) license, you can perform various trade license activities in Abu Dhabi. For example:

  • Import and export your goods with other nations
  • Take part in a number of commercial related activities
  • Let the masses know of your services and products through advertisements

However, the Abu Dhabi department of economic development offers different types of licenses for different activities. For example:

  • Commercial license: for trading activities, such as buying and selling goods or services. In this case you will need an Abu Dhabi economic department trade license
  • Professional license: for professional activities, such as consulting, accounting, or engineering
  • Industrial license: for manufacturing or industrial activities, such as producing or processing goods
  • Tourism license: for tourism-related activities, such as operating hotels or travel agencies

You can also apply for multiple licenses through the Abu Dhabi department of economic development (DED). This is done in case you want to conduct more than one activity.

What is economic license in Abu Dhabi?

An economic license is a type of DED license that allows you to conduct economic activities without having a physical presence or office space in Abu Dhabi. This means that you can operate your business from anywhere in the world. However, only as long as you have a local agent or sponsor who represents you in the emirate.

An economic license is ideal for businesses that do not require frequent interaction with customers or suppliers, such as e-commerce, consultancy, or media. With an economic license, you can enjoy benefits such as:

  • Low cost and fast registration process
  • No requirement for office space or employees
  • Access to various markets and customers
  • Flexibility and convenience

To apply you will need to submit similar documents as for a regular Abu Dhabi DED license. However, you will not need a tenancy contract or a letter from a bank.

Benefits of a DED License

DED license offers many benefits for owners and entrepreneurs who want to start or expand their business in Abu Dhabi. Some of these benefits are:

  • Access to a large and diverse market with high purchasing power and demand
  • Availability of various incentives and support programs from the government and other entities
  • Opportunity to participate in various projects and initiatives that contribute to the economic development and diversification of Abu Dhabi
  • Ability to benefit from the strategic location and connectivity of Abu Dhabi with other regions and countries
  • Enjoyment of a stable and secure environment with a high quality of life

DED Abu Dhabi – the legal requirements

A DED license is issued by the Abu Dhabi department of economic development. As mentioned above, this is the government entity responsible for regulating the economic activity and promoting the business environment in the emirate. A DED license is required for any type of business activity, whether it is commercial, industrial, professional, or tourism-related. There are different types of DED licenses depending on the nature and scope of your business. Such as:

  • General trade license

This allows you to engage in various trading activities, such as importing, exporting, distributing, or selling goods and services. Furthermore, In this case you would need to know how to start an import and export business particularly.

  • Industrial license

This allows you to establish and operate an industrial facility, such as a factory, workshop, or warehouse.

  • Professional license

It allows you to offer professional services, such as consulting, engineering, accounting, or legal services.

  • Tourism license

This allows you to operate a tourism-related business, such as a hotel, travel agency, or tour operator.

To obtain an Abu Dhabi economic department trade license, you need to follow certain steps and meet certain requirements. For example:

  • Choose a legal form for your business, such as a sole proprietorship, a partnership, or a limited liability company (LLC).
  • Pick a trade name for your business and register it with the DED.
  • Decide for a suitable location for your business and obtain the necessary approvals from the relevant authorities.
  • Prepare and submit the required documents, such as your passport copy, visa copy, Emirates ID copy, NOC from your sponsor (if applicable), and business plan.
  • Pay the fees for issuing and registering your DED license.

How can I check my trade license online in Abu Dhabi?

One of the advantages of having this license is that you can easily check the Abu Dhabi economic department online. You can check your status and validity through the website or mobile app. You can also access other online services related to your Abu Dhabi department of economic development license. For example

  • Renewing your DED license
  • Updating your contact details
  • Adding or removing partners
  • Changing your trade name
  • Adding or removing activities
  • Transferring your DED license
  • Cancelling your DED license

To check your trade license online in Abu Dhabi, you need to follow these steps:

  • Visit the DED Abu Dhabi website or download the mobile app.
  • Click on “e-Services” and then on “License Services”.
  • Enter your license number or trade name and click on “Search”.
  • You will see the details of your DED license, such as its status, expiry date, activities, partners, and fees.

Request for Renewal of Economic Licence

One of the responsibilities of having a DED license is to renew it every year before it expires. Failing to do so may result in fines, penalties, or suspension of your business activities. To renew your Abu Dhabi DED license online, you need to follow these steps:

  • Visit the DED Abu Dhabi website or mobile app.
  • Click on “e-Services” and then on “License Services”.
  • Enter your license number or trade name and click on “Search”.
  • Click on “Renew License” and follow the instructions.
  • You may need to upload some documents. Such as your tenancy contract copy, bank account statement copy, audit report copy (if applicable), and insurance certificate copy (if applicable).
  • Also, you will have to obtain some approvals from other authorities depending on your business activity.
  • Pay the fees for renewing your DED license online or at any authorized payment channel.

You will receive an SMS or email confirmation once your renewal request is processed. You can then print your renewed DED license from the website or mobile app.

Businesses Thriving with DED Licenses

Having a DED license in Abu Dhabi can offer many benefits for your business growth and success. Some of these benefits are:

  • You can access to a large and diverse market with high purchasing power and demand for various goods and services.
  • You will have access to a supportive and competitive business environment with world-class infrastructure, facilities, and services.
  • Entering to various incentives and initiatives from the government and other stakeholders to support entrepreneurship and innovation.
  • Access to various resources and opportunities for networking, learning, and development.

Some examples of businesses that are thriving with DED licenses in Abu Dhabi are:

  • Al Ain Farms: This is one of the leading dairy producers in the UAE that operates with an industrial DED license. It produces fresh milk, yogurt, cheese, and other dairy products using advanced technology and quality standards.
  • Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM): This is an international financial center that operates with a professional DED license. It offers a range of financial and non-financial services, such as banking, asset management, insurance, legal, and consulting services.
  • Yas Island: This is a premier leisure and entertainment destination that operates with a tourism DED license. It features various attractions, such as Ferrari World, Yas Waterworld, Yas Marina Circuit, Yas Mall, and Yas Links.

These are some of the things you need to know about DED license in Abu Dhabi. If you are interested in obtaining a DED license for your business, you can contact them through their different options. For example, their website, mobile app, call center, or customer service centers.

Conclusion

A DED license is a key requirement for starting a business in Abu Dhabi. It allows you to conduct various economic activities in the emirate and enjoy many benefits. You can apply for a DED license online or offline, depending on your preference and convenience. Furthermore, you can also choose between different types of licenses. Such as, commercial, professional, industrial, or tourism, depending on your activity.

Alternatively, you can opt for an economic license if you do not need a physical presence or office space in Abu Dhabi. Nonetheless, If you want to know more about DED license in Abu Dhabi, you can visit the DED website or contact us for more information and assistance.

  • Prepare and submit the required documents, such as your passport copy, visa copy, Emirates ID copy, NOC from your sponsor (if applicable), and business plan.
  • Pay the fees for issuing and registering your DED license.

How can I check my trade license online in Abu Dhabi?

One of the advantages of having this license is that you can easily check the Abu Dhabi economic department online. You can check your status and validity through the website or mobile app. You can also access other online services related to your Abu Dhabi department of economic development license. For example

  • Renewing your DED license
  • Updating your contact details
  • Adding or removing partners
  • Changing your trade name
  • Adding or removing activities
  • Transferring your DED license
  • Cancelling your DED license

To check your trade license online in Abu Dhabi, you need to follow these steps:

  • Visit the DED Abu Dhabi website or download the mobile app.
  • Click on “e-Services” and then on “License Services”.
  • Enter your license number or trade name and click on “Search”.
  • You will see the details of your DED license, such as its status, expiry date, activities, partners, and fees.

Request for Renewal of Economic Licence

One of the responsibilities of having a DED license is to renew it every year before it expires. Failing to do so may result in fines, penalties, or suspension of your business activities. To renew your Abu Dhabi DED license online, you need to follow these steps:

  • Visit the DED Abu Dhabi website or mobile app.
  • Click on “e-Services” and then on “License Services”.
  • Enter your license number or trade name and click on “Search”.
  • Click on “Renew License” and follow the instructions.
  • You may need to upload some documents. Such as your tenancy contract copy, bank account statement copy, audit report copy (if applicable), and insurance certificate copy (if applicable).
  • Also, you will have to obtain some approvals from other authorities depending on your business activity.
  • Pay the fees for renewing your DED license online or at any authorized payment channel.

You will receive an SMS or email confirmation once your renewal request is processed. You can then print your renewed DED license from the website or mobile app.

Businesses Thriving with DED Licenses

Having a DED license in Abu Dhabi can offer many benefits for your business growth and success. Some of these benefits are:

  • You can access to a large and diverse market with high purchasing power and demand for various goods and services.
  • You will have access to a supportive and competitive business environment with world-class infrastructure, facilities, and services.
  • Entering to various incentives and initiatives from the government and other stakeholders to support entrepreneurship and innovation.
  • Access to various resources and opportunities for networking, learning, and development.

Some examples of businesses that are thriving with DED licenses in Abu Dhabi are:

  • Al Ain Farms: This is one of the leading dairy producers in the UAE that operates with an industrial DED license. It produces fresh milk, yogurt, cheese, and other dairy products using advanced technology and quality standards.
  • Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM): This is an international financial center that operates with a professional DED license. It offers a range of financial and non-financial services, such as banking, asset management, insurance, legal, and consulting services.
  • Yas Island: This is a premier leisure and entertainment destination that operates with a tourism DED license. It features various attractions, such as Ferrari World, Yas Waterworld, Yas Marina Circuit, Yas Mall, and Yas Links.

These are some of the things you need to know about DED license in Abu Dhabi. If you are interested in obtaining a DED license for your business, you can contact them through their different options. For example, their website, mobile app, call center, or customer service centers.

Conclusion

A DED license is a key requirement for starting a business in Abu Dhabi. It allows you to conduct various economic activities in the emirate and enjoy many benefits. You can apply for a DED license online or offline, depending on your preference and convenience. Furthermore, you can also choose between different types of licenses. Such as, commercial, professional, industrial, or tourism, depending on your activity.

Alternatively, you can opt for an economic license if you do not need a physical presence or office space in Abu Dhabi. Nonetheless, If you want to know more about DED license in Abu Dhabi, you can visit the DED website or contact us for more information and assistance.
