title: Abu Dhabi Trade License Check: Verify Business Permits Easily
content:
In Abu Dhabi’s fast-paced and expanding business world, it’s very important to make sure that a business partner, supplier, or competitor is legitimate and trustworthy. One easy and useful way is to verify the Abu Dhabi trade license.

People and businesses need to safeguard their interests, prevent fraud, and create a safe and open business environment. This article is an entire guide to understanding why an Abu Dhabi trade license check is important and the information you may need to proceed.

The Significance of Checking the Trade License

The Abu Dhabi authorities issue trade licenses, which are legal documents that allow a firm to operate in the Emirate. It is a basic need for every business, whether it is a large organization or a small firm. 

The license shows that the business is lawful and lists the allowed and restricted business activities, its legal framework, and other important information. There are several reasons why you should go for an Abu Dhabi trade license check:

Investigation and Risk Reduction:

Checking a company’s trade license is an important part of the investigation that you must perform before engaging in any commercial deal, partnership, or financial transaction. A license that has expired, been suspended, or is no longer valid. 

It might be an alarming or warning sign that the business may be in trouble financially or legally. You may lower your risks and make sure you’re dealing with a real and compliant business by doing a check.

Performing Trade License Verification in Abu Dhabi

The Abu Dhabi government has made it easy to check company licenses online by means of its various ministries. The TAMM official portal is the main platform for this matter. It is an incorporated online platform that offers multiple government services, including trade license checks.

Follow these steps to perform an Abu Dhabi trade license check:

Go to the Official Portal:

You can easily perform Abu Dhabi trade license checks online through the recognized TAMM online web portal, which is the main place to go for queries regarding licenses. Find the License Enquiry section, which is usually under services offered by the Abu Dhabi authorities.

Select the Criteria:

The site has a number of ways to search for a business. You may usually search for:

Registered Number of the License:

It is the most efficient and precise method for Abu Dhabi trade license checks online and to get information about a firm if you already have its trade license number.

Authorized Reference Number:

You can also utilize additional identification numbers, such as a permit number, an online store number, or an MOA number.

Registered Trade Name:

You can look for Abu Dhabi trade license checks by name (registered trade name) in the absence of a license number. Make sure you enter everything correctly to get the right results.

Commercial Task:

You can sometimes ask about enterprises based on the type of work they do.

Fill Out the Form Properly:

Type in the information you need into the search box and hit the search button. The system will handle your request and provide you with the company’s public profile.

Look Over the Search Results:

The platform will provide you with a full profile of the company after the search is over. Usually, the details include:

  • The company’s Trade name or official name.
  • The trade license number is the only number that you can use to identify it.
  • The expiration date of the license needs to be renewed. It is an important detail to make sure it is true.
  • A list of the commercial tasks that the corporation is allowed to do under law.
  • The company’s official mailing address and other ways to get in touch with them.
  • The company’s legal form is that of an independent contractor or a partnership.

Varied Methods and Alternative Ways for Trade License Checks

The TAMM site is the main way to go for an Abu Dhabi trade license check, although there are other ways to cross-check and get extra information:

National Economic Registration Sources:

The National Economic Registration is an important resource where you can find all the information you need about enterprises registered in the UAE. You may utilize this to look up a business by name or license number to obtain an overall view.

MOHRE Inquiry:

You can also benefit from MOHRE’s inquiry services to check firm information, especially when it comes to work and employment.

Free Zone Regulatory Bodies:

You might have to use the web-based verification system for the relevant free zone if your firm is located in one of Abu Dhabi’s free zones. Every free zone has its own set of rules and a way to get a license.

Visiting Physical Locations:

In some cases, going to the company’s registered office in person can give you added peace of mind. Most real firms will show their trade license in their store or office for everyone to see.

Invalid or Missing Trade License Data

If you verify a company’s trade license and find that it is expired, suspended, or not listed on any official government site, you should be careful. It might indicate that the business is not real or is having a lot of issues with compliance and capital.

If you find yourself in this circumstance, it’s recommended to: 

  • Check your records again. To make sure your search didn’t have any mistakes.
  • Get in touch with the Abu Dhabi government for further information. They can give you official certification of the status of a trading license.
  • Never conduct business with the company unless you have obtained formal and adequate verification that it is legal.

Final Words

In the rapidly evolving digital economy, confidence and transparency are more important than ever. A swift and trustworthy Abu Dhabi trade license check online is an important tool for keeping yourself and your business safe. 

You can quickly verify the authorization of any firm by using the official government channels. It will help you make smart choices and help keep the business world secure and strong. The method is straightforward, the information is easy to find, and the peace of mind it gives you is priceless.

FAQs

What does it mean to check an Abu Dhabi trade license?

An Abu Dhabi trade license check is a way to make sure that an enterprise in Abu Dhabi is legitimate and has an appropriate license from the government authorities.

What do I need to know to complete a license check?

You usually require the company’s official business name or trade license number. The official web portals are the best places to look for information.

What information can you get from a licensing check?

A license check shows the trade name, license number, expiration date, recent status, and the company activities that are allowed. It attempts to see if the business is real and still going legitimately.

title: How much does a trade license cost in Abu Dhabi?
content:
Without a doubt, Abu Dhabi is a great city for doing business. For this reason, you are probably wondering about the process and the Abu Dhabi trade license fees. There is now good news for medium and small companies in the UAE.

In this article, you will learn everything about the trade license fees. Let us observe:

  1. Abu Dhabi
  2. What piques your interest in Abu Dhabi?
  3. Understanding what exactly is an Abu Dhabi Trade License
  4. How to obtain an Abu Dhabi trade license
  5. Activities permitted under different trade licenses
  6. Fees reduction
  7. How can Connect FZ help you?

1. Abu Dhabi

The Emirates has undergone a massive transformation of epic proportions in recent years, with extraordinary economic development and growth. Abu Dhabi has evolved into a dynamic hub and a major player in a variety of business and industrial sectors, allowing it to compete on the global stage.

Abu Dhabi is the richest emirate in the UAE, accounting for 95 percent of total oil production. Also, Abu Dhabi, as one of the fastest-growing business and industrial centers in the Arabian Gulf and the Middle East region, has become a hub for foreign investment, owing to its stable and prosperous economy.

1.1. Locations for doing business

There are numerous popular locations in Abu Dhabi for establishing a business. Some of the areas where you might want to consider establishing your business are as follows:

1.1.1. Al Ain

The city of Al Ain is located in the United Arab Emirates. The region is not only peaceful, with lush vegetation all around, but it is also home to Al Ain Farms, the UAE’s oldest dairy business; it was founded more than four decades ago. Aside from dairy farming, Al Ain’s climate is ideal for agricultural operations such as growing fresh fruits and vegetables and raising poultry.

1.1.2. Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM)

Abu Dhabi Global Market is a global marketplace. ADGM is an international financial center that follows English Common Law, allowing businesses to conduct themselves by global standards. As a result, it makes monetary transactions easier for companies doing business abroad.

The ADGM is made up of three distinct agencies: the registration, finance, and judicial systems, all of which collaborate to create a business-friendly environment.

1.1.3. The Khalifa Industrial Zone (KIZAD)

KIZAD provides large areas to meet the needs of the real estate and logistics sectors. It is also well-known in the industry for its free zone and mainland solutions. While it is well known that business setup in UAE free zone are limited to trading only within the jurisdiction in which they are located, entrepreneurs can obtain a second license through kizad.

So, you can use this dual license to open a Mainland office, apply for residency permits, and conduct business freely within the UAE.

1.1.4. Masdar City

Masdar City is a free zone dedicated to promoting renewable energy and sustainable urban development while also assisting the UAE in its transition to a knowledge-based society.

Additionally, it serves as the regional commercial center for several renewable energy initiatives. Therefore, entrepreneurs and investors who are passionate about modern technology are drawn in. In addition, we offer setup services in the UAE free zones.

1.2. Business activities are increasing

One of the most significant advantages of establishing a company in Abu Dhabi is that the emirate provides a favorable climate for certain industries, which include:

  • They manufacture oil and gas equipment in the following locations: This facility manufactures valves, pumps, fitters, tankers, turbines, and compressors, among other things.
  • Oil and gas supply and distribution companies: These are businesses that buy and sell natural resources.
  • Providing logistical support to the oil and gas industry entails the following activities: Companies that help with petroleum transportation.
  • Activities involving the sea: Companies that manufacture products for use in the maritime industry will find the Abu Dhabi ports to be an ideal location. Their businesses can run smoothly because of their proximity to other GGC countries, as well as the benefits of offshore facilities.

2. What piques your interest in Abu Dhabi?

Manufacturing, transportation, tourism, and healthcare are all experiencing significant growth in the city. Some of the highlights are as follows:

2.1. Obtaining long-term advantages at a reasonable cost

The annual renewal of a trade license can be an expensive endeavor. Starting a business in Abu Dhabi, on the other hand, is not only less expensive than in Dubai, but also more sustainable. Why? This is primarily because Trade licenses are typically valid for 1 year.

Therefore, this allows entrepreneurs to focus their time and energy on achieving their company’s goals rather than on the administrative tasks associated with renewals.

2.2. The overall standard of living

The Global Live ability Index 2021 named Abu Dhabi “the most liveable place in the region.” The emirate offers a desirable metropolitan lifestyle while also providing the peace that families seek.

Because the emirate is a popular destination for ex-pats from all over the world, visitors and residents can enjoy a wide range of activities, including foreign cuisine and entertainment.

2.3. ADNOC in Abu Dhabi: The benefits 

For oil and gas investors looking to establish a presence in Abu Dhabi, partnering with the Abu Dhabi Oil Company (ADNOC) is an excellent option. In many cases, permission from the Supreme Petroleum Council of the governing body in question is also required (SPC).

The SPC is the world’s highest-ranking energy decision-making organization, and it is critical for any company involved in oil and gas operations. One example is the delivery and distribution of oil and gas to and from ADNOC; as well as the manufacture of oil and gas equipment and logistical support, among other things.

Aside from that, any other businesses, including cafeterias and grocery stores, located within ADNOC’s jurisdiction must obtain permission from the State Planning Commission (SPC).

Additionally, companies in Abu Dhabi’s oil and gas sector expect to benefit from ADNOC’s ongoing expansion of the amount of business brought in through its numerous governmental collaborations.

3. Understanding what exactly is an Abu Dhabi trade license

An Abu Dhabi license is the documentation required for a company or individual to conduct commercial activities in the UAE. The process is governed and overseen by the Department of Economic Development (DED). Once you have obtained the license, you will be able to engage in the following activities.

Hence, you can engage in the following activities after obtaining a trade license.

  • Importing and exporting your goods to other countries.
  • Participating in a variety of commercially related activities.
  • Advertising your services and products to the general public.

On the other hand, if you are new to the UAE, we recommend that you seek the assistance of an expert business setup consultancy in the UAE to assist you in obtaining the trade license. This will speed up the process and help you avoid any cultural or legal stumbling blocks.

4. How to obtain an Abu Dhabi trade license

These are the steps you must take to obtain a trade license in Abu Dhabi. The steps are relatively simple, but you may encounter difficulties if you are unfamiliar with how to complete each step. All of these steps will be aided by a business set up consultant:

  • Choose a license type.
  • Reduce the number of business activities. In addition, keep in mind that the maximum number of activities is 10 per license.
  • Choose a suitable structure and legal status (LLC, sole proprietorship, etc.).
  • Choose a trading name for your company that complies with the UAE government’s list of permitted names.
  • Submit your application to the DED for preliminary approval.
  • Register your trade name after receiving initial approval.
  • Locate a local sponsor and execute a Memorandum of Association (MOA).
  • Find a location for your business and secure a tenancy contract.
  • Gather all relevant documentation, including the Memorandum of Agreement and application form.
  • Submit it to the DED for final approval, and you’re done!

Additionally, at Connect FZ, we can assist you on how to get a trade license in Abu Dhabi without an office.

5. Activities permitted under different trade licenses

If you are planning to apply for a license, you must be aware of the available activities. For this reason, here is the Abu Dhabi trade license activities list:

5.1. Commercial license operations

You can engage in the following businesses/activities with a commercial license:

  • Trading in general.
  • Contracting.
  • Real estate.
  • Healthcare.

5.2. Professional license exercises

Obtaining a professional license allows you to:

  • Teaching privately or in a classroom setting.
  • Practicing law as an individual or as part of a firm.
  • Auditing companies as an individual or as a group.

It is essentially the license that individuals with academic credentials must obtain. In addition to this, if you wish, we can provide you with an Abu Dhabi trade license activities list in pdf format.

5.3. Industrial license operations

It is the permit required to:

  • Managing a factory.
  • Producing products.
  • Profitable sales of goods.

This is the license that most Abu Dhabi investors seek. Additionally, in this article, you can learn how to get an industrial license.

5.4. License activities for craftsmanship

This is the license that workers whose primary skill is working with their hands must obtain. Some of the professionals who require this license are as follows:

  • Plumber.
  • Electrician.
  • Carpenter.
  • Painter.

5.5. Tourism-related activities

Given the UAE’s status as a global tourist destination, organizations interested in participating in the industry must obtain this license. This will enable them to:

  • Manage a hotel.
  • Create a travel agency.
  • Manage a restaurant.

Keeping in mind that the opportunities in the tourism sector are numerous, the activities listed above are only a subset of those that can be carried out under this license. It is best to consult with one of our expert business setup agents for complete information on all of the activities covered by each trade license.

6. Fees reduction

They have reduced Abu Dhabi trade license fees to AED1,000 as a result of collaborative efforts led by the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development (ADDED); in collaboration with multiple government authorities including the Abu Dhabi Chamber of Commerce and Industry. Abu Dhabi trade license renewal online fees have also been reduced to AED1,000.

The new fees cover all fees from Abu Dhabi Government entities such as ADDED, the Department of Municipalities and Transport, Abu Dhabi Chamber membership fees, CoC (Certificate of Conformity) issuance fees, and fees that Abu Dhabi regulating entities require  depending on the type of business.

Several fees have been eliminated, while others have been significantly reduced. The move will significantly improve the ease of doing business in the emirate and boost Abu Dhabi’s regional and international competitiveness. The implementation of a fixed fee will increase transparency while decreasing administration for investors.

6.1. Further information

It also backs the Abu Dhabi government’s efforts to improve the business environment for the private sector, particularly for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises.

We hope this significant change in fee structure helps to further ease the setup process for new and existing investors, were the words of Mohamed Ali Al Shorafa, Chairman of ADDED. As part of our new economic strategy, we want to create a thriving business environment in Abu Dhabi that encourages growth and innovation. The ease of starting and managing a business is a critical lever, and we are confident that the fee restructuring will help us achieve this goal.

The new fees will go into effect on Tuesday, July 27, 2021. Federal fees will remain in effect.

7. How can Connect FZ help you?

Now that we have discussed all of the elements and factors, it is clear that obtaining a trade license in Abu Dhabi is not a difficult process. Moreover, they have reduced the Abu Dhabi trade license fees. Therefore, now they are more affordable. Furthermore, using the services of Connect FZ will expedite and simplify the process.

Our years of experience and familiarity with the legal structures, local laws, and customs of the Emirates will ensure that your business is set up as smoothly as possible; this will allow you to devote your time to running your organization. Note that we will inform you about any change in the Abu Dhabi trade license fees. Additionally, we can teach you how to check trade license fines.

We are a leading agency in company formation, visa, licensing and other legal processes. You can always contact us to request more information. So call us now at +971 43 316 688 or write down all your questions and send them to us via email at contact@connectfz.com.Our agents will be pleased to solve all the doubts you may have about the Abu Dhabi trade license fees and DED Abu Dhabi trade license search.

One of the most significant advantages of establishing a company in Abu Dhabi is that the emirate provides a favorable climate for certain industries, which include:

  • They manufacture oil and gas equipment in the following locations: This facility manufactures valves, pumps, fitters, tankers, turbines, and compressors, among other things.
  • Oil and gas supply and distribution companies: These are businesses that buy and sell natural resources.
  • Providing logistical support to the oil and gas industry entails the following activities: Companies that help with petroleum transportation.
  • Activities involving the sea: Companies that manufacture products for use in the maritime industry will find the Abu Dhabi ports to be an ideal location. Their businesses can run smoothly because of their proximity to other GGC countries, as well as the benefits of offshore facilities.

2. What piques your interest in Abu Dhabi?

Manufacturing, transportation, tourism, and healthcare are all experiencing significant growth in the city. Some of the highlights are as follows:

2.1. Obtaining long-term advantages at a reasonable cost

The annual renewal of a trade license can be an expensive endeavor. Starting a business in Abu Dhabi, on the other hand, is not only less expensive than in Dubai, but also more sustainable. Why? This is primarily because Trade licenses are typically valid for 1 year.

Therefore, this allows entrepreneurs to focus their time and energy on achieving their company’s goals rather than on the administrative tasks associated with renewals.

2.2. The overall standard of living

The Global Live ability Index 2021 named Abu Dhabi “the most liveable place in the region.” The emirate offers a desirable metropolitan lifestyle while also providing the peace that families seek.

Because the emirate is a popular destination for ex-pats from all over the world, visitors and residents can enjoy a wide range of activities, including foreign cuisine and entertainment.

2.3. ADNOC in Abu Dhabi: The benefits 

For oil and gas investors looking to establish a presence in Abu Dhabi, partnering with the Abu Dhabi Oil Company (ADNOC) is an excellent option. In many cases, permission from the Supreme Petroleum Council of the governing body in question is also required (SPC).

The SPC is the world’s highest-ranking energy decision-making organization, and it is critical for any company involved in oil and gas operations. One example is the delivery and distribution of oil and gas to and from ADNOC; as well as the manufacture of oil and gas equipment and logistical support, among other things.

Aside from that, any other businesses, including cafeterias and grocery stores, located within ADNOC’s jurisdiction must obtain permission from the State Planning Commission (SPC).

Additionally, companies in Abu Dhabi’s oil and gas sector expect to benefit from ADNOC’s ongoing expansion of the amount of business brought in through its numerous governmental collaborations.

3. Understanding what exactly is an Abu Dhabi trade license

An Abu Dhabi license is the documentation required for a company or individual to conduct commercial activities in the UAE. The process is governed and overseen by the Department of Economic Development (DED). Once you have obtained the license, you will be able to engage in the following activities.

Hence, you can engage in the following activities after obtaining a trade license.

  • Importing and exporting your goods to other countries.
  • Participating in a variety of commercially related activities.
  • Advertising your services and products to the general public.

On the other hand, if you are new to the UAE, we recommend that you seek the assistance of an expert business setup consultancy in the UAE to assist you in obtaining the trade license. This will speed up the process and help you avoid any cultural or legal stumbling blocks.

4. How to obtain an Abu Dhabi trade license

These are the steps you must take to obtain a trade license in Abu Dhabi. The steps are relatively simple, but you may encounter difficulties if you are unfamiliar with how to complete each step. All of these steps will be aided by a business set up consultant:

  • Choose a license type.
  • Reduce the number of business activities. In addition, keep in mind that the maximum number of activities is 10 per license.
  • Choose a suitable structure and legal status (LLC, sole proprietorship, etc.).
  • Choose a trading name for your company that complies with the UAE government’s list of permitted names.
  • Submit your application to the DED for preliminary approval.
  • Register your trade name after receiving initial approval.
  • Locate a local sponsor and execute a Memorandum of Association (MOA).
  • Find a location for your business and secure a tenancy contract.
  • Gather all relevant documentation, including the Memorandum of Agreement and application form.
  • Submit it to the DED for final approval, and you’re done!

Additionally, at Connect FZ, we can assist you on how to get a trade license in Abu Dhabi without an office.

5. Activities permitted under different trade licenses

If you are planning to apply for a license, you must be aware of the available activities. For this reason, here is the Abu Dhabi trade license activities list:

5.1. Commercial license operations

You can engage in the following businesses/activities with a commercial license:

  • Trading in general.
  • Contracting.
  • Real estate.
  • Healthcare.

5.2. Professional license exercises

Obtaining a professional license allows you to:

  • Teaching privately or in a classroom setting.
  • Practicing law as an individual or as part of a firm.
  • Auditing companies as an individual or as a group.

It is essentially the license that individuals with academic credentials must obtain. In addition to this, if you wish, we can provide you with an Abu Dhabi trade license activities list in pdf format.

5.3. Industrial license operations

It is the permit required to:

  • Managing a factory.
  • Producing products.
  • Profitable sales of goods.

This is the license that most Abu Dhabi investors seek. Additionally, in this article, you can learn how to get an industrial license.

5.4. License activities for craftsmanship

This is the license that workers whose primary skill is working with their hands must obtain. Some of the professionals who require this license are as follows:

  • Plumber.
  • Electrician.
  • Carpenter.
  • Painter.

5.5. Tourism-related activities

Given the UAE’s status as a global tourist destination, organizations interested in participating in the industry must obtain this license. This will enable them to:

  • Manage a hotel.
  • Create a travel agency.
  • Manage a restaurant.

Keeping in mind that the opportunities in the tourism sector are numerous, the activities listed above are only a subset of those that can be carried out under this license. It is best to consult with one of our expert business setup agents for complete information on all of the activities covered by each trade license.

6. Fees reduction

They have reduced Abu Dhabi trade license fees to AED1,000 as a result of collaborative efforts led by the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development (ADDED); in collaboration with multiple government authorities including the Abu Dhabi Chamber of Commerce and Industry. Abu Dhabi trade license renewal online fees have also been reduced to AED1,000.

The new fees cover all fees from Abu Dhabi Government entities such as ADDED, the Department of Municipalities and Transport, Abu Dhabi Chamber membership fees, CoC (Certificate of Conformity) issuance fees, and fees that Abu Dhabi regulating entities require  depending on the type of business.

Several fees have been eliminated, while others have been significantly reduced. The move will significantly improve the ease of doing business in the emirate and boost Abu Dhabi’s regional and international competitiveness. The implementation of a fixed fee will increase transparency while decreasing administration for investors.

6.1. Further information

It also backs the Abu Dhabi government’s efforts to improve the business environment for the private sector, particularly for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises.

We hope this significant change in fee structure helps to further ease the setup process for new and existing investors, were the words of Mohamed Ali Al Shorafa, Chairman of ADDED. As part of our new economic strategy, we want to create a thriving business environment in Abu Dhabi that encourages growth and innovation. The ease of starting and managing a business is a critical lever, and we are confident that the fee restructuring will help us achieve this goal.

The new fees will go into effect on Tuesday, July 27, 2021. Federal fees will remain in effect.

7. How can Connect FZ help you?

Now that we have discussed all of the elements and factors, it is clear that obtaining a trade license in Abu Dhabi is not a difficult process. Moreover, they have reduced the Abu Dhabi trade license fees. Therefore, now they are more affordable. Furthermore, using the services of Connect FZ will expedite and simplify the process.

Our years of experience and familiarity with the legal structures, local laws, and customs of the Emirates will ensure that your business is set up as smoothly as possible; this will allow you to devote your time to running your organization. Note that we will inform you about any change in the Abu Dhabi trade license fees. Additionally, we can teach you how to check trade license fines.

We are a leading agency in company formation, visa, licensing and other legal processes. You can always contact us to request more information. So call us now at +971 43 316 688 or write down all your questions and send them to us via email at contact@connectfz.com.Our agents will be pleased to solve all the doubts you may have about the Abu Dhabi trade license fees and DED Abu Dhabi trade license search.

title: How to Get a Consultancy License in Dubai
content:
You need the right paperwork to start your consulting business in Dubai. Because whether you are planning to advise startups on scaling or helping global companies expand into new regions, your first real task isn’t even landing a client. Instead, it is getting your consulting license in Dubai.

In this blog post, we discuss everything you need to, from where to set up your shop to how you can file your documents, and yes, how our team can make the entire process way simpler than it sounds.

What Exactly is a Consultancy License & Why You Need One

Professionals and firms who want to offer their expert advice and specialized services in fields of management, marketing, HR, IT, and education require a consultancy license to operate in Dubai and UAE. 

It works as the very foundation your reputation stands on. In a market that has been built on trust and regulation, this license gives your business legitimacy. Clients prefer working with registered consultants as it signals professionalism, reliability, and compliance with UAE business laws. 

Now, if you have been planning to offer advice, strategy, or expertise in any form, a consultancy license is what turns your knowledge into an income-generating business.

Setting Up in Mainland or Free Zone: Which Option Fits Your Consulting Goals Best?

Before you apply, you will have to decide where you want to establish your company: Dubai Mainland or one of its many Free Zones.

Each option has its own perks. If you want flexibility to work with government entities or clients across the UAE, a Mainland license is your go-to. It allows you to operate without restrictions on who you can serve. Free Zones, on the other hand, are perfect if you will be primarily working with international clients, enjoy 100% ownership, and prefer simplified paperwork and taxes.

Each free zone caters to different industries. Dubai Media City, Dubai Internet City, and Dubai Multi Commodities Centre are popular choices for consultants. But the best fit depends on your goals, business model, and target market.

Our setup experts help you weigh your options and choose the most efficient and cost-effective path for your consulting business license in Dubai if you are feeling unsure about which route matches with your consulting plans.

Step-by-Step Process for How You Can Get Your Consulting Business License in Dubai

You can easily get your consultancy license by following these steps:

Step 1: Choose Your Business Activity

Define your consultancy type clearly. The Dubai Department of Economic Development (DED) and Free Zone authorities have predefined activity lists. Choose the one that matches your field, whether it’s marketing, HR, finance, or IT.

Step 2: Pick Your Trade Name

Your company name must reflect your business activity, avoid offensive words, and follow UAE naming rules. It should be simple, clear, and ideally include ‘consulting’ or a related term to speed up approvals.

Step 3: Get Initial Approval

Once your name and activity are approved, you will apply for initial permission from DED for mainland or from the relevant authority for the free zone. This step confirms that your business type is legally acceptable.

Step 4: Prepare and Submit Documents

You will have to gather all required documents:  passport copies, business plan, visa copy, proof of address, and a few others depending on your setup type. Some applicants might need additional approvals if their consulting field is specialized, like legal or financial services.

Step 5: Lease an Office or Virtual Desk

You need an office space to activate your license. Many free zones now allow flexi-desks or virtual offices that are ideal for any solo consultants or startups looking to minimize their costs early on.

Step 6: Pay the Fees and Collect Your License

You will receive your consultancy license once all your documents have been approved and the fees have been paid. Then you can apply for your visa, open a corporate bank account and start signing clients.

Our team handles these steps daily, helping entrepreneurs get their consulting business license in Dubai faster by managing paperwork, coordination, and communication directly with authorities.

What Documents Do You Need for a Consultancy License in Dubai

The documentation part is where most delays happen. But if you know what’s required upfront, you have nothing to worry about. Here’s what you’ll usually need:

  • Passport copies of the shareholders or owners
  • Passport-size photos
  • Entry stamp or residence visa copy
  • Proof of address
  • Business plan or outline of services
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your sponsor if you’re a UAE resident
  • Memorandum of Association (MOA) and lease agreement for mainland setups

A quick tip from our clients’ experiences: always check that your documents are notarized and attested before submission. Many applicants skip this step, only to have their approval delayed for weeks. Our licensing specialists double check every document to prevent those hold-ups.

Why Companies Choose Connect FZ for Business Setup

Getting a consultancy license in Dubai is one thing. Getting it fast, correctly, and with minimal hassle is another. And that’s exactly where we come in.

We guide you on each stage, from selecting the right jurisdiction to preparing your application and finalizing approvals. Our experts work directly with free zone and DED authorities, so you won’t find yourself stuck with unclear updates or paperwork issues.

Clients trust us because we simplify decisions while tailoring our solutions to your exact business type. From helping you find the most suitable free zone to supporting post-licensing tasks like visa applications, office setup, and bank account assistance, our team ensures your consulting business launches smoothly.

Get in touch with us to obtain your consultancy license in Dubai faster than you thought was possible.

Build Your Consulting Brand with Us

Getting your consultancy license in Dubai gives you access to one of the most dynamic consulting markets in the world. With the right guidance, the process can be fast, clear, and completely manageable. And that’s exactly what we provide.

Let our experts handle the paperwork while you focus on advising, analyzing, and helping businesses grow. Reach out today and get your consultancy license in Dubai without the usual hassles.

FAQs About Getting a Consultancy License in Dubai

  1. How long does it take to get a consultancy license in Dubai?

It usually takes a few working days once your documents are approved, though timelines vary based on your chosen Free Zone or Mainland authority.

  1. Can foreigners apply for a consultancy license in Dubai?

Yes. Dubai welcomes foreign investors, and you can fully own your consulting business in most Free Zones. Mainland setups may also allow 100% ownership depending on your activity.

  1. Do I need an office space to get the license?

Yes, but it doesn’t have to be a traditional office. Many free zones now offer flexi-desks or shared office options that meet the legal requirements.

  1. What’s the difference between a consultancy and a professional license?

A consultancy license covers advisory and strategic services, whereas a professional license is for hands-on, skill-based services. If you’re offering expertise or analysis, consultancy is your fit.

  1. Is it necessary to renew the consultancy license every year?

Yes, all business licenses in Dubai are renewable annually. Our team can handle the renewal process so you can stay focused on your clients.

title: All you need to know about the Restaurant License in Dubai – Learn how to obtain it
content:
Since the UAE and Dubai are popular tourist destinations, investors from everywhere decide to establish businesses of all kinds. For instance, businesses related to food, services, and many more. The food sector is among the most successful ones and any investor can establish a food company or restaurant. However, a restaurant license in Dubai is required.

In this article, you will learn everything you need to know about the restaurant license in Dubai. For instance, you can learn basic information about it and the required process to obtain it. Besides, any investor willing to establish a restaurant or any food-related business must be aware of this information. Let’s observe:

  1. What is a restaurant license in the Dubai emirate?
  2. How to set up a restaurant in Dubai efficiently?
  3. What documents do you need to obtain this license?
  4. The main requirements to open a new restaurant in Dubai.
  5. Are there other licenses related to the food sector in Dubai?
  6. Learn more about the trade license and the food license.
  7. How can Connectfz help you obtain more information about this license?

1. What is a restaurant license in the Dubai emirate?

The restaurant license in Dubai is a special permit that investors can obtain to conduct a food business legally. In this case, the Food Safety Department is the authority that provides and issues this license. However, it is essential to obtain the trade license first. The investor will have to obtain this first license from the DED (Department of Economic Development).

Although it is the main license to establish a restaurant in Dubai, other licenses are necessary too. For instance, the food and safety license is a requirement. The investor can obtain this license under a trade license. And just like the restaurant license, the Food Safety Department is the authority that issues this other license.

If investors desire to open restaurants in Dubai or any other location in the country, this license is necessary. Besides being mandatory, it is also a guarantee that their businesses are legal and transparent. If you are interested in obtaining this license and the other ones that are necessary, keep reading this article.

Remember that the trade license and the food and safety license are first, and then the restaurant license. You can request a business setup partner to help you apply for the license if necessary. In case you don’t have a partner who can help you with this process, then here you’ll learn about it.

Here you can learn everything you need to know about the trade license in Dubai and how to obtain it.

2. How to set up a restaurant in Dubai efficiently?

Opening your restaurant license in Dubai is an easy process. It only requires a few steps to follow in order to complete it. Since the first step is obtaining the licenses that we previously mentioned, here we will show you the next steps. Follow this short guide and you will get your license to run your restaurant effectively:

2.1. Select the most suitable location for your restaurant.

Before you choose a location, you must decide whether your business will be in Dubai mainland or free zone. Therefore, you should first learn the differences between these two options. In Dubai mainland, your business will require a local sponsor. The sponsor will hold 51% of your shares and the owner holds the remaining 49%. Remember that it will be necessary to obtain the approval of the DED authorities.

On the other hand, if you set up your restaurant in a Dubai free zone, things will be different. In the free zones, you can hold 100% of your company’s shares. Besides, a local sponsor is not a requirement to operate a business. Any of the available free zones in Dubai can offer you different advantages for your restaurant.

Right after you choose the most convenient area, you will select a specific locality to establish your restaurant. The most crowded locations are usually the best places for a restaurant or any other food business. Make sure to target the right customers according to the type of cuisine you want to operate.

Here you can learn about the company registration process in Dubai to establish a company successfully.

2.2. Get your business plan prepared.

If you want to create a professional business plan for a restaurant, you must take into consideration several factors. For example, a SWOT analysis helps you develop a good strategy by analyzing strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats. Other factors can be preparing a financial plan, analyzing the target marketing, and more.

An investor should also consider preparing a contingency plan, a market survey, cash projections, break-even analysis, and other details. All of these aspects will help you complete a flawless business plan for a restaurant. And therefore, you will be able to obtain your restaurant license in Dubai. Remember that you can always request help from a business partner to obtain better results.

2.3. Estimate the costs and expenditures.

As a final step to establish a restaurant successfully, you must prepare a favorable financial plan. It will help you spend the necessary resources to complete setting up a restaurant in Dubai. Besides, it will still help you in the future to keep track of your investments and spends.

In other words, you will take control of different aspects that will shape your restaurant. For instance, a financial plan will help you decide the type of restaurant you want, the staff and equipment you need, etc. And most importantly, it will let you know how much the restaurant license in Dubai will cost.

These are some costs that you need to consider in order to open a restaurant in Dubai:

  • A trade license (from AED 10,000 to AED 12,000 approximately).
  • The rent of the restaurant premises, which varies by location (from AED 60,000 approximately and above).
  • The labor and immigration registration (up to AED 8,000 approximately).
  • The local sponsor fee (around AED 10,000 annually).

Once you have prepared all these aspects, you will then complete some other simple steps. The first one will be submitting the required documents to obtain your license. If you are not sure what documents you will need, keep reading this article to discover them. And finally, you have to comply with the food code. It is a comprehensive document that establishes the requirements that every food business must follow. This document ensures a world-class food safety system.

Here you can learn some helpful recommendations to establish a free zone company in Dubai.

3. What documents do you need to obtain this license?

Since it is necessary a restaurant license in Dubai to operate a restaurant, let’s see the required documents. Keep in mind that some other documentation might be necessary depending on several aspects. For instance, it could vary depending on the type of restaurant, the type of food, among other details. Let’s see the basic documents you will need to obtain your license:

  • The trading license.
  • The food and safety license.
  • The NOC (No Objection Certificate) from the local municipality of Dubai.

As we previously mentioned, other documents are important to operate a restaurant without having trouble with the authorities. These other permits that could be necessary to run a restaurant in Dubai are these:

  • The delivery permit.
  • The Ramadan permit.
  • The liquor permit.
  • The pork permit.

Here you can learn how to obtain a general trading license in Dubai to start operating your company.

4. The main requirements to open a new restaurant in Dubai.

Any investor who desires to open a new restaurant in Dubai must cover some basic requirements. In this case, we will show the main architectural requirements. For example, you need to cover the following aspects:

  • All walls, floor, and roof must be washable, fireproof, and non-absorbent.
  • The kitchen space should be at least 300 to 380 square feet, in case there is a tandoor. Or it could very well cover 40 percent of the total area of the restaurant.
  • There must be a basin to wash utensils, another one to clean vegetables, and another different basin for meat.
  • It is necessary to have a drainage pipe at least 2 inches from the wall.
  • The ventilation facility should be appropriate and the chimney must be 2 meters higher than the nearest building.
  • It is a must to have an acceptable storage facility for all types of food. Make sure to fit the storage area with stainless steel shelves.

Here you can learn important information about warehouse and storage facilities in the United Arab Emirates.

5. Are there other licenses related to the food sector in Dubai?

In case you do not desire to open a restaurant but another type of food business, you have other options. Any investor can open a cafeteria, a food truck, a food delivery service, and many other food-related alternatives. However, each of them will require different types of licenses.

For example, if you want to establish a cafeteria, you need a cafeteria license, which is a professional type license. The Dubai Economic Department is the authority that issues it. In case you desire to know the cafeteria license cost in Dubai, visit their website or consult it with your partner.

Another case could be the home food business. Any investor who loves making food at home can also establish it as a business. But just like in the previous cases, a business license is necessary to accomplish this goal. In this case, it would be essential to acquire a home food business license in Dubai.

There are many other food licenses, permits, and approvals that will be vital for this kind of business. For instance, you can find kiosk permits, food promotion permits, temporary permits, and many more. If you need more information, you can obtain it from the Dubai Municipality authorities on their website.

Here you can learn some other excellent business ideas to set up a small business in Dubai.

6. Learn more about the trade license and the food license.

As an investor, you can obtain your trade license from the DED. The cost of this license could be around AED 30,000 and AED 40,000. As for the food license, you can obtain it from the Food Safety Department, the authority responsible for it.

Remember that you can only obtain the food license after obtaining the trade license first. Besides, you might need some other licenses, such as the food consignment license, the liquor license, among others.

7. How can Connectfz help you obtain more information about this license?

Before you start building your own restaurant in Dubai, you should obtain professional advice from Connectfz. Our team will guide you and help you discover the most efficient ways in which you can achieve your goals. Besides, you will be able to get your license in a matter of time and without going through tedious processes.

With our services, you can get the best packages, competitive prices, and more advantages for your business. In addition, you can request some other services that will your restaurant be more efficient and profitable. Since the UAE and Dubai are popular tourist destinations, investors from everywhere decide to establish businesses of all kinds. For instance, businesses related to food, services, and many more. The food sector is among the most successful ones and any investor can establish a food company or restaurant. However, a restaurant license in Dubai is required.

In this article, you will learn everything you need to know about the restaurant license in Dubai. For instance, you can learn basic information about it and the required process to obtain it. Besides, any investor willing to establish a restaurant or any food-related business must be aware of this information. Let’s observe:

  1. What is a restaurant license in the Dubai emirate?
  2. How to set up a restaurant in Dubai efficiently?
  3. What documents do you need to obtain this license?
  4. The main requirements to open a new restaurant in Dubai.
  5. Are there other licenses related to the food sector in Dubai?
  6. Learn more about the trade license and the food license.
  7. How can Connectfz help you obtain more information about this license?

1. What is a restaurant license in the Dubai emirate?

The restaurant license in Dubai is a special permit that investors can obtain to conduct a food business legally. In this case, the Food Safety Department is the authority that provides and issues this license. However, it is essential to obtain the trade license first. The investor will have to obtain this first license from the DED (Department of Economic Development).

Although it is the main license to establish a restaurant in Dubai, other licenses are necessary too. For instance, the food and safety license is a requirement. The investor can obtain this license under a trade license. And just like the restaurant license, the Food Safety Department is the authority that issues this other license.

If investors desire to open restaurants in Dubai or any other location in the country, this license is necessary. Besides being mandatory, it is also a guarantee that their businesses are legal and transparent. If you are interested in obtaining this license and the other ones that are necessary, keep reading this article.

Remember that the trade license and the food and safety license are first, and then the restaurant license. You can request a business setup partner to help you apply for the license if necessary. In case you don’t have a partner who can help you with this process, then here you’ll learn about it.

Here you can learn everything you need to know about the trade license in Dubai and how to obtain it.

2. How to set up a restaurant in Dubai efficiently?

Opening your restaurant license in Dubai is an easy process. It only requires a few steps to follow in order to complete it. Since the first step is obtaining the licenses that we previously mentioned, here we will show you the next steps. Follow this short guide and you will get your license to run your restaurant effectively:

2.1. Select the most suitable location for your restaurant.

Before you choose a location, you must decide whether your business will be in Dubai mainland or free zone. Therefore, you should first learn the differences between these two options. In Dubai mainland, your business will require a local sponsor. The sponsor will hold 51% of your shares and the owner holds the remaining 49%. Remember that it will be necessary to obtain the approval of the DED authorities.

On the other hand, if you set up your restaurant in a Dubai free zone, things will be different. In the free zones, you can hold 100% of your company’s shares. Besides, a local sponsor is not a requirement to operate a business. Any of the available free zones in Dubai can offer you different advantages for your restaurant.

Right after you choose the most convenient area, you will select a specific locality to establish your restaurant. The most crowded locations are usually the best places for a restaurant or any other food business. Make sure to target the right customers according to the type of cuisine you want to operate.

Here you can learn about the company registration process in Dubai to establish a company successfully.

2.2. Get your business plan prepared.

If you want to create a professional business plan for a restaurant, you must take into consideration several factors. For example, a SWOT analysis helps you develop a good strategy by analyzing strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats. Other factors can be preparing a financial plan, analyzing the target marketing, and more.

An investor should also consider preparing a contingency plan, a market survey, cash projections, break-even analysis, and other details. All of these aspects will help you complete a flawless business plan for a restaurant. And therefore, you will be able to obtain your restaurant license in Dubai. Remember that you can always request help from a business partner to obtain better results.

2.3. Estimate the costs and expenditures.

As a final step to establish a restaurant successfully, you must prepare a favorable financial plan. It will help you spend the necessary resources to complete setting up a restaurant in Dubai. Besides, it will still help you in the future to keep track of your investments and spends.

In other words, you will take control of different aspects that will shape your restaurant. For instance, a financial plan will help you decide the type of restaurant you want, the staff and equipment you need, etc. And most importantly, it will let you know how much the restaurant license in Dubai will cost.

These are some costs that you need to consider in order to open a restaurant in Dubai:

  • A trade license (from AED 10,000 to AED 12,000 approximately).
  • The rent of the restaurant premises, which varies by location (from AED 60,000 approximately and above).
  • The labor and immigration registration (up to AED 8,000 approximately).
  • The local sponsor fee (around AED 10,000 annually).

Once you have prepared all these aspects, you will then complete some other simple steps. The first one will be submitting the required documents to obtain your license. If you are not sure what documents you will need, keep reading this article to discover them. And finally, you have to comply with the food code. It is a comprehensive document that establishes the requirements that every food business must follow. This document ensures a world-class food safety system.

Here you can learn some helpful recommendations to establish a free zone company in Dubai.

3. What documents do you need to obtain this license?

Since it is necessary a restaurant license in Dubai to operate a restaurant, let’s see the required documents. Keep in mind that some other documentation might be necessary depending on several aspects. For instance, it could vary depending on the type of restaurant, the type of food, among other details. Let’s see the basic documents you will need to obtain your license:

  • The trading license.
  • The food and safety license.
  • The NOC (No Objection Certificate) from the local municipality of Dubai.

As we previously mentioned, other documents are important to operate a restaurant without having trouble with the authorities. These other permits that could be necessary to run a restaurant in Dubai are these:

  • The delivery permit.
  • The Ramadan permit.
  • The liquor permit.
  • The pork permit.

Here you can learn how to obtain a general trading license in Dubai to start operating your company.

4. The main requirements to open a new restaurant in Dubai.

Any investor who desires to open a new restaurant in Dubai must cover some basic requirements. In this case, we will show the main architectural requirements. For example, you need to cover the following aspects:

  • All walls, floor, and roof must be washable, fireproof, and non-absorbent.
  • The kitchen space should be at least 300 to 380 square feet, in case there is a tandoor. Or it could very well cover 40 percent of the total area of the restaurant.
  • There must be a basin to wash utensils, another one to clean vegetables, and another different basin for meat.
  • It is necessary to have a drainage pipe at least 2 inches from the wall.
  • The ventilation facility should be appropriate and the chimney must be 2 meters higher than the nearest building.
  • It is a must to have an acceptable storage facility for all types of food. Make sure to fit the storage area with stainless steel shelves.

Here you can learn important information about warehouse and storage facilities in the United Arab Emirates.

5. Are there other licenses related to the food sector in Dubai?

In case you do not desire to open a restaurant but another type of food business, you have other options. Any investor can open a cafeteria, a food truck, a food delivery service, and many other food-related alternatives. However, each of them will require different types of licenses.

For example, if you want to establish a cafeteria, you need a cafeteria license, which is a professional type license. The Dubai Economic Department is the authority that issues it. In case you desire to know the cafeteria license cost in Dubai, visit their website or consult it with your partner.

Another case could be the home food business. Any investor who loves making food at home can also establish it as a business. But just like in the previous cases, a business license is necessary to accomplish this goal. In this case, it would be essential to acquire a home food business license in Dubai.

There are many other food licenses, permits, and approvals that will be vital for this kind of business. For instance, you can find kiosk permits, food promotion permits, temporary permits, and many more. If you need more information, you can obtain it from the Dubai Municipality authorities on their website.

Here you can learn some other excellent business ideas to set up a small business in Dubai.

6. Learn more about the trade license and the food license.

As an investor, you can obtain your trade license from the DED. The cost of this license could be around AED 30,000 and AED 40,000. As for the food license, you can obtain it from the Food Safety Department, the authority responsible for it.

Remember that you can only obtain the food license after obtaining the trade license first. Besides, you might need some other licenses, such as the food consignment license, the liquor license, among others.

7. How can Connectfz help you obtain more information about this license?

Before you start building your own restaurant in Dubai, you should obtain professional advice from Connectfz. Our team will guide you and help you discover the most efficient ways in which you can achieve your goals. Besides, you will be able to get your license in a matter of time and without going through tedious processes.

With our services, you can get the best packages, competitive prices, and more advantages for your business. In addition, you can request some other services that will your restaurant be more efficient and profitable. For example, we can help you find the target customers and the most convenient place for your business. And when your restaurant is finished, we can help you to make it grow.

Once you have already opened your restaurant, you can request our recruitment services to find the staff you need. Or in case you need help to manage your HR department, our HR consultancy services are available for you. Among other useful services, you can request our payroll services, visa and government services, and many more.

title: How to Avoid Overstay Visa Fines and Visa Cancellation in UAE
content:
Foreigners need a valid visa and an Emirates ID. These prove the identity. They verify the legal status in the country. There can be situations where your visa or Emirates ID expires. There might be circumstances where it gets cancelled. You will have to deal with the consequences of a visa overstay fine in UAE.

We will explain what are the Emirates ID expired fine and visa fines. We discuss about how to pay these, how to check them and how to avoid them. We will also go over the overstay fine in UAE. We also share how to prevent them from happening.

Latest News and Updates of Cancelled Visa Overstay Fine

UAE standardized visa overstay fines starting October 14, 2022. Overstayers on residence visas are now charged AED fifty per day. The previous visa overstay fine in the UAE was AED twenty-five per day for cancelled residency visas.

Staying in the UAE after a tourist visa expires or is not renewed will result in:

  • You will be fined AED 50 per day for each day you overstay.
  • This daily fine applies from the first day after your visa expiry.
  • Additional administrative or exit service fees may apply when settling fines.

You should understand the UAE residence visa expiry and cancellation rules. Staying in the country after your residency visa grace period ends will lead to a penalty of AED 50 per day until your status is regularized or you exit the country.

How to Check Expiry Fines in UAE?

Check how many days you have of overstay. Find out how much you have to pay the overstay fine in UAE. Visit the ICA Smart Service website and follow these steps:

  • Select the option for Public Services from the drop-down menu.
  • Pick the window ‘Fines – Pay Fines – Violations of Entry Permissions or Residences – Pay New Fine’.
  • Press on the ‘Start Service’ option in the window.
  • Fill out the procedure pop up in front of you to finish: Request Information, Review Application, Application fees.
  • After that, you will be able to check how many days you have of overstay. Also, you will see how much you have to pay for your fine.

Pay for expired Emirates ID or overstay visa fine in UAE online. In the website, select your relationship with a sponsor from the drop-down box. That is why you shall:

  • Provide your phone number for the OTP
  • Give out your bank card details and submit a request

This is how to check expiry fines in UAE and pay them as soon as it is possible.

Documents to Bring to Apply for Emirates ID Fines Waiver

There are several reasons why you could have been overstaying your visa. Unavoidable circumstances can be the reason such as:

  • medical emergencies
  • family issues
  • legal disputes

These cases make you eligible for a waiver of your Emirate ID fines. Take the following documents to any ICA office to apply for a waiver:

  • Your original passport and a copy of it.
  • The original Emirates ID and a copy of it.
  • A letter from your sponsor explaining the reason for your overstay and requesting a waiver.
  • Any supporting documents that prove your reason for overstaying such as medical reports, court orders or police reports.

The ICA will review your application. They will decide to grant you a waiver or not. The decision depends on each cases’ merits. It is not guaranteed.

What is Emirates ID Fines?

Emirates ID expiry fines are penalties. You have to pay them if you fail to renew your ID before it expires. The Emirates ID card is an identification document. It contains your personal and biometric information. It is for various purposes such as:

  1. Accessing government services
  2. banking
  3. healthcare
  4. education
  5. travel

The Emirates ID card is valid for duration of two, three and five years. If you lose, damage, or someone steals your Emirates ID card the process will a different one. Report it. Replace it within seven days. Otherwise, you will have to pay a fine of the same amount.

Emirates ID Expiry Fine Payment

If you incur an Emirates ID fine, pay it as soon as possible. Cover the expense to avoid a more expensive cancelled visa overstay fine. Pay your Emirates ID fine online to Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship. Complete the process with Emirates ID number and a credit or debit card. Submit the payment. Receive a confirmation message and a receipt.

Pay your Emirates ID fine offline at any of the ICA service centers. Typing centers across the UAE also accept the fine payments.

Offline Procedure to Check Emirates ID Fine

Check if you have an Emirates ID fine or not by visiting any of the ICA service centers or typing centers in the UAE. You will need your original Emirates ID card and a copy of your passport to check the fine. They will ask you to enter your Emirates ID number on a device. The fine amount will be displaying on the screen.

Call the ICA toll-free number 6005 30003. Provide your Emirates ID number to check the fine. You will be connected to an automatic voice system. Enter your Emirates ID number. They will then tell you the fine amount.

How Many Types of Emirates ID Fines Are There?

There are two types of Emirates ID fines:

  1. for late renewal:
    The late renewal fine is for not renewing your Emirates ID card before it expires.
  2. for late replacement
    It is for when do not replace your lost, damaged, or stolen ID within seven days.

Is There Any Fine for Not Renewing an Emirates ID?

The fine is 20 AED daily, up to a maximum of 1,000 AED. This fine is separate from the cancelled visa overstay fine. Which is much higher and depends on your visa type and duration.

If you overstay your visa in the UAE, you will face a visa overstay fine and a possible visa cancellation. The visa overstay fine varies depending on your visa type and duration. For example:

  • A visit visa valid for 30 days will have a fine of 200 AED for the first day
  • it will be 100 AED for each next day.
  • This goes up to a maximum of 3,000 AED.

If you have a residence visa that is valid for three years, you will have:

  • a fine of 125 AED for the first day of overstaying
  • 25 AED for each next day
  • This can reach a maximum of 2,500 AED.

Also, remember that having your residence visa up to date has different privileges. For example, being able to travel to other countries in the world visa free for UAE residents.

You can face a visa cancellation if you overstay for more than six months. You will lose your legal status in the UAE. You will not be able to apply for a new visa. Unless you clear your fines and exit the country.

You may also face other consequences. For example:

  1. Getting into a blacklist of the country
  2. Facing a ban even facing a deportation from the UAE

How to Avoid Overstay Visa Fines and Visa Cancellation in UAE

Avoid overstay fine in UAE. Renewing or extend your visa before an eminent expiration. Do this online through the ICA website or app. Or do it offline at any of the ICA service centers or typing centers in the UAE. You will need these to complete the process:

  • your passport
  • visa copy
  • sponsor’s details
  • a credit or debit card

You will receive a confirmation message and a new visa sticker after the process is done.

If you have overstayed your visa in the UAE, pay your fines. Exit the country as soon as possible. Avoid further penalties and complications. As we have been mentioning, you can pay your fines online through the ICA website or app.

Pay offline at any of the ICA service centers or typing centers in the UAE. You will also need an exit permit from the ICA to leave the country. Pay the fee of 100 AED for the exit permit.

Conclusion

There are hefty overstaying visa fines in UAE. Keep track of your visa and Emirates ID expiry dates. Renew or extend them before they expire. Avoid overstaying. Exit the country. Re-enter with a new visa. If you have already overstayed or if your visa is cancelled, you should pay your fines. Exit the country as soon as possible to avoid further consequences. You must follow the visa cancellation process if it occurs. Even if it happens by your sponsor or by the authorities.

You can contact us ConnectFz anytime for further information on this subject.

title: 10 Benefits of setting up a freezone company in UAE
content:
Among the most favorable business hubs that you can find in the world, there is the UAE and its business locations. Besides being an excellent location to do business, the UAE can also bring you a lot of benefits and advantages. And freezone company formation is one of your best options to obtain those benefits for your business.

In this article, you will learn everything you need to know about the benefits of setting up in the UAE. More precisely, here you can find information about the most outstanding advantages of setting up a free zone company. Furthermore, we’ll provide you with useful information about the business setup process in these UAE jurisdictions known as free zones. Let’s observe:

Why is Setting Up a Free Zone Company in UAE Beneficial?

When starting a business in the UAE, you will be able to choose different jurisdictions to set up your company. And the main jurisdictions that you can select in this country are mainland areas, offshore areas, and free zones. Although all of them offer incredible benefits, the most popular option among foreign investors is free zones.

Free Zones in the UAE are certain locations where investors can trade and exchange different products, services, and commodities. But there are certain regulations and rules that they must follow in order to avoid legal issues. However, all regulations are very flexible, which is one of the many benefits that free zones can offer.

When setting up a freezone company in UAE, you’ll be able to get those benefits to boost your business exponentially. In fact, those advantages are the main reason why investors from everywhere decide to set up in those UAE locations. Now, let’s take a look at the many benefits that UAE free zones can provide you with and discover some reasons why becoming an entrepreneur in the UAE can be a favorable business idea for professionals like you.

Tax Benefits that Free Zones Offer.

One of the major reasons why investors from many different countries choose free zones over other options is this benefit. In the UAE, free zones are popular for offering tax exemptions to all companies that operate within these special areas. And some of the taxes that free zone companies and businesses are exempted from are personal and corporate income taxes.

And in some cases, companies can even get exempted from other relevant taxes, such as the VAT. Although the VAT is low, setting up a freezone company in UAE allows your business to get an exemption from it. In case you need to obtain more accurate information, Connect Free Zone can provide you with the guidance you require and If you desire to set up a facility management company in Dubai, here you can learn how to do it.

Exemption From Import and Export Duties.

Besides enjoying tax exemptions, you can also enjoy exemptions from import/export duties when setting up a freezone company in UAE. All free zones in the country provide companies with this benefit, which helps them to grow exponentially as stable businesses. And both the country and the investors can obtain other advantages with this import and export duties exemption.

Due to the import and export duties exemptions, free zones can contribute to the promotion of international trade within these jurisdictions. As a result, free zones are now attractions for foreign businesspeople and invite them to create their many businesses there. However, it is important to learn about the procedures related to import and export activities in free zones.

Complete Foreign Ownership of Your Company.

Another outstanding benefit that makes free zones successful business hubs for investors is the foreign ownership of companies or businesses. If you’re looking forward to setting up a freezone company in UAE, you’ll be able to enjoy 100% of ownership. In other words, you will not need to appoint a local sponsor to hold 51% of your company.

Unlike free zones, companies located in the mainland jurisdiction must find a UAE national who holds that percentage of their companies. In the meantime, business owners can only have the remaining 49%. However, that does not apply to free zones since business owners can hold 100% of the ownership.

Repatriation of Profits and Capital.

Apart from getting 100% of the foreign ownership of your company, you can also get full repatriation of capital and profits. All companies that operate in any of the available UAE-free zones will be able to get full repatriation benefits. And of course, it includes profits and financial assets as well, which is also an advantage for all companies and businesses.

In other words, by setting up a freezone company in UAE, you can send your earned profits back to your home country. And besides your company’s profits, you can also transfer your capital invested to your home country.

Access to a Variety of Facilities and Workspaces.

Another advantage that you can get by setting up a freezone company in UAE is access to multiple facilities. For example, you can rent or lease warehouses in excellent conditions, fully equipped office spaces, and many other available options. And since these facilities and spaces are easy to find, free zones became quite popular among SMEs and startups.

Besides, you can find plenty of alternatives, from the cheapest to the most expensive options. And you are also free to choose between leasing and renting your ideal workspace. However, that will mostly depend on your needs and available budget.

Access to World-Class Infrastructure.

You can also get access to the most efficient and modern infrastructure and other elements, including communication systems and more. Also, you can use excellent transportation systems to transport your goods and products by air, sea, and land. Besides, there is easy access to famous airports and seaports, which makes it easier for your business.

Hassle-Free Immigration Process.
