title: Commercial & Professional License Dubai: Trading vs Service
content:
Dubai’s business environment can be exciting yet complex. Especially when identifying the right license type for your venture. Whether you’re an entrepreneur looking to launch a flourishing retail store or a skillful professional. The one who desires to offer specialized services. Then you must understand the distinction between a commercial license and a professional license. Each of these licenses serves a unique purpose. They are tailored to different business activities. Knowing which one aligns with your goals can set you on the path to success. Let’s dive into the key difference between commercial and professional license Dubai. So, you can make informed decisions. Start and embark on your entrepreneurial journey with confidence!

Commercial License VS Professional License: The Difference Explained

When starting a business in Dubai, understanding the nuances between a commercial license and a professional license is crucial. Each serves distinct purposes, catering to various business activities and ownership structures. Let’s break down the difference between commercial and professional license Dubai.

What is Commercial License in Dubai, UAE

This license is designed for businesses engaged in trading activities. A commercial license allows companies to import, export, distribute, and sell goods within the UAE. The commercial license covers trading in goods, retail, wholesale, and e-commerce. Generally, foreign investors require a local sponsor (UAE national). Especially in business setup in Dubai Mainland. For applicable sectors, retail, wholesale, import/export, and various trading activities are included. Additionally, commercial licenses can be issued to a single entity or multiple partners.

What is Professional License in Dubai, UAE

A professional license is issued for individuals offering professional services or skills. Ideal for freelancers, and consultants. It works best for other service providers as well. The professional license includes several activities and conditions. Those conditions must be complied with. For instance, it covers professional services like consultancy, health, education, as well as technical services. In most instances, the professional license can guarantee 100% foreign ownership, subject to no requirement for a local sponsor. This license applies to sectors like consulting, IT services, and medical services, among others. The license can also be issued to individuals or partnerships. However, it depends on the service offered.

Commercial License VS Professional License

Aspect Commercial License Professional License
Purpose Trading goods and services Providing professional services
Ownership Requires a local sponsor for foreign investors Allows 100% foreign ownership
Business Activities Retail, wholesale, and trading Consultancy, IT, healthcare, specialized services
Requirements Registration with DED and relevant authorities Registration with DED and applicable bodies

Ownership Structure: Who’s in Charge?

Commercial License:

Typically, requires at least one local sponsor who holds 51% ownership in the business. However, this can vary depending on the business activity and structure.

Professional License:

A professional license allows for complete foreign ownership. It means you can fully control your business without needing a local partner. Making it more appealing for solo entrepreneurs and specialists.

What are the Benefits of a Commercial License in Dubai?

It offers numerous advantages to acquiring a commercial license in Dubai for businesses. Specifically, the one looking to establish or expand their operations. We share some key benefits:

Access to a Thriving Market:

The strategic location of Dubai provides access to a vast market. This makes it an ideal place for trading activities.

Diverse Business Opportunities:

A commercial license allows you to engage in various activities. This includes:

  • Retail
  • Wholesale, and
  • E-commerce

This facility gives you the flexibility to explore multiple revenue streams.

Supportive Business Environment:

The government of Dubai actively supports business growth. They offer support through initiatives, tax incentives, and a regulatory framework. Making it easier to start and run a business.

Easier Import and Export:

Import and export goods without significant restrictions with a commercial license. It also capitalizes on Dubai’s advanced logistics and transport infrastructure.

Potential for Growth:

The commercial landscape of Dubai is continually evolving. Providing opportunities for businesses to grow and expand both regionally and globally.

Brand Recognition:

Businesses operating under a commercial license in Dubai enhance your brand’s credibility and recognition. This in turn attracts more customers and business partners.

Networking Opportunities:

The vibrant business community of Dubai allows for networking with local and international businesses. It fosters collaborations and partnerships that can drive growth.

Foreign Investment Opportunities:

A commercial license facilitates foreign investment. It enables you to attract capital and resources to support your business objectives.

Attractive Lifestyle and Infrastructure:

Dubai offers a high standard of living. It also provides excellent infrastructure and a multicultural environment. Making it an attractive place for business owners and their employees.

How Much Does a Commercial License Cost in Dubai?

The cost of obtaining a commercial license in Dubai can vary based on several factors. This includes:

  • Business activity type
  • Your business location, and
  • The specific legal structure you choose.

The cost of obtaining a commercial license in Dubai is the same as the fees for acquiring a license. The base license fee on average ranges between AED 10,000 and AED 15,000. It will depend on business activity and the licensing authority type. That is the mainland or free zone.
The registration fees also go into it. Fees for the name registration of your trade and obtaining approvals from the DED add another AED 1,000 and AED 2,000. Then there are local sponsor fees. Their fee may be between AED 5,000 and AED 50,000 a year. However, this depends on the terms with which the sponsor proceeds.
Commercial licenses usually require a physical office space. However, costs vary greatly based on location and size. The rents range from AED 15,000 to AED 100,000 or more per annum. The added costs are documents and legal fees. The documents such as MOUs or contracts. This might add another AED 2,000 to AED 5,000.

How to Get Commercial License in Dubai – Steps

Obtaining a commercial license in Dubai involves structured steps. We share a straightforward guide to help you through the process:

Determine Your Business Activity:

Identify the activities your business will engage in. It helps you choose the correct license type. While it ensures compliance with regulations.

Choose a Business Name:

Choose a suitable name for your business. It must comply with Dubai’s naming regulations. Avoid any offensive or inappropriate terms. There’s a way to check the availability of your chosen name through the DED website.

Prepare Required Documents:

Gather the necessary documents. It typically includes:

  • A copy of your passport and residence visa
  • NOC from a sponsor (if needed)
  • Proposed trade name registration
  • Business plan and details of activities
  • Lease agreement for your office space

Reserve Your Trade Name:

Submit your trade name for approval to the DED. This usually requires a small fee and is valid for a specific period.

Obtain Initial Approval:

Apply for initial approval from the DED. This step confirms that you can proceed with the business setup. It involves business plan submission and other supporting documents.

Draft the Memorandum of Association (MOA):

Setting up a company? Then draft an MOA with the assistance of a legal expert. Outlining the rights and responsibilities of the partners/shareholders.

Secure Office Space:

Lease physical office space by Dubai’s regulations. Obtain a tenancy contract. It is often required for the license application.

Submit Final Documents and Pay Fees:

Compile all required documents. This includes:

  • The MOA
  • Tenancy contract, and
  • Initial approval

Submit these documents to the DED along with the applicable fees for your commercial license.

Receive Your License:

Receive your commercial license, once your application is processed and approved. Keep a copy of this document for legal and operational purposes.

Apply for Visas:

Apply for employee visas and any additional permits. This can be done after obtaining your commercial license. It is needed for your business operations.

What are the Benefits of a Professional License in Dubai?

Obtaining a professional license in Dubai comes with a range of advantages. This is especially true for individuals and businesses. The ones that are focused on providing specialized services. We share some key benefits:

100% Foreign Ownership:

Foreign investors can own their business entirely with a professional license. Even without the need for a local sponsor. It allows for greater control and independence in operations.

Access to a Diverse Market:

The strategic location of Dubai provides access to a diverse and growing market. It enables professionals to tap into a wide range of clients and industries.

Flexibility in Business Activities:

A professional license allows for a variety of business activities. This includes:

  • Consultancy
  • Healthcare
  • IT services, and more

It gives professionals the flexibility to adapt and expand their services as needed.

Simplified Regulatory Process:

Generally, the procedures for obtaining professional licenses are very straightforward. It is relatively less bureaucratic than other licenses. Thus, it is easier to start up and run a business.

Networking Opportunities:

Dubai’s dynamic business venue offers numerous networking events, trade shows, seminars, and more. Having a professional license gives a particular authenticity quotient to one’s credentials and opens the door for valuable connections.

Enhanced Reputation:

A professional license underlines the fact that you are sufficiently compliant with the regulatory bodies about your field of operation. It supports your reputation and credibility among clients and partners.

Potential for Growth and Expansion:

Professionals can explore various growth opportunities with the ability to operate freely. They also have the support of Dubai’s business ecosystem. The businesses can branch into new services or markets.

Attracting Top Talent:

The prestige associated with a professional license can help attract skilled professionals to your business. It fosters a talented and capable workforce.

Tax Benefits:

The tax-free environment of Dubai allows businesses to retain more of their earnings. It enhances profitability and enables reinvestment into growth.

Supportive Business Ecosystem:

Dubai provides a supportive infrastructure for businesses. It includes:

  • Access to modern facilities
  • Technology, and
  • A skilled workforce, all of which can contribute to your success.

How Much Does a Professional License Cost in Dubai?

The cost of a professional license in Dubai ranges from AED 10,000 to AED 15,000. However, it depends on the specific business activity. It also depends on the relevant authority. This fee includes registration costs, trade name reservations, and initial approvals.

However, additional expenses may arise from securing office space. This can vary widely based on location and size. It also varies with legal fees for drafting documents like the Memorandum of Association. The budgeting for around AED 20,000 to AED 30,000 is advisable. This covers all associated costs, including visa applications for employees if needed.

How to Get Professional License in Dubai – Steps

 

To obtain a professional license in Dubai involves a series of steps. These steps ensure compliance with local regulations. A simple guide to help you through the process:

Determine Your Business Activity:

Identify the specific services you plan to offer. This will guide your license application and help you understand any specific requirements for your chosen activity.

Choose a Business Name:

Select a suitable name for your business. It must comply with naming regulations in Dubai. Check for availability through the DED.

Prepare Required Documents:

Gather the necessary documents. It typically includes:

  • A copy of your passport and residence visa
  • No Objection Certificate from a sponsor
  • Proposed trade name registration
  • Business plan outlining your services
  • Lease agreement for your office space

Reserve Your Trade Name:

Submit your trade name for approval to the DED. This involves a small fee and ensures your chosen name is available for use.

Obtain Initial Approval:

Apply for initial approval from the DED. This step verifies that you can proceed with your business setup. It may require the submission of your business plan.

Draft the Memorandum of Association:

If you’re setting up a company, draft an MOA with legal assistance. This outlines the structure and agreements between partners.

Secure Office Space:

Lease a physical office space that meets local requirements. Obtain a tenancy contract. It is necessary for the license application.

Submit Final Documents and Pay Fees:

Compile all required documents. This includes the MOA and tenancy contract. Submit these to the DED along with the applicable fees for your professional license.

Receive Your License:

Once your application is processed and approved. You will receive your professional license. It allows you to legally operate your business.

Apply for Visas:

After obtaining your license, you can apply for employee visas and any additional permits needed for your business operations.

Capital Requirements: Setting Up Your Business

Set up your business in UAE Freezone while knowing the capital requirements. It is counted as the most important part. Let’s explore the commercial and professional license capital requirements in detail.

Commercial License: Higher Minimum Capital

The minimum capital is normally higher when taking the example of establishing an enterprise under a commercial license in Dubai. This is especially so for trading enterprises that are given a minimum capital of AED 300,000 and above, depending on the nature of the business activity conducted in that particular place. It means an amount of capital comfort for business as such that the organization can utilize in carrying out its operations and initial costs.

Professional License: Lower Minimum Capital

In contrast, setting up a business with a professional license generally involves lower minimum capital requirements. It can be operationalised with as less as AED 10,000 on a consultancy or IT services business. Thus, businessmen and freelancers have an easier time launching their ventures without the setbacks of high initial capital investment. The lower capital requirement reflects the nature of service-oriented businesses, which often have fewer physical assets to finance.

How do you Decide which License to apply for?

There are multiple ways by which you can decide on which license to select. You can seek professional guidance, and take guidance from consultants. For instance, you can also hire lawyers who specialize in business law.

Seeking Professional Guidance: Make an Informed Choice

Choosing the right license for your business in Dubai can be a crucial decision that impacts your operations and growth potential. To make an informed choice, consider seeking professional guidance. Consulting with experts who understand the nuances of business licensing can help clarify your options based on your specific business activities and goals. They can assess your needs and recommend the most suitable license type, ensuring you are well informed about the implications of each option.

Business Consultants: Streamlining the Process

UAE Business consultants can play a pivotal role in streamlining the licensing process. They possess in-depth knowledge of the local market and regulatory requirements, making them invaluable partners in your business setup journey. By working with a consultant, you can navigate the complex paperwork, secure the necessary approvals, and avoid common pitfalls. Their expertise can save you time and effort, allowing you to focus on your core business objectives while ensuring a smooth setup.

Lawyers Specializing in Business Law: Ensuring Compliance

Engaging a lawyer who specializes in business law can further enhance your decision-making process. These legal professionals can provide crucial insights into the compliance aspects of various licenses, helping you understand the legal obligations associated with each. They can assist in drafting necessary documents, such as the Memorandum of Association, and ensure that your business structure aligns with local regulations. Having legal guidance helps mitigate risks and ensures that your business operates within the legal framework from day one.

What are the different types of licenses in Dubai

Dubai offers various types of licenses tailored to specific business activities, including commercial, professional, industrial, and tourism licenses. Each license serves distinct purposes, allowing businesses to operate legally within their respective fields. Commercial licenses are primarily for trading activities, while professional licenses cater to service-oriented businesses. Industrial licenses are needed for manufacturing and production activities, and tourism licenses are designed for businesses in the hospitality and travel sectors. Understanding these categories is essential for entrepreneurs when setting up their businesses.

Is Commercial License and Trade License Same?

While the terms “commercial license” and “trade license” are often used interchangeably, they can have distinct meanings in Dubai. A commercial license typically refers to the broader category that encompasses various trading activities, allowing businesses to engage in the sale and distribution of goods. On the other hand, a trade license may refer specifically to the licensing of trading activities related to a particular trade or business type. It’s important for entrepreneurs to clarify these definitions to ensure they apply for the correct license based on their specific business activities.

Difference Between Commercial and Trade Licenses in Dubai

The primary difference between commercial and trade licenses in Dubai lies in their scope and application. A commercial license covers a wide range of trading activities, including import, export, and retail, enabling businesses to operate across multiple sectors. In contrast, a trade license is usually more specific, focusing on particular trade activities and may have restrictions based on the nature of the goods or services offered. Understanding these differences is crucial for entrepreneurs, as selecting the appropriate license impacts their ability to conduct business legally and effectively in Dubai’s competitive market.

Conclusion

Understanding the difference between commercial and professional license Dubai is essential for any entrepreneur looking to establish a business. A commercial license is ideal for those engaged in trading activities, allowing for a broad range of business operations related to goods and services. In contrast, a professional license caters to individuals offering specialized services, providing the benefit of full foreign ownership without the need for a local sponsor. By clearly defining your business activities and objectives, you can make an informed decision about which license suits your needs. This choice not only influences your operational framework but also impacts your potential for growth in Dubai’s dynamic market. Ultimately, selecting the right license is a crucial step toward building a successful venture in this thriving business hub.

Setting up a company? Then draft an MOA with the assistance of a legal expert. Outlining the rights and responsibilities of the partners/shareholders.

Secure Office Space:

Lease physical office space by Dubai’s regulations. Obtain a tenancy contract. It is often required for the license application.

Submit Final Documents and Pay Fees:

Compile all required documents. This includes:

  • The MOA
  • Tenancy contract, and
  • Initial approval

Submit these documents to the DED along with the applicable fees for your commercial license.

Receive Your License:

Receive your commercial license, once your application is processed and approved. Keep a copy of this document for legal and operational purposes.

Apply for Visas:

Apply for employee visas and any additional permits. This can be done after obtaining your commercial license. It is needed for your business operations.

What are the Benefits of a Professional License in Dubai?

Obtaining a professional license in Dubai comes with a range of advantages. This is especially true for individuals and businesses. The ones that are focused on providing specialized services. We share some key benefits:

100% Foreign Ownership:

Foreign investors can own their business entirely with a professional license. Even without the need for a local sponsor. It allows for greater control and independence in operations.

Access to a Diverse Market:

The strategic location of Dubai provides access to a diverse and growing market. It enables professionals to tap into a wide range of clients and industries.

Flexibility in Business Activities:

A professional license allows for a variety of business activities. This includes:

  • Consultancy
  • Healthcare
  • IT services, and more

It gives professionals the flexibility to adapt and expand their services as needed.

Simplified Regulatory Process:

Generally, the procedures for obtaining professional licenses are very straightforward. It is relatively less bureaucratic than other licenses. Thus, it is easier to start up and run a business.

Networking Opportunities:

Dubai’s dynamic business venue offers numerous networking events, trade shows, seminars, and more. Having a professional license gives a particular authenticity quotient to one’s credentials and opens the door for valuable connections.

Enhanced Reputation:

A professional license underlines the fact that you are sufficiently compliant with the regulatory bodies about your field of operation. It supports your reputation and credibility among clients and partners.

Potential for Growth and Expansion:

Professionals can explore various growth opportunities with the ability to operate freely. They also have the support of Dubai’s business ecosystem. The businesses can branch into new services or markets.

Attracting Top Talent:

The prestige associated with a professional license can help attract skilled professionals to your business. It fosters a talented and capable workforce.

Tax Benefits:

The tax-free environment of Dubai allows businesses to retain more of their earnings. It enhances profitability and enables reinvestment into growth.

Supportive Business Ecosystem:

Dubai provides a supportive infrastructure for businesses. It includes:

  • Access to modern facilities
  • Technology, and
  • A skilled workforce, all of which can contribute to your success.

How Much Does a Professional License Cost in Dubai?

The cost of a professional license in Dubai ranges from AED 10,000 to AED 15,000. However, it depends on the specific business activity. It also depends on the relevant authority. This fee includes registration costs, trade name reservations, and initial approvals.

However, additional expenses may arise from securing office space. This can vary widely based on location and size. It also varies with legal fees for drafting documents like the Memorandum of Association. The budgeting for around AED 20,000 to AED 30,000 is advisable. This covers all associated costs, including visa applications for employees if needed.

How to Get Professional License in Dubai – Steps

 

To obtain a professional license in Dubai involves a series of steps. These steps ensure compliance with local regulations. A simple guide to help you through the process:

Determine Your Business Activity:

Identify the specific services you plan to offer. This will guide your license application and help you understand any specific requirements for your chosen activity.

Choose a Business Name:

Select a suitable name for your business. It must comply with naming regulations in Dubai. Check for availability through the DED.

Prepare Required Documents:

Gather the necessary documents. It typically includes:

  • A copy of your passport and residence visa
  • No Objection Certificate from a sponsor
  • Proposed trade name registration
  • Business plan outlining your services
  • Lease agreement for your office space

Reserve Your Trade Name:

Submit your trade name for approval to the DED. This involves a small fee and ensures your chosen name is available for use.

Obtain Initial Approval:

Apply for initial approval from the DED. This step verifies that you can proceed with your business setup. It may require the submission of your business plan.

Draft the Memorandum of Association:

If you’re setting up a company, draft an MOA with legal assistance. This outlines the structure and agreements between partners.

Secure Office Space:

Lease a physical office space that meets local requirements. Obtain a tenancy contract. It is necessary for the license application.

Submit Final Documents and Pay Fees:

Compile all required documents. This includes the MOA and tenancy contract. Submit these to the DED along with the applicable fees for your professional license.

Receive Your License:

Once your application is processed and approved. You will receive your professional license. It allows you to legally operate your business.

Apply for Visas:

After obtaining your license, you can apply for employee visas and any additional permits needed for your business operations.

Capital Requirements: Setting Up Your Business

Set up your business in UAE Freezone while knowing the capital requirements. It is counted as the most important part. Let’s explore the commercial and professional license capital requirements in detail.

Commercial License: Higher Minimum Capital

The minimum capital is normally higher when taking the example of establishing an enterprise under a commercial license in Dubai. This is especially so for trading enterprises that are given a minimum capital of AED 300,000 and above, depending on the nature of the business activity conducted in that particular place. It means an amount of capital comfort for business as such that the organization can utilize in carrying out its operations and initial costs.

Professional License: Lower Minimum Capital

In contrast, setting up a business with a professional license generally involves lower minimum capital requirements. It can be operationalised with as less as AED 10,000 on a consultancy or IT services business. Thus, businessmen and freelancers have an easier time launching their ventures without the setbacks of high initial capital investment. The lower capital requirement reflects the nature of service-oriented businesses, which often have fewer physical assets to finance.

How do you Decide which License to apply for?

There are multiple ways by which you can decide on which license to select. You can seek professional guidance, and take guidance from consultants. For instance, you can also hire lawyers who specialize in business law.

Seeking Professional Guidance: Make an Informed Choice

Choosing the right license for your business in Dubai can be a crucial decision that impacts your operations and growth potential. To make an informed choice, consider seeking professional guidance. Consulting with experts who understand the nuances of business licensing can help clarify your options based on your specific business activities and goals. They can assess your needs and recommend the most suitable license type, ensuring you are well informed about the implications of each option.

Business Consultants: Streamlining the Process

UAE Business consultants can play a pivotal role in streamlining the licensing process. They possess in-depth knowledge of the local market and regulatory requirements, making them invaluable partners in your business setup journey. By working with a consultant, you can navigate the complex paperwork, secure the necessary approvals, and avoid common pitfalls. Their expertise can save you time and effort, allowing you to focus on your core business objectives while ensuring a smooth setup.

Lawyers Specializing in Business Law: Ensuring Compliance

Engaging a lawyer who specializes in business law can further enhance your decision-making process. These legal professionals can provide crucial insights into the compliance aspects of various licenses, helping you understand the legal obligations associated with each. They can assist in drafting necessary documents, such as the Memorandum of Association, and ensure that your business structure aligns with local regulations. Having legal guidance helps mitigate risks and ensures that your business operates within the legal framework from day one.

What are the different types of licenses in Dubai

Dubai offers various types of licenses tailored to specific business activities, including commercial, professional, industrial, and tourism licenses. Each license serves distinct purposes, allowing businesses to operate legally within their respective fields. Commercial licenses are primarily for trading activities, while professional licenses cater to service-oriented businesses. Industrial licenses are needed for manufacturing and production activities, and tourism licenses are designed for businesses in the hospitality and travel sectors. Understanding these categories is essential for entrepreneurs when setting up their businesses.

Is Commercial License and Trade License Same?

While the terms “commercial license” and “trade license” are often used interchangeably, they can have distinct meanings in Dubai. A commercial license typically refers to the broader category that encompasses various trading activities, allowing businesses to engage in the sale and distribution of goods. On the other hand, a trade license may refer specifically to the licensing of trading activities related to a particular trade or business type. It’s important for entrepreneurs to clarify these definitions to ensure they apply for the correct license based on their specific business activities.

Difference Between Commercial and Trade Licenses in Dubai

The primary difference between commercial and trade licenses in Dubai lies in their scope and application. A commercial license covers a wide range of trading activities, including import, export, and retail, enabling businesses to operate across multiple sectors. In contrast, a trade license is usually more specific, focusing on particular trade activities and may have restrictions based on the nature of the goods or services offered. Understanding these differences is crucial for entrepreneurs, as selecting the appropriate license impacts their ability to conduct business legally and effectively in Dubai’s competitive market.

Conclusion

Understanding the difference between commercial and professional license Dubai is essential for any entrepreneur looking to establish a business. A commercial license is ideal for those engaged in trading activities, allowing for a broad range of business operations related to goods and services. In contrast, a professional license caters to individuals offering specialized services, providing the benefit of full foreign ownership without the need for a local sponsor. By clearly defining your business activities and objectives, you can make an informed decision about which license suits your needs. This choice not only influences your operational framework but also impacts your potential for growth in Dubai’s dynamic market. Ultimately, selecting the right license is a crucial step toward building a successful venture in this thriving business hub.

title: Why Hamriyah Freezone (HFZ) for Company Formation
content:
The United Arab Emirates has become a major economic center in the world, and its free zones network is an integral component of that achievement. The Hamriyah Free Zone (HFZA) in Sharjah is one of the best places for entrepreneurs and investors to start their firms quickly and easily with low-cost options.

HFZA has a great value proposition due to its great location, exceptional facilities, and standards that are beneficial for investors. This post will discuss the benefits of company formation in the Hamriyah Free Zone, how easy the process is, and how professional assistance can make the process even easier.

Why Do You Choose Hamriyah Free Zone for Company Formation?

The Hamriyah Free Zone was set up to create an interesting and varied business and industrial community. Due to its distinctive geographical position and vast range of services, it is a preferred option for many enterprises.

Geographical Position and Connectivity:

HFZA is located on the coast of the Gulf Ocean in Sharjah. It has a water port and a submerged harbor that is seven meters deep. It provides businesses with a direct connection with global sea routes, making it a great place to base their trading, import, and export activities. 

Also, its location near Sharjah International Airport and robust road networks make it easy to get to all the other Emirates and significant global markets. This transportation benefit is an important factor why enterprises in the maritime, oil and gas, and logistics sectors want to be here.

Full Ownership and Repatriation for Foreigners:

The fact that you are allowed to maintain foreign ownership is one of the best things about the company formation in Hamriyah Free Zone. It implies that you can start and run your own business without a local partner or sponsor. Additionally, without any limits on profits, repatriation, and funds, you have full power and freedom over your revenue and business.

Tax Breaks and Customs Perks:

Businesses that work in the Hamriyah Free Zone get a lot of important financial benefits. Some of these are:

  • No personal income taxes at all.
  • No import or export duties at all.
  • Goods and services in the free zone are not required to pay VAT.

These favorable tax rules make it possible for enterprises of all sizes to compete and make money.

Advance Infrastructure and Outstanding Amenities:

HFZA has a strong and up-to-date infrastructure that can fulfill several corporate needs. Entrepreneurs can select from several customizable and adaptable options, such as serviced desks and corporate offices for small firms and entrepreneurs.

Pre-built warehouses in different sizes that are great for storage, producing goods, and transportation. Leased industrial property for larger initiatives and buildings made just for you. The free zone also has reliable phone service, a steady supply of electricity, and full security, which makes sure that everything runs smoothly and efficiently.

Simplified and Quick Setup: Seamless Company Formation

Hamriyah Free Zone company formation has made the process easy, quick, and feasible. If you have the proper help, you can get your business license and company papers in only a few days.

There are a few important steps that are usually part of the process:

Business Consultation and Planning:

The initial step is to consider what your firm intends to do, what kind of legal structure it requires, and what kinds of facilities it will need. At this point, a professional service like Connect Freezone may provide huge assistance in choosing the optimal license and package for your needs. They will also help you write a simple business plan and other documents.

Submitting and Approving Documents:

You will need to send in a few important papers after you have selected your company’s activity and legal structure. These usually include:

  • A filled-out application form. 
  • Passport copies of every owner and the manager.
  • If you live in the UAE, you need a No Objection Certificate from your existing sponsor.
  • A proper business plan or organization profile.

The HFZA team or your company setup consultant will take care of the submission while following up with the right people to get initial approval.

Issuing Licenses and Lease Contracts:

Once you have first approval, you will need to pay the fees. After that, the Hamriyah Free Zone Authority will issue your business license, incorporation certificate, and leasing agreement for the place you want to rent. In numerous cases, it can happen quite quickly, even in one day.

Corporate Bank Account and Workers’ Visa:

Now that your business is properly registered, you can apply for visas for employees or investors. The steps include getting security clearance and registering for medical screenings and an Emirates identification card. You can also open a business bank account with a domestic or foreign bank in the UAE at the same time.

Hamriyah free zone company formation is easy to establish and provides numerous benefits, but new enterprises should be aware of potential issues and risks. It takes a lot of work and, in many cases, competent assistance to get through difficulties.

Business Licensing and Activity Limits:

Choosing the right company license and ensuring you comply with its regulations is one of the most prevalent issues. The free zone has permits for businesses, industries, and services, but each one has distinct rules.

For example, a company in a free zone can’t sell items directly in the UAE mainland market; it needs a local distributor or agent to do that. If you don’t understand these regulations, you could have trouble complying with them.

Visa and Staffing Restrictions:

The size of a workspace or facility frequently determines how many workers’ visas it can sponsor. New businesses with lower office packages may not get as many visas as they need, which might make it harder for them to grow their crew. To get around this problem, it’s important to plan forward for future staffing demands.

Hidden Expenses and Administrative Issues:

Even though the initial startup costs are reasonable, business owners should also think about subsequent costs, such as license renewal fees, visa processing fees, and audits that are required. 

Even though the process is quick, it still requires a lot of paperwork and government clearances. It might take a long time for people who don’t know the rules in their area. Unexpected administrative delays or hidden expenses could impose a burden on startup funding and slow down operations.

How Connect Freezone Can Assist You with Company Formation in HFZA

While the process of company formation in Hamriyah Free Zone is streamlined, navigating the legal and administrative requirements can still be a challenge, especially for first-time entrepreneurs. Due to these complexities, a professional business setup partner like Connect Freezone proves invaluable. They can provide expert assistance and personalized solutions, fast and hassle-free setup, and comprehensive support.

FAQs

Q1. What makes Hamriyah Free Zone attractive for businesses?

It offers 100% foreign ownership, tax exemptions, and access to international markets via ports and airports.

Q2. What type of companies can I form in the Hamriyah Free Zone?

You can set up Free Zone Establishment (FZE), Free Zone Company (FZC), or branches of local or foreign companies.

Q3. How long does it take to set up a company in the Hamriyah Free Zone?

Business setup can be completed in a few days, depending on documentation and approvals.

Q4. What are the key business activities available?

Trading, manufacturing, services, consultancy, and logistics are among the most popular.

Q5. Do I need office space to start in Hamriyah Free Zone?

Yes, companies must lease an office or flexi-desk to operate legally.

Company formation in Hamriyah Free Zone is an ideal setting for businesses to grow, as the environment is always changing and lucrative. Its beneficial location, tax breaks, and the fact that the foreigners fully own the business are all significant incentives for new and established businesses. 

You can easily and confidently go through the process of starting a business with the help of a competent service provider like Connect Free Zone. You may swiftly and easily start your business with their fast setup services, professional advice, and full assistance. It will set you up for a prosperous future in one of the world’s most dynamic financial markets.

title: Comparison of the cheapest free zone in UAE for business setup
content:
If you’re looking for the cheapest free zone in UAE to stablish your company, you have to consider several factors. The UAE is one of the best places to start a business, so starting operations here may be the best decision you can make.

In this article, you’re going to learn everything you need to know about the best places to invest based on your economy. In addition, you can find out more about the benefits that all of these free zones give to you. Let’s observe:

  • Why should you be interested in knowing the cheapest free zone in UAE?
  • International Free Zone Authority (IFZA)
  • Ajman Media City Free Zone (AMC FZ)
  • Sharjah Media City Free Zone (SHAMS)
  • Khalifa Industrial Zone Abu Dhabi (KIZAD)
  • Ras Al Khaimah Economic Zone (RAKEZ)
  • How can Connect FZ help you establish your business in a Free Zone?

1. Why should you be interested in knowing the cheapest free zone in UAE?

Free Zones have been gaining popularity among investors for the past few years. They offer several benefits for business owners and you may already know it. You get access to a lot of infrastructure and get plenty business support.

However, since there are more than 40 Free Zones in the UAE, you must be wondering which one could be the best for you. For this reason, you may be looking for the cheapest free zone in UAE to start your business.

By knowing the best places where you can invest your money you can get an outstanding revenue. In addition, you can save some money and start entering a new promising market that could give you more incomes.

1.1 Why do investors opt for Free Zones?

Free Zones in the UAE are a popular choice for business owners and investors. There are several reasons for this which are the following:

  • 100% ownership: one of the most outstanding benefits for business owners is that they get 100% ownership of the business entity. When it comes to Mainland business you don’t get this benefit.
  • Tax-free environment: dealing with taxes could be a big headache for investors. With a Free Zone Company, you don’t have to worry about this.
  • Secure banking system: since you’re investing tons of money you want your income to be safe.
  • Fast and easy business setup: you don’t have to deal with long and tedious processes to set up a company in a Free Zone.
  • World-class infrastructure: you can carry out your business operations in top place. In addition, you get access to a variety of options.
  • Business set-up cost: it’s one of the most important benefits. You can find a few cost-effective Free Zones to set up your business. You can run your operations profitably thanks to this.

As you can see, you can get the cheapest free zone license in Dubai and start taking the most out of your expansion.

Learn more about how you can get your renewable business license in Abu Dhabi.

2. International Free Zone Authority (IFZA)

The International Free Zone Authority, also known as IFZA, is the cheapest free zone in UAE. It’s considered a highly cost-effective place to start your business.

2.1 What are the benefits of establishing a business in IFZA?

When you’re considering obtaining a Free Zone license UAE you have to think in setting your business in IFZA. There are several benefits you can get in this place which are the following:

  • Company incorporation in a quick and easy manner
  • Possibility to carry out a vast range of business activities
  • Get 100% ownership
  • Set up an LLC (Limited Liability Company) and add the suffix to your company name
  • It’s not necessary to have an office space to set up a business
  • Share capital requirement not needed
  • There are no restrictions when it comes to foreign currency

2.2 What are the main characteristics of IFZA?

  • Wide range of office solutions for your business
  • You can carry out 7 business activities with one license
  • You can sell your products and goods online with your trade license
  • Save in annual audits

Learn more about how you can start your own salon in Sharjah.

3. Ajman Media City Free Zone (AMC FZ)

In the Ajman Media City Free Zone (AMC FZ) you can get the cheapest free zone license in Dubai. You can start any type of business in this place and you can get your license at lower costs.

If you’re a business owner that is looking for flexibility you have to consider the AMC FZ to start. You have no limitations regarding the type of company. In fact, this is one of the best benefits you can get in this place.

3.1 What are the best characteristics of the Ajman Media City Free Zone?

Perhaps you’ve never heard of this place before and you’re not sure why you should consider it. Before making a crucial decision of establishing your business you must have enough knowledge about the place.

  • Incorporation time: if you want to set up your business in this place, you’ll get a fast solution. The average incorporation time is 2 weeks.
  • No physical office space required
  • Business people and individuals can both carry out the company formation easily

3.2 Why is the Ajman Media City Free Zone attractive for investors?

As you know, each Free Zone has its own benefits. In the Ajman Media City Free Zone you get the following advantages:

  • Registration process that won’t take long time and that is simple
  • You can get your License fast (Estimate issue time: 2 days)
  • You can carry out multiple business activities with one license
  • 100% profit repatriation
  • You get 100% ownership of your business

Learn more about how to set up your business in Umm Al Quwain.

4. Sharjah Media City Free Zone (SHAMS)

The Sharjah Media City Free Zone, also known as SHAMS for its initials, is also a cheapest free zone in UAE. The best news for business owners is that they can find business packages at low cost in this place.

New entrepreneurs can find outstanding opportunities in SHAMS as well as existing business owners. They can choose the business activity and get the professional license at a fair price. For this reason, the Free Zone license UAE is best suited for professionals.

4.1 Why is SHAMS a great place to set up your business?

You can get your license in this place to start working legally and at a lower cost in comparison to other Free Zones. Some of the best benefits of SHAMS are the following:

  • You’ll only have to wait 3-5 business days for incorporation
  • Access to several kinds of facilities such as flexi-desk, dedicated desk, shared office and dedicated office.
  • Although it is known as a media zone you also have a broad list of activities to choose from (120 activities in total)
  • It’s an affordable Free Zone since fees start from lower prices. The fees increase based on the number of visas
  • You can register your company in a week and do it remotely. So, it doesn’t matter if you’re abroad

Learn more about how to set up your offshore business in the UAE.

5. Khalifa Industrial Zone Abu Dhabi (KIZAD)

When you’re planning on stablishing your company in the cheapest free zone in UAE you have to consider the Khalifa Industrial Zone Abu Dhabi (KIZAD). It’s one of the emerging zones in the UAE that offers outstanding benefits to business owners.

title: How to Set Up a Construction Company in Dubai
content:
In Dubai, investors and entrepreneurs from all over the world can obtain the opportunities they need to establish their businesses. And this location is favorable for many types of industries, including the construction sector, which has recently shown unprecedented growth. Therefore, many foreign investors like you desire to set up their construction companies in Dubai and achieve their goals successfully.

In this article, you will learn everything about the business setup process to establish a construction company in this emirate. More precisely, we will explain what you must know about the steps of the process, the approvals it requires, etc. In addition, you will also learn how to successfully become a contractor and seize business opportunities in this UAE emirate. Let us observe:

  1. What is a construction company in the UAE?
  2. How can you start your company in the UAE?
  3. How can you become a contractor in Dubai?
  4. What are the business opportunities for a construction company in UAE?
  5. What are the UAE required approvals for setting up a construction company?
  6. How can Connect FZ help you set up your construction company in Dubai?

1. What is a construction company in the UAE?

Due to the thriving economy of this country, construction companies in the UAE of all sizes have guaranteed success. As a matter of fact, you can find some of the best construction companies in the world in this country. And among the services that these companies provide, you will discover services in several sectors, including the following:

  • Infraestructure.
  • Transport.
  • Building.
  • Oil and natural gas plant construction.
  • Mining.
  • Trading and manufacturing.
  • Automotive.
  • Hospotality.
  • Real estate.
  • Heavy equipment.
  • Electrical.
  • Lightning.

There is a variety of projects that the best construction companies in the country can carry out. And the main factors that influence these projects can vary a lot, including complexity level, size, and location. So, if you desire to establish a construction company in this country, you need to define your area and other details. Below, we will explain how to set up your company in Dubai.

2. How can you start your company in the UAE?

As you may know, setting up a new company can be a complex and time-consuming process. And it will require you to get and/or provide a variety of documents before starting your business operations. Therefore, it is recommendable to be aware of the steps and paperwork that this process involves before carrying it out.

Below, we will briefly explain each step that the process to set up construction companies in Dubai involves, which are:

  • Choosing a suitable company structure and location.
  • Applying for a license to perform your business activities.
  • Getting the necessary building permit.
  • Obtaining the required approvals and other essential licenses.
  • Learning about the provisions and limitations.
  • Get your visa and open a bank account.

2.1. Choose a suitable company structure and location

The first step that all construction companies in Dubai must complete during the setup process is deciding on a location. In addition, they must choose a type of company structure that suits their requirements and needs in their chosen location. When it comes to location, Dubai offers two main ones; mainland and free zones. And each of these locations provides different advantages.

Keep in mind that choosing Dubai Mainland will require you to have a local sponsor. In the meantime, free zones do not require it and allow you to have 100% of foreign business ownership. On the other hand, you need to consider other features and benefits of each location and company structure before choosing.

2.2. Apply for a license to perform your business activities

To register new construction companies in Dubai, it is necessary to apply for a suitable license. And, in this case, it is mandatory to apply for a construction license, which can be obtained in any free zone. If you are setting up in Dubai Mainland, you must approach the DED (Department of Economic Development) to get the license.

A construction-related business will need to get a license under the commercial type. However, the license and any additional approvals may differ according to the business activities you want to perform. Therefore, make sure to determine your activities before applying for a license.

2.3. Get the necessary building permit

One of the most important things you must achieve is the building permit allowance for several business activities. And keep in mind that this procedure has to be done before getting a license for your business in Dubai.

This step of the business setup process may be a bit complex in many cases. Therefore, it is recommendable to have a business partner in the UAE who can help you complete this process. This way, you can easily overcome this challenging task and obtain all the licenses and approvals you require.

2.4. Obtain the required approvals and other essential licenses

Apart from the construction license, setting up your construction company in Dubai will require you to get additional approvals and certificates. Nonetheless, these elements will vary depending on whether you set up your company in a free zone or the mainland.

For example, free zone companies must have a G+1 permit. On the other hand, mainland companies will need a similar allowance. Among other necessary licenses, you will probably need a steel construction license, building maintenance license, etc. Below, we will mention some of the most vital approvals that you will need to get during the company formation process.

2.5. Be aware of the provisions and limitations

As you may know, in Dubai and other UAE emirates, construction companies must follow a number of rules and regulations. And, as we mentioned before, the government provides advanced infrastructure, lenient taxation laws, and supportive policies. With all these beneficial elements, the government looks forward to empowering construction companies in Dubai and across the country.

Nonetheless, it is mandatory to be aware of the limitations related to the construction license in this UAE emirate. Otherwise, you might make costly mistakes that can lead to penalties. For this reason, you should request consultation services to learn more about the local rules and guidelines.

2.6. Get your visa and open a bank account

As an investor or entrepreneur, getting a suitable visa in Dubai will be a requirement. It will allow you to live and work in this emirate, as well as sponsor your family members and domestic staff. And depending on your needs, you can choose between different types of visas available in Dubai.

Once you get your visa and business license, you need to open a business bank account in the UAE. Feel free to choose a local or international bank that suits your needs and requirements.

3. How can you become a contractor in Dubai?

To become a construction contractor in a location such as Dubai, you need to follow the steps we mentioned before. And with the benefits and incentives that this emirate provides, you will become a successful contractor in no time. Besides, keep in mind that this emirate has strategic plans to attract more investors and entrepreneurs like you for many purposes.

To summarize, make sure to get your construction license to start operating your construction company in Dubai or become a contractor. Also, it is essential to obtain some other permits and approvals, which we will mention below. If you seize the many business opportunities that Dubai offers, you will reach success and achieve your goals quickly.

4. What are the business opportunities for a construction company in UAE?

Among the most lucrative and successful business sectors in Dubai, you can find the construction sector. As you may know, Dubai has some of the tallest buildings in the world, such as the Burj al Khalifa. Apart from that, you will find more examples of the finest structures, like Marina 101, Burj Al Arab, and more.

And to favor the expansion of the tourism industry, the Dubai government is currently overtaking many development projects. Of course, it involves the participation of all construction companies in Dubai, including the new ones established by foreigners. Therefore, if you are looking forward to setting up a construction company, Dubai is the perfect place to do it.

5. What are the UAE required approvals for setting up a construction company?

In order to complete the business setup process, you will also need to obtain certain approvals from important government authorities. All construction companies in Dubai must get the following external approvals before starting their operations in the emirate:

5.1. Approval from Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA)

Not only construction companies in Dubai must obtain this approval but also all industrial-related companies. And the main reason is that DEWA (Dubai Electricity and Water Authority) is the entity that provides vital services.

Without water and electricity, running a construction company is simply impossible. Therefore, make sure to obtain approval from DEWA so you can cover the basic amenities that your company will need.

5.2. Approval from the Drainage and Irrigation Department

Apart from approval from DEWA for water and electricity amenities, you will need the respective approval from this authority. And with this element, you will have the necessary permit for liquid waste management, among other kinds of disposable services. Many industrial-related businesses, such as construction companies in Dubai, must get this approval in order to start operating.

5.3. Approval from the Building Department and Dubai Civil Defense Authority

This particular approval works as a clearance that determines whether construction companies in Dubai operate as per the construction regulations/norms. Once you obtain this approval, it will be easier to perform your activities in the emirate.

5.4. Additional approvals

As we mentioned before, it is a requirement to obtain a building permit during the business setup process in Dubai. And apart from the approvals and permits we have mentioned so far, you will also need these:

  • For transportation purposes, construction companies in Dubai need to get approval from the Roads and Transport Authority. This permission allows them to access the road and internal road network.
  • For telecommunication purposes, a construction company in this emirate needs a license from Etisalat.
  • Lastly, your company will also need a Completion Certificate, which will allow it to occupy the building.

6. How can Connect FZ help you set up your construction company in Dubai?

When it comes to setting up companies in the UAE, Connect FZ is your best ally during this important process. With our experience and solutions by your side, you can easily establish your construction company in any Dubai location available. And whether you choose Dubai Mainland or a Dubai free zone, our specialists will help you build your company successfully.

In Dubai, you can satisfactorily set up your construction company and operate it in any of the following free zones:

  • Dubai Airport Free Zone Authority (DAFZA)
  • Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO)
  • Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA)
  • Dubai South Free Zone (DWC)
  • Dubai Multi-Commodity Center (DMCC)

But if you desire to set up your company in another UAE location, you can choose between these emirates:

  • Sharjah
  • Abu Dhabi
  • Ajman
  • Ras Al Khaimah
  • Umm Al Quwain

Do you desire to establish your construction company in Dubai or another UAE location? In that case, you should work with our specialists, who will guide you throughout the business setup process to ensure your success. But first, make sure to contact us by sending us an email at contact@connectfz.com, or you can also call us at +971 43 316 688 to talk to one of our representatives.

title: Financial Consultancy License in Dubai: SCA Approval
content:
Dubai is one of the top-leading trade and financial hubs of the Middle East. In addition, the strategic location between the west and east makes it an ideal choice for financial consultancy businesses to carry out their activities in the region. This is why we offer you a cost-effective and hassle-free way of getting a financial consultancy license in Dubai.

In this article, we will make sure you understand the entire process of obtaining this license. Investors can conduct several activities under the financial consultant license in the UAE. Some of the activities are debt management, financial advisory services, budgeting for clients, financial planning, and more. Let us observe:

What is a Financial Advisor?

Financial advisors work with companies and individuals to achieve their short and long-term financial objectives. In addition, they assess clients’ financial necessities to assist them and make decisions about tax laws, insurance, mortgages, investments, college savings, and retirement plans.

Similarly, the solutions provided by financial advisors vary based on the type of firm, but usually, they determine your financial situation including your debts, expenses, and assets. After that, they work on identifying areas for improvement.

Further, they will ask about you and your objectives and create an assistance plan for you to reach them. That is to say, this means ensuring you have an adequate emergency fund, calculating how much you will save for retirement, helping you refinance or pay off debt, and offering tax-planning suggestions.

Likewise, they allow you to save massive amounts of money, either by providing complete investment management or by recommending specific investment opportunities.

In some cases, you can choose which services you need or want to obtain based on the type you choose. For instance, a traditional advisor may offer hands-on, personalized guidance for an ongoing fee. However, a Robo-advisor is a less expensive, automated management solution, which is best for individuals wishing to obtain assistance managing their investments.

They may use their financial expertise to:

  • Teach clients and answer inquiries about potential risks and investment opportunities.
  • Meet with clients to talk about their financial objectives.
  • Make recommendations on behalf of their clients.
  • Monitor their clients’ accounts to make changes in their investment policy.
  • Financial advisors also work with large organizations or by themselves to meet their clients’ needs. In addition, some of them provide tax advice or sell insurance.

What does a Financial Consultant Do?

As defined by the UAE regulations, a financial consultancy license in Dubai is for individuals and businesses who advise and recommend based on financial and economic research; analysis, and studies related to viability and determining the current or future values of securities.

In addition, they provide feasibility on commodity contracts and companies provided to clients in any means of communication and communication.

Similarly, financial analysis means the systematic processing of information related to the performance and position of organizations in the past, present, and future forecasts of the results of their business. Further, their securities, commodities, business, trade volumes, and price trends for the purpose of getting information to decide at the time of the financial consultation.

The established fee for capital in UAE companies formed to carry out financial consultation and obtain the financial consultancy license in Dubai is AED 1.000.000. However, the legal entities allowed to apply are:

  • A judicial entity established in the UAE as one of the structures set in Federal Law No. 8 of 1984 related to commercial companies. In addition, a natural or juristic individual being UAE or GCC national must hold 51% of the shared capital. It is subject to the principle of reciprocal treatment.
  • A branch of a foreign organization licensed under similar regulations in their own country that conduct business in the financial consultation and financial analysis. This company must have at least 5 years of experience and meet certain criteria.

What is the License Fee Structure?

There is no chance of putting a fixed amount for obtaining a financial consultancy license in Dubai and starting your consulting business without knowing the type of company involved. That is to say, the cost of this type of license varies from organization to organization.

On the other hand, it is based on various factors such as if you want to set up as a freelancer or start a company in the mainland area or in a free zone; whether you will employ workers, and whether you will make use of office space.

  • However, an LLC company in Dubai with a financial consultant license without office space and visa may cost up to AED 25,000.
  • On the other hand, a free zone company with a financial consultant license without office space and visa start from AED 12,000.

At Connect Free Zone, one of our effective approaches to assist you in establishing your activities in the UAE is to set up a free zone company with a license package involving your visa application and the use of a business entity and a coworking space.

Similarly, the DIFC region is a good free zone destination for establishing your financial consultancy business in the UAE. This is the hub for banks, financial activities, and large fund entities. Also, there are many free zones in the UAE offering financial consultancy licenses.

Consultancy License in Dubai: What Are the Requirements?

The UAE government mandates some requirements for individuals or entities looking to obtain a financial consultancy license in Dubai. They must provide the following:

  • Share capital: The business must keep the capital share of AED 1 million.
  • Shareholding: A UAE or GCC national must hold at least 51% of the shareholding area.

If it is an organization, it must have competent technical and administrative staff to perform the financial consultation business and financial analysis. Hence, they must be certified SCA consultants.

Also, the business plan is a crucial component of the process that you must draft in both languages (Arabic and English). However, let us observe the most important key factors:

  • The business plan must keep the prospective competitors as well as current competitors.
  • You must include the competition level in the business plans.
  • The business plan must include the expected market share of the applicant for the following 3 years and the market share of competitors.
  • In addition, the plan must include the analysis of demand and supply gaps related to the provided solutions.
  • The business plan must also outline the target clients.

In our agency, we excel at preparing plans for businesses for SCA and each type of organization establishment.

Under this license, What Activities are Allowed?

Certainly, the investor can perform various activities under this license to their clients.

  • They can arrange feasibility studies as well as price trends, market research, and analysis as well as future forecasts.
  • The organizations under this type of license can conduct consulting on commodities, and security as well as related contracts.
  • Investment portfolio component modeling is also allowed under this license.
  • Companies looking to obtain a financial consultancy license in Dubai carry out financial statements as well as performance analyses.
  • The companies are allowed to offer investment consulting services.
  • Volume, price analysis and decision-making on financial investments, and more.

In addition, the financial consultancy license owner provides comprehensive support to personal investors and companies with high-net-worth in diversifying their assets. They also offer financial planning and advisory services; ensuring that the business grows its finances effectively.

How to Apply for a Financial Consultancy License in Dubai?

The financial consultancy license in the UAE is obtained from onshore jurisdictions such as Mainland and Free Zone. In addition, it follows a certain process with some variations in the steps in the different business jurisdictions. However, the general application process includes the following:

  • The first step to obtaining a financial consultancy license in the UAE is to choose your business activity.
  • Get the trade name approval for your business. But you must abide by certain name specifications provided by the UAE government.
  • Choose a suitable business structure such as a Limited Liability Company (LLC), a Branch office of a foreign organization, or a sole proprietorship.
  • Prepare the application form for the company registration in the Free Zone or Mainland.
  • Provide the additional documents of the involved shareholders such as passport copies and photographs.
  • Obtain the pre-approvals from the Security Commodity Authority (SCA).
  • Submit the required fee, documentation, and required fee to the government entity in charge in order to obtain the financial consultancy license in Dubai.
  • Receive the associated organization documents such as shareholder agreement, Memorandum of Association (MoA), tenancy contract (for your office space), etc.
  • Proceed to apply for the UAE residence visa for investors.
  • Open a corporate bank account for your business.

What is the Scope of Business For Companies in this Area?

Financial consulting in Dubai has massive opportunities in this thriving and growing market. Further, the stable government, robust banking system, and pro-enterprise policies make this country an ideal destination for investors and companies to establish their operations.

There are several small and large-scale fund companies and houses established in Dubai. The financial growth and the technological improvements are making the country and its businesses improve like never before.

Therefore, the financial ecosystem of the UAE is growing to an outstanding level with digital banking, cryptocurrencies, blockchain, and more. These are some of the reasons why obtaining this license and starting a consultancy business in Dubai is one of the best decisions you can make.

Obtaining a Financial Consultancy License in Dubai?

One of our main objectives is to provide you with the most innovative solutions so you can establish your business in this beautiful country. In Connect FZ, we offer you the best pricing, packages, and discounts so you can start your financial consulting business.

Further, we also provide you with sponsorship solutions so you can easily begin your economic activities or have business setup in Mainland Dubai.

On the other hand, we understand that opening a company in a new market is a complex task; especially if you are on your own. That is why we offer you our experience and expertise to help you set up your organization in a hassle-free way.

With us, you will access the best locations for your financial consulting business; while ensuring you obtain all the benefits the different jurisdictions have. In the same vein, we also compare free zones’ regulations, rules, and prices regarding your organization’s PRO solutions.

Would you like to receive assistance to obtain a financial consulting business license in Dubai and the UAE? If you want to take your business to another level you can reach us at +97143316688. Or you can write us an email at contact@connectfz.com.
