title: Dubai Dependent Visa: Cost, Processing Time, Requirements
content:
Moving to Dubai can be the perfect life decision since it can grant access to a variety of benefits, opportunities and booming sectors for entrepreneurs. However, most people prefer to travel to the UAE with their relatives. Thus, you will need to apply for a Dubai dependent visa. Employers, employees and self-employed individuals in the UAE can sponsor their dependents (spouse, children, and parents) to get a UAE residence visa.

In this article, you are going to learn about the requirements for spouse visa in Dubai, as well as who you can sponsor for a UAE Family Visa. Let’s observe:

  1. Understand the requirements for getting a family visa
  2. How can you sponsor your wife and children?
  3. Sponsoring parents by meeting the conditions
  4. Can a woman sponsor her dependents?
  5. Getting a family visa in simple steps
  6. Save money with the UAE Family Visa cost

1. Understand the requirements for getting a family visa

The rules for sponsoring dependents have changed. Employees now can sponsor their families regardless of their job titles as long as they comply with the requirements set. Similarly, holders of a Golden Visa in UAE and investors with a Trade License in Dubai can sponsor their relatives too.

Nevertheless, the Dubai dependent visa for wife requirements is a little bit stricter. This is why it is essential to determine if you are eligible.

Any man that has a valid UAE Residence Visa can apply for a visa for his or her dependents as long as they comply with the following:

  • Earn a minimum salary of AED 4,000 per month or AED 3,000 plus accommodation

However, a woman that has a UAE Residence Visa has to comply with the following requirements to be able to sponsor her husband and children:

  • Earn a minimum salary of AED 10,000 or AED 8,000 plus accommodation
  • Hold a position as a teacher, engineer or related to the health sector

1.1 See the documents you need to submit for applying for a UAE Family Visa

If you comply with the requirements, you have to gather the documentation needed to apply for the family visa:

  • Application form
  • Applicant’s passport copy and UAE Visa
  • Dependents’ passport copies
  • Dependents’ photographs
  • Medical clearance certificate for each dependent
  • Copy of company contract
  • Applicant’s salary certificate
  • Attested marriage certificate
  • Registered tenancy contract

The best news about sponsoring your spouse is that he or she can apply for a Home Business trade License in Dubai and make some extra money.

2. How Can You Sponsor your Wife and Children?

As a male expatriate, you can sponsor the following family members as per the conditions established:

  • Wife: it is necessary to submit proof of the marital relationship with an attested marriage certificate
  • Two wives: Muslim expatriates are allowed to sponsor two wives if they comply with the conditions set by ICP.
  • Daughters: an individual can sponsor unmarried daughters without any age restrictions
  • Sons: expatriates can sponsor their sons up to 25 years of age. However, sons with special needs have no restrictions regarding their age.
  • Stepchildren: a male expatriate can sponsor her stepchildren as long as he submits a NOC from the biological parent and complies with the conditions established by the GDRFA.

When it comes to babies born in the UAE, the parent has to apply for a residence visa within 120 days of his or her birth. Otherwise, he may receive a fine.

Also, regardless of the type of visa you hold, you can generally sponsor your wife and children. Thus, if you have a Property Visa in Dubai or any other, you can go through the process.

3. Sponsoring Parents by Meeting the Conditions

As a male expatriate, you are allowed to sponsor your parents as long as you meet the following conditions:

  • Pay a deposit for each parent that will be a guarantee since this is requested by the immigration department.
  • The applicant cannot sponsor just a single parent. He has to sponsor both parents together.
  • The applicant must submit proof that he is the sole support of his parents and that there is no one to take care of them in their home country.
  • If any of the parents have passed away or if they are divorced, the applicant must submit proof with documents that will justify sponsoring a single parent.
  • If the applicant is an employee, he must earn the minimum salary stipulated, which is AED 20,000
  • The applicant has to get a medical insurance policy for his parents that must be renewed each year and must be with the minimum coverage established for each one.

As you can see, there are several requirements to comply with for being able to sponsor parents. This is because the applicant must prove that he can earn enough money to cover his expenses and his parents’. A woman expatriate cannot sponsor her parents, unfortunately.

4. Can a Woman Sponsor her Dependents?

A female expatriate has it harder when it comes to sponsoring her family members. In addition to complying with the salary requirements, you can only sponsor your husband and your children.

In addition, if her husband can sponsor the children, she cannot sponsor them. Instead, her husband should be the one doing the process.

Nevertheless, having your family with you can help you grow. For example, you can get a cafeteria license in Dubai and start a family business in the UAE.

5. Getting a Family visa in simple steps

Getting a spouse visa in UAE is a very straightforward process. The UAE spouse visa processing time will not take long, but once you get your visa, you have 60 days to apply for the UAE Family Visa.

First, you must apply for an entry permit, whether online or in person at the GDRFA. After they receive it, they can travel to the UAE and you can continue with the process, by submitting the visa application at the GDRFA of the Emirate where you are residing.

6. Save money with the UAE Family Visa cost

Applying for a dependent visa Dubai means that you will have to pay some fees to get the documentation. Nevertheless, it is important to point out that the cost will depend on the type of visa you are applying for.

Some of the fees for a UAE Family Visa are the following:

  • Registration file: AED 268.90
  • Tasheera (wife/children): AED 488.90 if they are outside the UAE and AED 1,138.90 if they are inside the UAE.
  • Tasheera (parents): AED 488.90 if they are inside the UAE
  • Medical test fee: AED 322.50
  • Emirates ID: AED 250 for one-year validity, AED 350 for two-year validity, and AED 450 for three-year validity

If you want to learn more about how to get a Dubai dependent visa, you can visit our blog to find more details about the different types of visas, such as the benefits you get with a Golden Visa or the multiple-entry tourist visa.

  • The applicant has to get a medical insurance policy for his parents that must be renewed each year and must be with the minimum coverage established for each one.

As you can see, there are several requirements to comply with for being able to sponsor parents. This is because the applicant must prove that he can earn enough money to cover his expenses and his parents’. A woman expatriate cannot sponsor her parents, unfortunately.

4. Can a Woman Sponsor her Dependents?

A female expatriate has it harder when it comes to sponsoring her family members. In addition to complying with the salary requirements, you can only sponsor your husband and your children.

In addition, if her husband can sponsor the children, she cannot sponsor them. Instead, her husband should be the one doing the process.

Nevertheless, having your family with you can help you grow. For example, you can get a cafeteria license in Dubai and start a family business in the UAE.

5. Getting a Family visa in simple steps

Getting a spouse visa in UAE is a very straightforward process. The UAE spouse visa processing time will not take long, but once you get your visa, you have 60 days to apply for the UAE Family Visa.

First, you must apply for an entry permit, whether online or in person at the GDRFA. After they receive it, they can travel to the UAE and you can continue with the process, by submitting the visa application at the GDRFA of the Emirate where you are residing.

6. Save money with the UAE Family Visa cost

Applying for a dependent visa Dubai means that you will have to pay some fees to get the documentation. Nevertheless, it is important to point out that the cost will depend on the type of visa you are applying for.

Some of the fees for a UAE Family Visa are the following:

  • Registration file: AED 268.90
  • Tasheera (wife/children): AED 488.90 if they are outside the UAE and AED 1,138.90 if they are inside the UAE.
  • Tasheera (parents): AED 488.90 if they are inside the UAE
  • Medical test fee: AED 322.50
  • Emirates ID: AED 250 for one-year validity, AED 350 for two-year validity, and AED 450 for three-year validity

If you want to learn more about how to get a Dubai dependent visa, you can visit our blog to find more details about the different types of visas, such as the benefits you get with a Golden Visa or the multiple-entry tourist visa.

title: Know about the difference between Free Zone and Mainland Visa?
content:
Most investors from all around the world choose the UAE as their ideal country to trade and do business. Although there are many reasons for it, the main one is that this place offers a variety of options. For example, the visa eligibility depending on the jurisdiction they choose. But it is important to know the difference between freezone and mainland visa before setting up.

In this article, you will learn everything you should know regarding your visa options according to the location you select. Besides, you’ll discover all you need to learn about the differences between a free zone company and a mainland company. Subsequently, you will be able to make the right choices to satisfy your business needs. Let’s observe:

What is a Visa in the UAE and Why Do you Need it?

Before learning the difference between freezone and mainland visa, you need to know what exactly a visa is. This is a legal document that allows foreigners to live and work in a specific country or location. In the case of entrepreneurs and investors, a certain type of visa allows them to reside and run their businesses.

In the UAE, there are two main types of visas for foreign businesspeople; the free zone visa and the mainland visa. Both have similar functions, but their main difference is that one is for free zones and the other one for the mainland. However, both of these visas also provide benefits for those who desire to set up their business in the country.

For instance, one of the benefits of these visas is that the visa holder can get other visas for dependents. On the other hand, you must know that it is mandatory for foreigners to have this document. Otherwise, they could face several legal issues and penalties, which evidently won’t benefit them.

Additionally, it is essential to know the rules that visa holders must follow in order to avoid legal issues. For example, they have to be aware that this document needs a renewal process after a determined time. In the case of free zone visas, they need to renew them every three years.

What are the Differences Between a Free Zone Company and a Mainland Company?

As we mentioned before, the main difference between freezone and mainland visa is that each works for a different jurisdiction. For instance, the mainland visa works for setting up in different emirates with a mainland location, such as Dubai. On the other hand, a free zone visa is for setting up in any of the 45 available free zones.

Now, you should also know the differences between a free zone company and a mainland company. Both types of company formation have their own structure and benefits, and knowing them is essential. Therefore, we should take a look at the differences between these two types of companies that you can set up:

  • Mainland companies can do business anywhere across the country. But free zone companies can only trade within their jurisdiction. However, they can trade across the UAE through a distributor or local agent.
  • Another difference is the employment visa mainland and freezone. For a mainland company, it is only valid for two years. And for a free zone company, this visa is valid for three years.
  • A mainland company requires a local sponsor that holds 51 percent of shares. While the owner holds the remaining 49 percent. But free zone company owners can hold 100 percent of shares without requiring a local sponsor.
  • Visa requirements are also different according to the company structure. For a mainland company, there are no restrictions to issue visas for its employees. And for a free zone company, it needs a smart office package that offers two visas. Nonetheless, it is possible to get more visas by renting out a physical workplace.

There are many other elements that these structures don’t have in common. For example, there might a difference between freezone and mainland license. Nonetheless, you can ask a specialist in any case.

How Can You apply for a visa in a free zone in the UAE?

Another difference between freezone and mainland visa could be the way in which you obtain them. You need to follow five main steps in order to obtain a free zone visa in the UAE. Firstly, you need to register for e-channel services, which is an online platform that the government designed. With this platform, the application process is much easier and more transparent too.

After registering, it is necessary to apply for an entry permit and activate it by changing its status. The entry permit is a temporary visa that is valid for 60 days. Changing its status to activate is vital for getting your full visa afterward. And after completing these steps, you can continue and move on to the next one; completing your medical fitness test.

When your medical test is done, you will be able to register for getting an Emirates ID card. This element is important since it will allow you to open your bank account and complete other vital processes. And lastly, you need to complete the residence visa stamping process to finish the entire application process.

How to Apply for a Visa to Setup a Mainland Company in UAE?

If you want to apply for a mainland visa Dubai, it is important to understand the process and its steps. First, take into consideration that this process is issued by the UAE labor law. On the other hand, the application process for a free zone visa follows certain rules made by the free zone authorities.

Although that counts as a difference between freezone and mainland visa, the process itself is very similar. All you need to do is to follow these four main steps:

  • Register online for e-channel services.
  • Apply for your entry permit.
  • Complete your medical fitness test.
  • Obtain your Emirates ID card.

To summarize this section, you first need to understand the employment visa mainland meaning to start the process. But you can request professional help to understand and complete the entire application process in no time.

In the UAE, What are the Benefits of a Freezone Visa?

There are many Dubai free zone visa benefits for employee and also for company owners and investors. For example, one of the most outstanding advantages that it offers to investors is 100 percent of ownership of their businesses. Nonetheless, there are many other benefits and you can see each of them right here:

  • Tax exemption from import, export, and personal taxes. Besides, there is also a full exemption from corporate tax for a determined period of time (and it can be renewed).
  • This license allows investors to open their corporate bank account and access many other financial services to cover their needs.
  • You can also know if your freezone visa is limited or unlimited, however, this is not exactly the correct term. After getting your visa, it will be valid for three years and you can renew it after those three years.
  • After getting your visa, you will be able to carry out other important processes. For example, it allows you to apply for a driving license.
  • Visa holders can also access healthcare services and take out their health insurance if they need it.
  • It is important to know how to check free zone visa in Dubai. And luckily, you can easily check your application validity on the General Directorate of Residency and Foreign Affairs of Dubai.

If your dependents Need Visas, What Should You Do?

Once obtaining their visas, investors can also apply for additional visas for their dependants, including spouses and children. Furthermore, it also allows them to get visas for their domestic staff (maids and drivers) if they require it. But in order to do this, investors will need to have a salary certificate.

There is a minimum salary that is necessary to have to obtain these additional visas. And although it could vary, the usual minimum amount is AED 7,500. On the other hand, it is also essential to pay a certain fee when applying for these documents. This is a security deposit of AED 3,000, and in the case of women, it is AED 5,000. Make sure to contact a specialist to confirm the steps of the application process.

Additional Information About the Employment Visa Available in the UAE.

You must know that there is another difference between freezone and mainland visa, which is visa eligibility. Compared to a mainland company, there are certain restrictions that a free zone company setup has regarding visa eligibility. Usually, the number of visas varies (from 1 to 6), but it depends on the chosen package.

As for mainland companies, there are no restrictions, but the number of visas will depend on the workplace area. In other words, the bigger their work premises, the more visas they can issue. As for the visa cost, it will mostly depend on the exact location and the business license. For example, a visa for a commercial license costs AED 30,000 and AED 27,000 for a UAE professional license.

How can Connectfz help you get more information about the available visas in the UAE?

Now that you are aware of the difference between freezone and mainland visa, you can get your business started. The first thing that you should do is requesting better guidance provided by professionals such as our Connectfz team. This way, you will be able to set up your company quickly and without spending too much effort or resources.

Requesting our services equals getting a significant improvement in your business setup and also a variety of benefits. For example, you can get the best advice to choose the most suitable options for your kind of business. This includes choosing your location or jurisdiction, your licenses, packages, and many other elements.

In addition, you have the opportunity to make your company more efficient by improving its operations effectively. And this is possible due to other services that we offer to improve your company, such as HR consultancy. Some other support services that you can request are banking services, payroll, staff outsourcing, and many more.

Would you like to contact Connectfz to learn more relevant information about the free zone visas and mainland visas for foreign investors in the UAE? If you have any questions, call us on +97143316688. You can email us at info@connectfz.com, and you will talk to one of our representatives who will answer your questions.

title: Discover what is a free zone business license in Dubai UAE
content:
Selecting a suitable free zone as your business location is the first step to set up a company. However, it is important to take into consideration the licenses that are available in that location. For instance, if you want to open your company in Dubai, make sure to check on the free zone business license in Dubai UAE.

In this article, you will learn everything you should know about the most popular business licenses in Dubai free zones. Besides, you will be able to find a detailed comparison between these free zone business licenses. After analyzing each option, you can select the license you need to cover your activities. Let’s observe:

  1. What is a free zone business license in the UAE?
  2. Which business licenses are available in Dubai free zones?
  3. A brief comparison between the available free zone business licenses in Dubai.
  4. How can investors apply for any of these business licenses in Dubai?
  5. What documents will you need to complete the license application process?
  6. Tips to select the free zone and the business license that you need.
  7. How can Connectfz help you to obtain a free zone business license in this emirate?

1. What is a free zone business license in the UAE?

If you desire to start a business in this country, and specifically in a free zone, you’ll need this element. A free zone business license in Dubai UAE is a required legal document that allows investors to operate a company. Therefore, it is a key element you should obtain before opening your business.

Besides, you may have to face certain difficulties and legal issues if you don’t obtain it before running a business. Also, you will have many restrictions and additional fees to pay as penalties for not having a proper business license. On the other hand, you can get many benefits by having a business license for your company.

Nonetheless, it will be always important to take a look at all options before making a decision. The main reason for this is that there are many available licenses, but you must know what each license offers. Therefore, keep reading this article to find more information about the available licenses in Dubai free zones.

1.1. What benefits can you obtain from having a business license in Dubai?

If you are interested in the advantages of business licenses, you should know about them. Here’s a list of some benefits of a free zone business license in Dubai UAE:

  • Business licenses allow you to trade within the country and, in some cases, internationally.
  • Depending on the business license you choose, you’ll be able to trade a larger number of goods (general trading license).
  • The application process is for obtaining these licenses, and it’s a simple and fast process.
  • Each license can cover a wide range of business activities related to the chosen sector or type of business.

1.2. What benefits do free zones in Dubai offer to investors like you?

Besides getting advantages with a license, you can also get some others just by setting up in a free zone. For example, if you decide to set up your company in Dubai, you’ll be able to enjoy these benefits:

  • You can have 100 percent of ownership of your company.
  • There is a full exemption from corporate and personal tax.
  • Similarly, there is a total exemption from import and export customs duty.
  • Investors can also enjoy 100 percent of repatriation of profits and capital.
  • Also, they can have access to world-class infrastructure and advanced facilities (which include warehousing services, office space, and more).
  • There is access to a large pool of talent in all locations. In other words, investors can easily find and hire high-qualified professionals as employees.
  • Building a company and doing business in Dubai is easy due to the business-friendly rules and regulations.

Here you can learn about the new resolution that the UAE government issued to reduce tax penalties in the country.

2. Which business licenses are available in Dubai free zones?

Depending on the location you choose, you’ll find several types of free zone business license in Dubai UAE. Each of these business licenses is available in most free zones in this emirate. But you may also find other types of licenses in certain business locations. For now, let’s see the most common licenses available in Dubai free zones:

2.1. Commercial or trading license.

This license allows investors to carry out commercial, industrial, and consulting activities within the free zone. Besides, it’s also an authorization to carry out other business activities, including exporting, importing, selling products, and many more. In addition, you can obtain other licenses under a commercial license, like a general trading license.

2.2. General trading license.

As we mentioned before, you can obtain this type of license under a commercial license. The main difference between these licenses is that a general trading license allows you to trade more products. Besides, it also provides the advantage of trading different kinds of products at the same time.

2.3. Industrial license.

In this case, an industrial license will allow you to carry out industrial-related business activities. For example, if you want to set up a factory, you’ll need this free zone business license in Dubai UAE. Among the activities that this license covers, you can find importing raw materials to manufacture goods.

2.4. Professional license.

As for this type of license, you can apply for it if you want to offer individual services. For instance, it allows you to carry out consultancy services as an individual service provider. Besides, many other professionals can apply for it, including artists, lawyers, educators, doctors, and many more.

2.5. Service license.

On the other hand, this one is for those companies that provide different kinds of services within the free zone. For instance, this type of business license is for business consultancy agencies, shipping companies, freight forwarding businesses, and many others. However, keep in mind that your license will specify your activities.

2.6. Other business licenses available in Dubai free zones.

Under one of these licenses, it is possible to apply for another free zone business license in Dubai UAE. For example, you can apply for a restaurant license, a software development business license, a freelancer license, etc. Make sure to find the right information before applying for a license.

Here you can learn about everything you must know about the commercial license in Dubai and how to get it.

3. A brief comparison between the available free zone business licenses in Dubai.

A free zone license UAE can have different features according to the location, and here we’ll see some of them. A vital element you should compare is the cost of each free zone business license in Dubai UAE. In some free zones located in Dubai, the costs of a business license can start from:

  • Dubai Airport Free Zone Authority (DAFZA): AED 50,000.
  • Dubai Internet City: AED 7,500 (it applies for freelancer licenses).
  • DMCC (Dubai Multi Commodities Centre): AED 50,000.
  • Dubai Media City Free Zone (DMCFZ): AED 7,250.
  • Dubai Silicon Oasis Authority (DSOA): AED 70,000.
  • Jebel Ali Free Zone Authority (JAFZA): AED 50,000.

If you desire to obtain more information, you can contact your partner or the free zone authorities. Take into consideration that these prices will vary depending on other details, such as facilities, visas, etc.

4. How can investors apply for any of these business licenses in Dubai?

Before getting started, you should know how to apply for a free zone business license in Dubai UAE. Let’s take a look at the steps that you must follow to complete the process:

  • Firstly, you must make sure to select the business activities you want to perform. After doing this, you’ll be able to choose the right license for your business.
  • Secondly, it is mandatory to submit all required documents when applying for a license. You’ll see some of them below.
  • And lastly, you must make the required payment and wait for the authorities to issue your license. After that, you’ll receive your desired license.

Here you can learn about the main reasons why you should become an entrepreneur in a country like the UAE.

5. What documents will you need to complete the license application process?

Firstly, these are the documents that you’ll need:

  • A duly filled application form that includes the company’s name.
  • A passport copy of the owner(s).
  • Colored passport-size photographs.
  • Original lease contract for the company’s registered address.
  • A permit that mentions the use of the office space.
  • And lastly, proof of paying the necessary fee for the license’s issuance.

However, remember that you might need additional documents according to your type of license and business location.

Here you can learn about the professional license available in Dubai and how to apply for this license.

6. Tips to select the free zone and the business license that you need.

Before you start operating your business, make sure to choose the options that will make your business thrive. For example, you must find a location in which you can find potential customers or the necessary conditions for it.

On the other hand, you must also select a business license that covers all activities you want to carry out. In order to do this, you will need to examine all available options first. Nonetheless, remember that you can always consult with your partner.

Here you can learn about all different types of business licenses that are available in the emirate of Abu Dhabi.

6.1. How many free zones are available in Dubai?

You will be able to find more than 20 free zones available in this popular emirate. However, you must select the one that fits your kind of business better and allows you to develop it. Let’s take a look at some of the most successful free zones that you can find in Dubai:

  • Dubai Airport Free Zone Authority (DAFZA).
  • Jebel Ali Free Zone Authority (JAFZA).
  • Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC).
  • Dubai Internet City.
  • DSOA (Dubai Silicon Oasis Authority).
  • Dubai South Free Zone (DWC).
  • Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC).
  • International Free Zone Authority (IFZA).

Remember that each of these locations may have different additional benefits and available licenses. Besides, the cost of setting up a company can also vary according to the free zone you choose. If you find a location that fulfills your requirements, it could be the best free zone in UAE for you.

Here you can learn how to apply for a trading license and a general trading license in the UAE.

7. How can Connectfz help you to obtain a free zone business license in this emirate?

Making the right choice is the key to reaching success in the short or long term. And as you can see, you will have a wide range of options to choose from when opening your business. In case you cannot make a decision easily, you can count on us to guide you during the process.

With Connectfz by your side, you can obtain the information and tips you need to make the right decisions. After selecting a free zone, you can choose between the several packages we offer, which contain licenses, visas, etc. Moreover, you’ll be able to save time and money with our services during the setup process.

After building your company, you can operate it easily with more of our support services. For example, you can develop and make improvements in your HR department with our HR consultancy services. Among other services, you can request recruitment, payroll, banking, and many other services to help your company be more efficient.

Would you like to contact Connectfz to obtain more information and tips regarding the available free zone business license in Dubai? If you have any questions, call us on +97143316688. You can email us at info@connectfz.ae, and you will talk to one of our representatives who will answer your questions.

1. What is a free zone business license in the UAE?

If you desire to start a business in this country, and specifically in a free zone, you’ll need this element. A free zone business license in Dubai UAE is a required legal document that allows investors to operate a company. Therefore, it is a key element you should obtain before opening your business.

Besides, you may have to face certain difficulties and legal issues if you don’t obtain it before running a business. Also, you will have many restrictions and additional fees to pay as penalties for not having a proper business license. On the other hand, you can get many benefits by having a business license for your company.

Nonetheless, it will be always important to take a look at all options before making a decision. The main reason for this is that there are many available licenses, but you must know what each license offers. Therefore, keep reading this article to find more information about the available licenses in Dubai free zones.

1.1. What benefits can you obtain from having a business license in Dubai?

If you are interested in the advantages of business licenses, you should know about them. Here’s a list of some benefits of a free zone business license in Dubai UAE:

  • Business licenses allow you to trade within the country and, in some cases, internationally.
  • Depending on the business license you choose, you’ll be able to trade a larger number of goods (general trading license).
  • The application process is for obtaining these licenses, and it’s a simple and fast process.
  • Each license can cover a wide range of business activities related to the chosen sector or type of business.

1.2. What benefits do free zones in Dubai offer to investors like you?

Besides getting advantages with a license, you can also get some others just by setting up in a free zone. For example, if you decide to set up your company in Dubai, you’ll be able to enjoy these benefits:

  • You can have 100 percent of ownership of your company.
  • There is a full exemption from corporate and personal tax.
  • Similarly, there is a total exemption from import and export customs duty.
  • Investors can also enjoy 100 percent of repatriation of profits and capital.
  • Also, they can have access to world-class infrastructure and advanced facilities (which include warehousing services, office space, and more).
  • There is access to a large pool of talent in all locations. In other words, investors can easily find and hire high-qualified professionals as employees.
  • Building a company and doing business in Dubai is easy due to the business-friendly rules and regulations.

Here you can learn about the new resolution that the UAE government issued to reduce tax penalties in the country.

2. Which business licenses are available in Dubai free zones?

Depending on the location you choose, you’ll find several types of free zone business license in Dubai UAE. Each of these business licenses is available in most free zones in this emirate. But you may also find other types of licenses in certain business locations. For now, let’s see the most common licenses available in Dubai free zones:

2.1. Commercial or trading license.

This license allows investors to carry out commercial, industrial, and consulting activities within the free zone. Besides, it’s also an authorization to carry out other business activities, including exporting, importing, selling products, and many more. In addition, you can obtain other licenses under a commercial license, like a general trading license.

2.2. General trading license.

As we mentioned before, you can obtain this type of license under a commercial license. The main difference between these licenses is that a general trading license allows you to trade more products. Besides, it also provides the advantage of trading different kinds of products at the same time.

2.3. Industrial license.

In this case, an industrial license will allow you to carry out industrial-related business activities. For example, if you want to set up a factory, you’ll need this free zone business license in Dubai UAE. Among the activities that this license covers, you can find importing raw materials to manufacture goods.

2.4. Professional license.

As for this type of license, you can apply for it if you want to offer individual services. For instance, it allows you to carry out consultancy services as an individual service provider. Besides, many other professionals can apply for it, including artists, lawyers, educators, doctors, and many more.

2.5. Service license.

On the other hand, this one is for those companies that provide different kinds of services within the free zone. For instance, this type of business license is for business consultancy agencies, shipping companies, freight forwarding businesses, and many others. However, keep in mind that your license will specify your activities.

2.6. Other business licenses available in Dubai free zones.

Under one of these licenses, it is possible to apply for another free zone business license in Dubai UAE. For example, you can apply for a restaurant license, a software development business license, a freelancer license, etc. Make sure to find the right information before applying for a license.

Here you can learn about everything you must know about the commercial license in Dubai and how to get it.

3. A brief comparison between the available free zone business licenses in Dubai.

A free zone license UAE can have different features according to the location, and here we’ll see some of them. A vital element you should compare is the cost of each free zone business license in Dubai UAE. In some free zones located in Dubai, the costs of a business license can start from:

  • Dubai Airport Free Zone Authority (DAFZA): AED 50,000.
  • Dubai Internet City: AED 7,500 (it applies for freelancer licenses).
  • DMCC (Dubai Multi Commodities Centre): AED 50,000.
  • Dubai Media City Free Zone (DMCFZ): AED 7,250.
  • Dubai Silicon Oasis Authority (DSOA): AED 70,000.
  • Jebel Ali Free Zone Authority (JAFZA): AED 50,000.

If you desire to obtain more information, you can contact your partner or the free zone authorities. Take into consideration that these prices will vary depending on other details, such as facilities, visas, etc.

4. How can investors apply for any of these business licenses in Dubai?

Before getting started, you should know how to apply for a free zone business license in Dubai UAE. Let’s take a look at the steps that you must follow to complete the process:

  • Firstly, you must make sure to select the business activities you want to perform. After doing this, you’ll be able to choose the right license for your business.
  • Secondly, it is mandatory to submit all required documents when applying for a license. You’ll see some of them below.
  • And lastly, you must make the required payment and wait for the authorities to issue your license. After that, you’ll receive your desired license.

Here you can learn about the main reasons why you should become an entrepreneur in a country like the UAE.

5. What documents will you need to complete the license application process?

Firstly, these are the documents that you’ll need:

  • A duly filled application form that includes the company’s name.
  • A passport copy of the owner(s).
  • Colored passport-size photographs.
  • Original lease contract for the company’s registered address.
  • A permit that mentions the use of the office space.
  • And lastly, proof of paying the necessary fee for the license’s issuance.

However, remember that you might need additional documents according to your type of license and business location.

Here you can learn about the professional license available in Dubai and how to apply for this license.

6. Tips to select the free zone and the business license that you need.

Before you start operating your business, make sure to choose the options that will make your business thrive. For example, you must find a location in which you can find potential customers or the necessary conditions for it.

On the other hand, you must also select a business license that covers all activities you want to carry out. In order to do this, you will need to examine all available options first. Nonetheless, remember that you can always consult with your partner.

Here you can learn about all different types of business licenses that are available in the emirate of Abu Dhabi.

6.1. How many free zones are available in Dubai?

You will be able to find more than 20 free zones available in this popular emirate. However, you must select the one that fits your kind of business better and allows you to develop it. Let’s take a look at some of the most successful free zones that you can find in Dubai:

  • Dubai Airport Free Zone Authority (DAFZA).

  • Dubai Internet City.
  • DSOA (Dubai Silicon Oasis Authority).

  • International Free Zone Authority (IFZA).

Remember that each of these locations may have different additional benefits and available licenses. Besides, the cost of setting up a company can also vary according to the free zone you choose. If you find a location that fulfills your requirements, it could be the best free zone in UAE for you.

title: The surge in DLD Licenses from 2021 to 2026
content:
The DLD or Dubai Land Department is in charge of constantly updating the legislation related to Dubai’s real estate business. In addition, they also promote real estate investment and the distribution of knowledge regarding this topic. The DLD since 2021 has managed to attract different people interested in investing in Dubai.

In this article, you will see all the information related to the new news related to people who invest in Dubai real estate recently. The first thing will be, to let you know the new figures for all the real estate licenses and permits that were issued. In addition, you will see all the benefits that you can have when acquiring a Dubai investor visa.

1. Know the latest news on how Dubai’s real estate business has grown

In recent years, the Dubai Land Department has reported a continued and significant increase in real estate licenses and permits when compared to previous periods. This sustained growth clearly reflects the strong and ongoing interest from investors in Dubai. As a result, the real estate market has become more competitive, which is highly beneficial for the country’s overall economic development. At the same time, there has been a noticeable rise in foreign ownership across multiple property segments.

According to official figures released by the DLD, thousands of real estate licenses and permits continue to be issued annually, maintaining high growth rates compared to earlier years. This consistent expansion highlights the strength of Dubai’s real estate sector. In parallel, overall transaction volumes within the Dubai real estate market have shown remarkable growth, reaching record-breaking values and reinforcing Dubai’s position as a global property investment hub.

This positive performance has also supported the objectives of the Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism, which confirmed that the strong real estate sector plays a key role in advancing the Dubai D33 economic agenda. The department further noted that the steady increase in license and permit applications demonstrates rising demand from real estate investors worldwide.

Experts believe this demand is driven by Dubai’s long-term growth outlook and the strong potential for attractive investment returns in the local market. Overall, these developments underline the DLD’s continued efforts to enhance its services and further strengthen Dubai’s position as one of the world’s leading real estate destinations.

1.1 Why do experts think these new investors exist?

All this increase in investors in the Dubai real estate business has made experts think a lot about the possible reasons. The conclusion they came to is that this is due to the superior lifestyle; and the low visa cost that exists in Dubai. And not only that but also its infrastructure, stability, economic growth, and regulated market. In addition, investment is granted free of income taxes and the current increase in population. These are some of the many reasons why investors have risen so high.

2. Do you know what is Dubai investor visa and its benefits?

The Dubai investor visa or also known as the partner visa in Dubai is the best opportunity for foreigners to start a business in the UAE. Also if you intend to make the best investment in the UAE, you can apply for this long-stay permit. With this, investors are allowed to work and live and sponsor their relatives so they can all move to Dubai.

In case you want to get an investor visa in Dubai; The first thing you should know is that it is only granted to people who are dedicated to buying shares in existing companies. These must have a minimum value of AED 720,000 or are creating a company that involves a capital investment of the same amount.

There are two types of investor visas, to which you can apply, which vary in the duration of the long-stay permit. The first is the one that allows you to stay in the country for three years. To obtain this visa, your investment must be at least AED 750,000; if you decide to share the investment with your spouse it must be AED 1 million. The second is the investor visa with a duration of 5 years which requires a minimum investment of 2 million AED.

2.1 What are the requirements to obtain this visa?

If you already own investments or are in the process of setting up a company in Dubai, there are certain documents that you need to submit. These are part of the investor visa application process. Next, you will see all the documents that you have to deliver.

  • Establishment card.
  • A photograph of the applicant on a white background.
  • Photocopy of the partner’s passport in the UAE.
  • The sponsor’s original emirates ID.
  • A photocopy of the commercial license is required.
  • In addition, you need a corporate bank account and provide the sponsor’s IBAN number.
  • If it exists, the member’s current UAE visa must be provided.
  • As proof of ownership interest, the Memorandum Papers (MOA) must be submitted.
  • Finally, the investor visa costs must be paid as all the additional expenses that this process entails.

2.2 Benefits of the investor visa

By having access to the investor visa, you can have access to different benefits. Next, you will see each of these in detail and thus understand why you should invest in the Dubai real estate business.

  • You are allowed to travel outside of the UAE while the visa is valid.
  • You can do business in a tax-free environment.
  • The beneficiary has access to permanent residence in the UAE.
  • You will have access to benefits provided by the government and local services.
  • You have the opportunity to participate in the growing economy of Dubai.
  • In addition, you will have the possibility to sponsor your close relatives to live with you in the UAE (parents, children, and spouses).

3. Contact Connect FZ for information on the investor visa and start investing in Dubai real estate

Dubai is considered one of the three best cities in the world. This is because it offers a very striking infrastructure and, in addition, it provides many opportunities for investors. For instance, currently, the Dubai real estate business is highly sought after and represents a great opportunity for foreigners.

In case you are interested in starting the process to obtain the Dubai investor visa; and invest in Dubai real estate business or any other, you should contact ConnectFZ. We take care of supporting you throughout the process so that you can have access to all the benefits that this visa provides. To contact us you can call us at +971 43 316 688. We also have an email that you can write to which is contact@connectfz.com.

title: DMCC Business Setup – 0% Corporate Tax, Dubai Free Zone
content:
Thinking of launching an e-commerce venture in Dubai? You’re not alone and you’re definitely in the right place. With the rise of digital shopping, Dubai has transformed into a hub for online business, and the DMCC Free Zone is leading the way. But before you rush into the world of online selling, there’s one thing you need to get the straight rules.

In this detailed guide, we’ll walk you through the exact steps, legal regulations, and hidden details that can make or break your DMCC business setup in 2025. If you’re aiming for success in the UAE’s fast-growing e-commerce market, this article will serve as your roadmap.

Why DMCC Business Setup Is a Game Changer for E-commerce in 2026

DMCC, short for Dubai Multi Commodities Centre, is more than just a free zone. It’s a fully integrated business district built for the digital economy. From tech startups to online retailers, DMCC has become the preferred choice for entrepreneurs who want flexibility, global access, and a future-proof location.

What Makes DMCC Different from Other Free Zones?

Unlike many other zones, DMCC focuses on long-term value. It doesn’t just offer cheap licenses,it builds an ecosystem around your business. In 2026, it remains one of the most trusted and well-regulated zones for launching an e-commerce company.

You get:

  • Full foreign ownership
  • Zero corporate and personal tax for up to 50 years
  • Prime location in Jumeirah Lakes Towers
  • Access to premium office solutions, logistics, and banking
  • This makes business setup in DMCC a powerful option for online sellers who want scalability and credibility.
  • Business Activities Approved for E-commerce in DMCC

Before setting up your company, you must select the business activity that matches your online business model. DMCC offers a wide range of options under its e-commerce category.

Setting Up a DMCC E-commerce Company the Right Way

Whether you’re selling physical products or offering digital services, you’ll find a business model that fits within DMCC’s structure. In this section, we explain how a DMCC e-commerce company setup works step by step highlighting the exact activities, paperwork, and compliance you need to follow.

Online Activities You Can Legally Run in DMCC

Common licensed activities include:

  • Operating an e-commerce platform
  • Online retail or wholesale distribution
  • Marketplace administration and aggregator services
  • App or software development for online platforms
  • Logistics and warehousing for e-commerce fulfillment

Choosing the right activity from the start makes the licensing process faster and avoids complications later.

Can You Sell Both in UAE and Internationally?

Yes, and that’s where DMCC’s dual licensing model comes in. As of 2026, companies can apply for a dual license through a collaboration between DMCC and Dubai’s mainland authorities. This means you can operate your online store across both the free zone and the mainland without opening two businesses.

This flexibility gives your e-commerce brand wider exposure and direct access to the UAE market.

Licensing Rules and Regulations You Must Know

Setting up your business in DMCC is relatively simple, but there are specific rules to follow to get and keep your e-commerce license active.

Naming Your Business in DMCC: Key Guidelines

Your trade name must reflect your licensed activity, and it should not mislead or violate any cultural or legal sensitivities in the UAE.

Avoid names that:

  • Use religious or political terms
  • Resemble names of existing businesses
  • Are vague about the actual nature of your operations
  • Once your trade name is approved, it’s locked in for your license.

Compliance Checklist for Online Businesses

Here’s a table outlining the current DMCC rules for e-commerce companies in 2026:

Requirement Details
Business License Must specify online trading or platform activity
Office Lease A physical presence in DMCC is required, even if it’s a flexi-desk
Domain Ownership Proof of website registration under your business name is mandatory
Secure Payments Use UAE-approved gateways like Telr, PayTabs, or Network International
Data Security Must comply with the UAE’s updated Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL)
Customs Code Needed if you import/export physical goods

Missing any of these can delay your DMCC business setup or lead to fines later.

How to Set Up Your E-commerce Business in DMCC

Now that you know what’s allowed, let’s talk about how to get your business off the ground, from picking a name to getting your visa.

Step 1: Define Your Business Model

Start by deciding what you will sell and how you’ll sell it. Will you manage your inventory or run a dropshipping store? Will you create your online platform or sell through marketplaces?

Your chosen model will guide your license type and office needs.

Step 2: Apply for a Trade Name

Submit your trade name online through the DMCC portal. The name should match your business activity and follow UAE’s naming rules. You can submit three name options, and the approval usually takes 1–2 working days.

Step 3: Submit Your Pre-Approval Documents

Once your trade name is approved, DMCC will ask for basic documents:

Passports of shareholders and manager

Proof of residential address

Brief business plan (especially if applying for a platform or aggregator license)

At this stage, your file is reviewed for initial approval.

Step 4: Choose Your Office Space

Even digital companies must lease a physical space in DMCC. The options include:

Flexi-desks (shared spaces with limited use)

Private offices (customizable workspaces)

Warehouses (ideal for inventory-based e-commerce)

Flexi-desks are the most cost-effective and popular for startups. Choosing the right office depends on your license and visa requirements.

Step 5: Finalize License and Apply for Visa

After office selection, DMCC will issue your e-commerce license. You can then proceed to open a bank account and apply for residency visas for yourself and your employees.

Your DMCC free zone business setup is now complete.

What’s New in 2026 for E-commerce in DMCC?

DMCC keeps updating its policies to meet global standards. Here are some of the most important regulatory changes you need to be aware of this year.

Mandatory UBO and KYC Filing

All DMCC companies must now submit a UBO (Ultimate Beneficial Ownership) declaration and conduct KYC reporting annually. This move is part of the UAE’s transparency drive and helps prevent fraudulent activity in the online space.

Corporate Tax and ESR Filing

From 2024 onwards, certain companies in the UAE are subject to a 9% corporate tax if they generate taxable income. In 2026, the DMCC will continue to apply this rule based on your source of income.

If your business generates profits from within the UAE and surpasses the income threshold, you must file returns accordingly.

Meanwhile, e-commerce companies involved in cross-border trade may also need to file an Economic Substance Report (ESR) depending on the nature of activities.

DMCC vs Other Free Zones: Where Should You Set Up?

If you’re comparing zones, here’s how DMCC stacks up against others like IFZA, SHAMS, and RAKEZ when it comes to launching an e-commerce business.

DMCC Offers:

  • Better reputation for global trading partners
  • Access to premium infrastructure
  • Direct ties to logistics hubs and shipping networks
  • Transparent and detailed licensing for online businesses

While other zones may offer cheaper packages, they often lack the support systems and location advantages that a business setup in DMCC Dubai brings.

Should You Work with a Business Setup Consultant?

While it’s possible to go through the process on your own, many entrepreneurs prefer working with business setup consultants in DMCC to avoid mistakes and speed things up.

A consultant can:

  • Help you select the right license activity
  • Prepare and review all documentation
  • Liaise with DMCC authorities on your behalf
  • Assist with office leasing, visa processing, and banking
  • It’s not just about convenience, it’s about setting up your business correctly from day one.

Final Thoughts: DMCC is Built for Digital Entrepreneurs

If you’re aiming to build a scalable, online-first business in the UAE, setting up in DMCC puts you in the right environment. The infrastructure, regulation, and ecosystem all work in your favor. And with updates like dual licensing and digital compliance standards, the DMCC keeps getting better for online sellers.

Getting your DMCC business setup right means you’re laying the groundwork for a sustainable, profitable e-commerce venture in one of the world’s most connected cities.

Connect FZ: The Smart Way to Launch Your DMCC E-commerce Company

Want to launch your online business without getting stuck in paperwork? Connect FZ is here to simplify every part of your journey, from trade name approval to visa stamping.

We’re not just another business setup agency. We’re the people behind hundreds of successful DMCC companies, and we know the system inside out. Our local consultants work closely with you to get your e-commerce license faster, cheaper, and without the guesswork.

Connect FZ helps you focus on what matters, your products, your customers, and your growth.

Before setting up your company, you must select the business activity that matches your online business model. DMCC offers a wide range of options under its e-commerce category.

Setting Up a DMCC E-commerce Company the Right Way

Whether you’re selling physical products or offering digital services, you’ll find a business model that fits within DMCC’s structure. In this section, we explain how a DMCC e-commerce company setup works step by step highlighting the exact activities, paperwork, and compliance you need to follow.

Online Activities You Can Legally Run in DMCC

Common licensed activities include:

  • Operating an e-commerce platform
  • Online retail or wholesale distribution
  • Marketplace administration and aggregator services
  • App or software development for online platforms
  • Logistics and warehousing for e-commerce fulfillment

Choosing the right activity from the start makes the licensing process faster and avoids complications later.

Can You Sell Both in UAE and Internationally?

Yes, and that’s where DMCC’s dual licensing model comes in. As of 2026, companies can apply for a dual license through a collaboration between DMCC and Dubai’s mainland authorities. This means you can operate your online store across both the free zone and the mainland without opening two businesses.

This flexibility gives your e-commerce brand wider exposure and direct access to the UAE market.

Licensing Rules and Regulations You Must Know

Setting up your business in DMCC is relatively simple, but there are specific rules to follow to get and keep your e-commerce license active.

Naming Your Business in DMCC: Key Guidelines

Your trade name must reflect your licensed activity, and it should not mislead or violate any cultural or legal sensitivities in the UAE.

Avoid names that:

  • Use religious or political terms
  • Resemble names of existing businesses
  • Are vague about the actual nature of your operations
  • Once your trade name is approved, it’s locked in for your license.

Compliance Checklist for Online Businesses

Here’s a table outlining the current DMCC rules for e-commerce companies in 2026:

Requirement Details
Business License Must specify online trading or platform activity
Office Lease A physical presence in DMCC is required, even if it’s a flexi-desk
Domain Ownership Proof of website registration under your business name is mandatory
Secure Payments Use UAE-approved gateways like Telr, PayTabs, or Network International
Data Security Must comply with the UAE’s updated Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL)
Customs Code Needed if you import/export physical goods

Missing any of these can delay your DMCC business setup or lead to fines later.

How to Set Up Your E-commerce Business in DMCC

Now that you know what’s allowed, let’s talk about how to get your business off the ground, from picking a name to getting your visa.

Step 1: Define Your Business Model

Start by deciding what you will sell and how you’ll sell it. Will you manage your inventory or run a dropshipping store? Will you create your online platform or sell through marketplaces?

Your chosen model will guide your license type and office needs.

Step 2: Apply for a Trade Name

Submit your trade name online through the DMCC portal. The name should match your business activity and follow UAE’s naming rules. You can submit three name options, and the approval usually takes 1–2 working days.

Step 3: Submit Your Pre-Approval Documents

Once your trade name is approved, DMCC will ask for basic documents:

Passports of shareholders and manager

Proof of residential address

Brief business plan (especially if applying for a platform or aggregator license)

At this stage, your file is reviewed for initial approval.

Step 4: Choose Your Office Space

Even digital companies must lease a physical space in DMCC. The options include:

Flexi-desks (shared spaces with limited use)

Private offices (customizable workspaces)

Warehouses (ideal for inventory-based e-commerce)

Flexi-desks are the most cost-effective and popular for startups. Choosing the right office depends on your license and visa requirements.

Step 5: Finalize License and Apply for Visa

After office selection, DMCC will issue your e-commerce license. You can then proceed to open a bank account and apply for residency visas for yourself and your employees.

Your DMCC free zone business setup is now complete.

What’s New in 2026 for E-commerce in DMCC?

DMCC keeps updating its policies to meet global standards. Here are some of the most important regulatory changes you need to be aware of this year.

Mandatory UBO and KYC Filing

All DMCC companies must now submit a UBO (Ultimate Beneficial Ownership) declaration and conduct KYC reporting annually. This move is part of the UAE’s transparency drive and helps prevent fraudulent activity in the online space.

Corporate Tax and ESR Filing

From 2024 onwards, certain companies in the UAE are subject to a 9% corporate tax if they generate taxable income. In 2026, the DMCC will continue to apply this rule based on your source of income.

If your business generates profits from within the UAE and surpasses the income threshold, you must file returns accordingly.

Meanwhile, e-commerce companies involved in cross-border trade may also need to file an Economic Substance Report (ESR) depending on the nature of activities.

DMCC vs Other Free Zones: Where Should You Set Up?

If you’re comparing zones, here’s how DMCC stacks up against others like IFZA, SHAMS, and RAKEZ when it comes to launching an e-commerce business.

DMCC Offers:

  • Better reputation for global trading partners
  • Access to premium infrastructure
  • Direct ties to logistics hubs and shipping networks
  • Transparent and detailed licensing for online businesses

While other zones may offer cheaper packages, they often lack the support systems and location advantages that a business setup in DMCC Dubai brings.

Should You Work with a Business Setup Consultant?

While it’s possible to go through the process on your own, many entrepreneurs prefer working with business setup consultants in DMCC to avoid mistakes and speed things up.

A consultant can:

  • Help you select the right license activity
  • Prepare and review all documentation
  • Liaise with DMCC authorities on your behalf
  • Assist with office leasing, visa processing, and banking
  • It’s not just about convenience, it’s about setting up your business correctly from day one.

Final Thoughts: DMCC is Built for Digital Entrepreneurs

If you’re aiming to build a scalable, online-first business in the UAE, setting up in DMCC puts you in the right environment. The infrastructure, regulation, and ecosystem all work in your favor. And with updates like dual licensing and digital compliance standards, the DMCC keeps getting better for online sellers.

Getting your DMCC business setup right means you’re laying the groundwork for a sustainable, profitable e-commerce venture in one of the world’s most connected cities.

We’re not just another business setup agency. We’re the people behind hundreds of successful DMCC companies, and we know the system inside out. Our local consultants work closely with you to get your e-commerce license faster, cheaper, and without the guesswork.

Connect FZ helps you focus on what matters, your products, your customers, and your growth.

content:
Because of its extensive commercial features, Dubai and parts of the United Arab Emirates have always attracted businessmen from all over the world. However, entrepreneurs looking to start a business in the UAE face a number of bureaucratic and legal challenges, one of which is documents clearance.

What is Documents Clearing Services?

The meaning of document clearance is easy. Document clearance simply means that in order to incorporate a company in Dubai or register a business in the UAE, a number of PRO services, certifications, and authorizations must be obtained – obtaining these authorized documents is referred to as Document Clearance.

Certifications and document clearance are determined by the type of company being launched, the number of employees appointed, the partners, their nationalities; and a variety of other factors that mitigate the need for accreditation.

Typically, governmental authorities examine business setup procedures as well as the mandatory PRO services, and judicial bodies provide approval or sanction, stating a “green signal” or a “go head”.

What are the obstacles?

Obtaining document clearance may be a difficult aspect of business setup in the UAE for foreign investors or global businessmen. It is difficult because they are unfamiliar with the UAE’s business setup guidelines, as well as the PRO requirements for company formation.

Several factors may contribute to the difficulties of getting sanctions for business setup in UAE for locals as well as international business entities. Here are a few examples:

  • Changing business laws and irregularities
  • Unusual requirements and vivid consequences
  • Currency and economic structure changes for foreign investors
  • Subjective authorizations and transnational ethics

All of these factors make getting documents cleared for starting a business in Dubai and throughout the UAE a difficult task.

What are the Consequences of not Using Document Clearing Services?

Document clearance in the UAE can be difficult for foreigners looking to invest in Dubai. Setting up a business in Dubai can present several challenges, particularly if you are not a UAE resident. However, difficulties in establishing a business in Dubai are not limited to foreigners; there are numerous restrictions for locals as well.

Here at Connect FZ, we provide the best document clearing services in Dubai. Our team of experienced professionals has over twenty years of experience and can help you register your business without any hassle. Additionally, investing in our services will provide you with the security you require to take your business to the next level.

As a result, if you are an entrepreneur looking to establish your business in Dubai, here are a few risk factors to consider:

Changing business regulations

Knowing about all of the individual laws established to fit each company type is critical, given the number of them. The UAE and all of its emirates are known for their business-friendly policies and extensive legislation. The goal of enacting these legal regulations is to ensure fair trade and business conduct.

As a responsible entrepreneur looking to start a business there, you must follow all of these regulations. Similarly, we can assist your company in ensuring that it meets all of your company’s requirements.

Currency fluctuations and economic structure

Everybody knows the United Arab Emirates for its unique economic policies and for having a strong economy. As a result, all businesses seeking to establish themselves in Dubai must adhere to the status quo and the economic structure.

The economy of Dubai is not only focused on business, but also tourism and mineral fuels, and the part of Dubai’s economy that brings all of them together is the UAE’s multi-currency empire. Thus, businesses established in Dubai must not only adhere to the economic structure, but also the legal policies governing the various currencies used in the country.

Hence, when establishing a business in Dubai, documents such as a trade license, letter of association, bank statement, and others are required. These documents will demonstrate to the authorities that you are ready to conduct multi-currency transactions in the UAE.

Subjective authorizations for your organization

There are several other activities that you must be able to perform to freely conduct business in Dubai. For example, you will need to travel, conduct national and international transactions, and have some type of documentation. In these cases, document clearing services in Abu Dhabi or Dubai can assist you in obtaining the documents required to complete those subjectively important tasks.

In this way, document clearing services in Sharjah or Dubai can assist you with this by processing live visa registration, ID registration, and bank account opening. Also, we can help you to set up a company in SHAMS Free Zone.

Dubai Mainland: advantages of Document Clearing Services

Anyone who has ever traveled for pleasure immigrated to a new country for education or work, or started a new business in a new country is familiar with the process of obtaining document authorizations and attestations. There are several legal and bureaucratic requirements you must meet.

Dubai is no exception, and the documentation process may appear daunting. There are many documentation requirements for both employers and employees, such as visa processing, medicals, acquiring dependent visas or maid visas and their medicals, pre or post-employment documentation, and so on.

Hence, many people prefer to outsource this difficult task to document clearing services companies. Here are five advantages of establishing a document clearing services business in Dubai:

You can save time

The most significant benefit of having a document clearing services company handle the entire documentation process for one is that it saves a significant amount of time. Time is similar to sand. You cannot get it back once it seeps through your hand. People in Dubai are high-functioning individuals with little time on their hands.

As a result, the majority of them prefer to set aside more time each day to devote to more important tasks, spend time with their families, or simply live more wisely. Hence, they decide to outsource this time-consuming task to a document clearing services company.

Effort

Not only is the documentation process time-consuming, but it also necessitates a significant amount of effort. An effort that a company or business can put forth to improve their core competencies or an effort that an individual can put forth to improve their personal or professional life.

As a result, many people prefer to outsource these documentation processes to experts, making establishing a document clearing services company in Dubai mainland a very profitable business.

You can avoid fines

Dubai is a city with extremely strict rules. Hence, to avoid fines, all necessary documentation should be completed on time. Document clearing services assist people in doing just that, which is why they are in such high demand.

You will be stress-free

Many foreign investors and businessmen consider Dubai Mainland to be an ideal location for establishing their operations. Every year, a large number of ex-pats relocate to this city for work reasons. Because they are dealing with a different currency and economic structure, these foreigners may find it difficult to go through the various documentation processes.

As a result, they hire a document clearing services company to do the necessary work for them.

Renewing documents

Even existing businesses and ex-pats may need to renew their licenses, visas, and other documents. Certain rule changes may also necessitate the same. As a result, document clearing services companies have a lot of room to grow in Dubai.

Document Clearing: Frequently asked questions

What is the procedure for attestation of legal documents in the UAE?

The process of legal document attestation in the UAE consists of four major steps. They are the following:

  • Notarization will take place in your home country.
  • The Ministry of Foreign Affairs in your country of origin will certify your documents.
  • The UAE Embassy or Consulate in your country of origin will perform the certification.
  • Lastly, the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs will perform the certification (MOFA).

Will I need a No Objection Certificate (NOC) to obtain a license and establish my business in the UAE?

They do not require NOC for a foreign national on a visit/tourist visa. If the person wishes to open a business and already has a resident visa as an employee designation, they require a NOC; however, if the person has an owner or investor designation visa, they do not require a NOC. Another DED regulation states that if a person wants an instant license, no NOC is required.

What documents are required to establish a free zone business in the UAE?

You must submit several documents to establish a free zone company in the UAE. They require the following general documents to establish an FZE business in the UAE:

  • A correctly completed application license form.
  • Owner’s contact information
  • Name selection for the company’s name reservation.
  • MOA was signed.
  • Copies of the business managers’ and partners’ passports

On the other hand, they require the following documents to obtain a consultancy license:

  • A copy of the degree/diploma certificate indicating the required activities, or a certificate of experience (any of these documents is a must).

These are the requirements to obtain an industrial license:

  • Existing business profile
  • Business feasibility analysis.
  • Completed the form for the investor’s project profile correctly.

The following documents are a requirement to obtain documents for branch companies:

  • A certified copy of the parent company’s registration certificate, incorporation certificate, and Memorandum and Articles of Association (MAA).
  • The first Board Resolution.
  • Original Power of Attorney (PoA) and passport copy of the legal representative

What documents they require to establish a Mainland LLC business in the UAE?

  • All shareholders and managers must have certified passport copies.
  • If applicable, a copy of the UAE residence visa.
  • A letter of no objection (NOC) from the current UAE residence visa sponsor.
  • Name suggestions for company name reservation

If the shareholder is a corporation, the documentation must include the following:

  • The shareholding company’s memorandum and articles of incorporation.
  • A board resolution authorizing the formation of a new LLC in the United Arab Emirates.
  • A power of attorney to the general manager for the formation of the new LLC.

The mandatory documents required to establish a company in Dubai will vary depending on the type of business activity, legal entity, shareholder type, and location of the company. You should note that you can contact Connect FZ to set up your business in the UAE. We will advise and assist you through each step of the company formation process.

How can I obtain local documents notarized in the United Arab Emirates?

The UAE offers both public and private notary services in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and the other Emirates. You can make appointments for notary public positions either directly or via the online notary system. In addition, please keep in mind that the systems in Dubai and Abu Dhabi are separate.

Before scheduling a physical notary appointment, the Abu Dhabi online notary system requires the relevant documents to be uploaded and approved. In some cases, you can also request that the Notary Public come to your home or private office. This is accomplished by requesting such an appointment.

The following are the general requirements for notarizing a document in the UAE:

  • You must present the original document (in Arabic or dual language text side by side).
  • The person(s) signing the document should have the necessary authority to do so, as well as provide supporting documentation and identification.
  • The document must be by UAE law.
  • Everyone who signs the document must be physically present.
  • Once the necessary documents are submitted, the notary public reviews the document witnesses its signing and verifies the identity of the signatories.

Please keep in mind that they also permit video call notarization during the current COVID travel restrictions; for more information, please contact us. We can assist you with document preparation and notarization in any of the Emirates, Dubai, or Abu Dhabi. Our business setup experts are well-versed in all business setup processes and the documents that go with them. We will be happy to assist you.

6. How can Connect FZ help you?

Submitting and obtaining approval from the necessary government agencies is a must when establishing a business in Dubai or any other Emirates. You could learn it yourself, but it will undoubtedly be time-consuming and costly. Hence, the best way to resolve this is to use the document clearing services provided by business setup service providers.

Are you wondering “where can I find document clearing services near me?“. If so, you must know that entrusting this task to professionals will save you time, allowing you to concentrate on other aspects of your business. For this reason, with us, you do not have to understand the seemingly endless fine print, learn Arabic, or rely on trial and error to get document clearance.

Let us assist you in this journey and many other legal processes in the UAE. With our value-added services, there will not be any aspect left uncovered for your business.

Get more information about document clearing services with us. Feel free to request our assistance by calling us at +971 43 316 688 or by writing down all of your concerns and sending them to us via email at contact@connectfz.com. With our document clearing services, you can rest assured you will obtain the desired results quickly.
