title: How can I check my Emirates ID renewal status?
content:
The ICA allows the Emirates ID renewal verification and also allows new applications or replacements in the UAE. Likewise, the renewal of the identification must be carried out at the same time as the residence visa process. In addition, you must renew it on time to avoid sanctions or fines from the Emirati government.

In this article, you will find a guide so that you can successfully renew the Emirates ID. You will also learn how to check Emirates id renewal status and other important details.

Emirates ID Renewal Status Easy Verification Guide

You can check Emirates ID renewal status very easily through different media. Concerning this, you can verify it through the web platform for the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security. Also, you must have the application number or PRAN or the UAE ID number at hand if it is for replacement or renewal.

Next, you will see a detailed guide so you can carry out the verification in a few steps:

Exploring the Emirates ID Renewal Status Verification

The Emirati ID is important to carry out a process such as renting an apartment or a villa among others. Consequently, you have to renew it on time and be aware of the Emirates ID renewal. Below, you will learn the simple steps you must follow to verify through the ICA:

  1. Go to the ICA website.
  2. Find and click where it says ID Card Status.
  3. Type your PRAN application number or IDN number in the slot and select Verify.

After you have completed all the steps, select continue and you will immediately receive the details of the renewal status. In the same way, you will obtain the type of request, your identification number, and the current status. Additionally, remember that the PRAN number can be found on the form you will have to request the Emirates ID.

How long does it take for Emirates ID renewal?

The process for renewing your Emirates ID is easy and will generally be done within 4 business days. However, this will depend on the particular circumstances of each applicant. In addition, after the pandemic, the system suffered a delay due to time zones and mandatory medical examinations.

Understanding Emirates ID Renewal Processing Time

From the expiration date, you will have up to 30 days to renew your Emirates ID. If you fail to do so, you will have to pay fines and apply for renewal by UAE IPC online application.

As we have mentioned before, medical examinations are slightly delayed but must be carried out at the ICP facilities. Then, when you have made the request, you will receive an SMS to authorize both the biometric and medical test.

What to Expect During Emirates ID Renewal Duration

Visa tenancy will determine the validity of the UAE ID for foreigners. Furthermore, there is a link between the ID and the Emirati residence visa. However, if you have a valid residence visa, you can apply for the United Arab Emirates identification card.

UAE ID renewal process

It is very easy to renew your Emirates ID for anyone who requires it. The only thing you have to present is the ID renewal form accompanied by the following documents.

  • The original passport
  • The old Emirates ID Card
  • Residence Visa or your Original Valid Entry Permit
  • You can Apply for the Residence Visa in the renewal process

For dependent Newborns:

  • Photo with white background,
  • The passport of the father
  • The original birth certificate or Emirates ID
  • Passport and Visa of the sponsors.

For UAE citizens:

  • Before submitting you must add the details of the newborn to the original Family Book and hand it in
  • Your original Passport
  • For dependents, a photograph with a white background, the father’s passport or the original birth certificate or Emirates ID, as well as the passport and visa of the sponsors.

Documents to be submitted by GCC nationals

  • The original passport
  • The original valid GCC ID Card
  • Proof of residence in the UAE i.e. current business trade license, employment certificate/certified employment contract, or a certificate proving that the applicant is studying in the UAE

In the case of dependents, you only need the parents’ documents and the ID Card.

Receiving Your Renewed Emirates ID Card

The last step to Emirates ID renewal online is to go pick it up. In this case, they will send you an SMS indicating that your card is ready to pick up at any Customer Service center. Moreover, you can receive your card at home through courier.

On the other hand, the renewal system is very simple but you must have all the documents at hand when you apply.

Emirates ID Renewal Timeframe Explained

The period for renewal of the Emirates ID is between 6 months and 30 days before expiration. In this case, if your Emirates ID is less than 30 days old, you will receive a fine. Also, you should know that the process differs depending on whether you are a foreign citizen or a national in the UAE.

Thus, expats can only renew their ID if they have a valid residence visa. However, the process for both expatriates and Emirati citizens is very simple.

Understanding the Emirates ID Renewal Process

Keep in mind that, as we have mentioned before, the renewal time will be different depending on the particularities of each person. However, the process they must follow is similar and generally consists of a few steps. Below you will learn in detail about the Emirates ID renewal online process and in person:

1. Register and submit the renewal form

The first step in renewing your card is to gather the documents listed above. Then, you must go to one of the government-authorized sites to continue the process. In this case, you can go to one of the following sites:

  • Dubai Customer Satisfaction Centers
  • Service centers of the Federal Identity and Citizenship Authority (ICP)
  • Typing centers in Dubai

Additionally, you can apply for ID renewal using the smart services provided by ICP or on the website. However, you will still need to go to one of the authorized centers to provide your biometric data. Regardless of the channel you use to renew the document, the authorities facilitate the entire process.

When you arrive at one of the mentioned centers, you must obtain a ticket to know your place in line. Furthermore, you will need to fill out the Emirates ID renewal application form with all your details. If you submit your form online, you will receive confirmation via SMS or email.

On the other hand, the renewal fee can only be paid in the national currency, the Dirham (AED). However, the fees differ, depending on whether the applicant is an Emirati citizen or an expatriate with a residence visa.

2. Payment of Emirates ID renewal fees

The next step to renew your ID is to pay the corresponding fees as mentioned above. Apart from nationality, rates also vary according to the selected validity period. So, the fees you need to pay for Emirates ID renewal we will detail below.

  • For UAE nationals the issuance rates are as follows:
    • 5 years validity, AED 100
    • 10 years validity, AED 200
    • The service fee is AED 40
    • The printing fee is AED 30
  • For GCC nationals the issuance rates are as follows:
    • 5 years validity, AED 100
    • The service fee is AED 40
    • The printing fee is AED 30
  • For expatriates, the renewal rates are as follows:
    • Depending on the validity period, AED 100
    • The service fee is AED 40
    • The printing fee is AED 30

Also, if you want to process the renewal at a Customer Success Center in Dubai, you can pay AED 150 for the express service.

3. Confirm your biometric data

The next step, after paying Emirates ID renewal fees, is to confirm your biometrics. Once the payment has been made, you will receive a message via SMS in which you will be informed of the status of the request. ID applicants over 15 years of age must process their biometric data.

Additionally, those who will renew their ID must go to one of the ICP centers to have their photo taken. Likewise, they must go to said centers to confirm their fingerprints.

Emirates ID renewal for nationals living abroad

Emirati citizens living abroad can also renew their Emirates ID. They can do this thanks to the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs, and Port Security and its new service. This way, they do not need to return to the country to renew the card, as they had to do according to the previous process.

In this sense, they only have to send the request through the smart application of the aforementioned authority. Also, you can apply up to 6 months before the Emirates ID expires. Moreover, the fee for this process from abroad is AED 270.

If the document expires and you have not renewed it, you will have to pay a fine of AED 20 for each day of delay. Thus, knowing the Emirates ID renewal status is essential to avoid suffering penalties.

Access to Emirates Digital ID

After the Emirates ID renewal, you can view a digital version of it. Additionally, you do not need to pay any fees to do so, although this version is no substitute for the card you should have with you. Next, we will show you what methods you can use to view the ID:

UAE Pass app

Through the UAE Pass app, you will be able to follow a simple process to view your digital ID. The steps you must follow to view your Emirates ID are as follows:

  1. First, open the app
  2. Then tap ADD DOCUMENT at home
  3. Select the Federal Identity, Citizenship, Customs, and Port Security Authority (ICP) category at the bottom.
  4. Next, tap on EMIRATES IDENTIFICATION CARD and scan your face so that the system will add your ID to the documents.
  5. In this step, you will need to select DOCUMENTS at the bottom of the screen.

Upon completion, you will be able to see the digital version of your ID and can get a PDF version on your phone.

UAEICP application

Another method to view your Emirates ID in digital format is through the UAEICP application. To do it this way, you must follow the steps that we will describe below:

  1. Log in to the UAEICP app. If you do not have a user, you will need to create one to use this method.
  2. Then, you must select EMIRATES ID
  3. Tap your name in this section

Once the process is complete, you will be able to see the digital copy of your ID, which you can obtain in PDF. This way, you can access it at any time without having to have an internet connection.

title: How to Check Emirates ID Status Online in the UAE
content:
Missed updates can cost you a lot of time! Your Emirates ID gives you access to essential services, keeps your legal status squeaky clean, and proves you belong here.

But waiting without knowing where your application stands? That’s a recipe for stress, confusion, and a dozen unnecessary trips to typing centers. The longer you stay in the dark, the more you risk missing out on important deadlines and services that rely on this ID.

The silver lining here is that it only takes a few clicks to check your Emirates ID status online. And you don’t have to spend hours standing in seemingly never ending queues. In this blog post, we explain how you can quickly check your emirates ID.

What Is Emirates ID and Why It Matters

we start going into detail about how to check your Emirates ID status, here’s the basic introduction to what it actually is.

  • It’s your national identity proof.
  • It’s linked to your visa, bank account, and even your phone line.
  • You can’t get a driving license or rent a house without it.
  • Many services, from hospital visits to Emirates Post pickup, require it.
  • It’s used to sign official documents digitally.

Whether you’re applying for the first time or renewing, knowing your Emirates ID status helps you stay ahead of delays and avoid fines that can sneak up without warning.

How You Can Check Your Emirates ID Status Online

This is how you can do your Emirates ID status check online in under a minute:

Step-by-Step:

  1. Visit the official ICP Portal
  2. Click on ‘Check Application Status’
  3. Enter your Application Number (PRAN) or Emirates ID number
  4. Click ‘Submit’
  5. Your application timeline will be displayed.

If you applied through a service center, they should’ve handed you a PRAN (application number). You will need it, so keep it safe. But if you end up losing it, you can still check your status using your Emirates ID number if you’re renewing.

What Your Status Means & What to Do About It

When you check your emirates id status, you might see:

1. Under Processing

Still in the system. It means your application has been received, but biometrics might still be pending, or the review is underway. Give it some time. It can take up to 10 working days. If it stretches beyond that, follow up.

2. Printed

Your ID has been printed and is being prepared for dispatch. You should get an SMS soon with post office details.

3. Delivered to Post Office

Visit your local Emirates Post office with your original passport and application slip to collect it. 

4. Collected

You’ve picked it up and can now update records with banks, employers, and service providers.

If you don’t see movement after 10 days? Call the ICP at their number. They’re surprisingly helpful and often resolve issues on the spot.

These are some of the most common reasons for delays happening. We also share how you can prevent that:

  • Incomplete documents: Always double check the checklist before submission.
  • Unpaid fines or outstanding dues: Immigration and traffic fines can halt processing.
  • Photo issues: If your photo doesn’t meet ICP standards, expect a speed bump.
  • Incorrect mobile number: You won’t get updates. Update it via the ICP app or nearest typing center.
  • Application submitted during public holidays: Expect things to move a little slower around Eid or National Day.

Why Should You Be Checking Regularly?

These are the reasons explaining why a quick Emirates ID check should be on your to-do list:

  • Avoid fines for late renewals
  • Track application hiccups before they become disasters
  • Know exactly when and where to collect your card
  • Get peace of mind when you’re about to travel or submit legal documents
  • Fix issues before they spiral into bigger delays

Checking your Emirates ID is actually a smart strategy

Alternatives to Portals

Not a fan of web portals? We get it. Some days, even a CAPTCHA feels like too much effort. Here are your other options:

Use the ICP App

  • Free on Android and iOS
  • Instant notifications about every step
  • Useful for other services too (visa renewals, family sponsorship, etc.)
  • Login with UAE Pass for faster access

Call ICP Customer Service

  • Dial 600 522222
  • Available in Arabic and English
  • Friendly reps
  • They’ll ask for your PRAN or Emirates ID number, so have it ready

How Our Team Makes It Look Effortless for You

We get it. Forms, documents, numbers… that’s not everyone’s cup of tea. And honestly, why should it be yours?

That’s why our licensing experts in UAE Free Zones handle it all. Whether it’s your very first Emirates ID application or a renewal buried under a pile of other tasks, we’ve got it covered.

What You Get With Connect FZ:

  • Instant updates so you’re not left in the dark
  • We handle the grunt work, so you don’t have to
  • Fast document filing with zero errors
  • Real human support (not a chatbot with attitude)
  • Proactive follow-ups so you never miss a pickup
  • Integrated services with your free zone license and visa process

Avoid the stressful processes. Let us sort your ID while you focus on building your dream business.

FAQs

How long does it take to get an Emirates ID?

Typically 7–10 working days after biometrics. If it takes longer, check your emirates ID status online or call the ICP.

What if my Emirates ID is delayed?

Check the ICP portal. If it’s stuck for more than 10 days, call them. You might need to visit a customer happiness center.

Can I track Emirates ID without a PRAN number?

Yes, if you already have an Emirates ID number (for renewals), you can use that instead on the ICP portal.

What if I entered the wrong mobile number during application?

Update your contact info via the ICP app or by visiting a typing center. It only takes a few minutes.

Can someone else collect my Emirates ID?

Yes, but they need a copy of your passport and an authorization letter. The post office staff won’t release it otherwise.

Do I need an Emirates ID to open a bank account?

Yes. Most banks in the UAE require it as proof of residence and identity. Without it, you’re stuck.

Can I travel without my Emirates ID if my visa is valid?

Technically yes, but some services at the airport or check-in counters may ask for it. It’s better to carry it.

Conclusion

In a place like the UAE, your Emirates ID is more than an ID. It’s your access pass to almost everything. From job onboarding and bank accounts to mobile plans and medical care, this tiny card punches well above its weight.

Tracking your application is basic maintenance for your UAE life. Waiting without any plans or strategies only adds stress. Be diligent instead.

Stop guessing. Stop waiting. Check your emirates ID status now, or let us handle it while you focus on your business goals. Get in touch with our experts.

title: How Many Days Can I Stay in UAE After Employment Visa Cancellation UAE 2026?
content:
Understanding employment visa cancellation UAE procedures is crucial for expatriates. It ensures a smooth transition or exit. As a result, this guide elaborates on post-cancellation stays, rules, and more.

In this article, we delve deep into the Visa Services in UAE. We explore options for extended stay, procedures, fees, and potential consequences of overstaying. Furthermore, we address common inquiries related to visa cancellation in the UAE.

Employment Visa Extended Stay Options

The UAE government provides certain flexibilities for individuals looking to extend their stay post-cancellation. Discover more here:

Procedure and Fees

Initially, the process of employment visa cancellation UAE commences with the employer or sponsor initiating the cancellation. This step is critical and must be executed properly to avoid legal complications.

  • Firstly, the employer submits a cancellation request to the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE) or the respective free zone authority.

Documentation requirements include the employee’s passport, a cancellation form completed by both parties, and possibly a no objection certificate (NOC) from the employee.

  • Subsequently, the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA) processes the cancellation. This involves updating the immigration system to reflect the end of the individual’s employment status.

During this stage, the individual might need to provide biometric data or undergo an exit interview.

Regarding fees, the cancellation fee for employment visa in UAE varies based on several factors including the emirate, type of visa, and whether the process is expedited.

Generally, the cancellation fee for employment visa in UAE ranges but it is advisable to budget for additional costs such as typing and service charges. Employers typically cover these costs, but it is essential to clarify this as part of the end-of-service settlement.

  • After the cancellation is processed, individuals receive a confirmation. This document is crucial for any future visa applications or if planning to re-enter the UAE.

Consequences of Overstaying

Understanding the consequences of overstaying after employment visa cancellation UAE is paramount. The UAE imposes strict penalties on those who exceed their legal stay.

  • Firstly, the UAE provides a grace period ranging from 30 to 180 days, depending on visa category and skill level post-visa cancellation. This period is meant for individuals to either exit the UAE or secure another visa type. It is vital to use this time wisely to avoid penalties.

If an individual overstays beyond this grace period, daily fines accrue. Initially, the fine might seem manageable, but it can quickly accumulate, becoming a significant financial burden. Standard overstay fine is generally AED 50 per day.

  • Moreover, prolonged overstaying can lead to more severe consequences. These include a ban on re-entry to the UAE, deportation, and even legal action.

Such penalties not only affect one’s immediate situation but can also have long-term implications for future travel or employment in the Gulf region.

  • To avoid these outcomes, individuals should closely monitor their stay duration. If an extension is needed, applying for a new visa or seeking advice from immigration consultants is advisable.

Options include tourist visas, visit visas, or even transitioning to a new employment visa if another job offer is secured within the UAE.

The importance of understanding Employment Visa Extended Stay Options

The importance of understanding Employment Visa Extended Stay Options in the UAE cannot be overstated, especially for expatriates navigating the complexities of visa regulations in a foreign country.

  • These options offer a cushion of security and flexibility, crucial during the transitional period following employment visa cancellation UAE. For many, the ability to extend their stay legally provides the necessary time to seek new employment opportunities.
  • Moreover, considering Employment Visa Extended Stay Options is essential due to the legal implications and potential penalties associated with overstaying a visa in the UAE. The government has set clear rules and fines for those who fail to adhere to their visa.
  • Extended stay options help prevent the accrual of fines, legal complications, or a ban on re-entry, which can have long-term consequences on one’s ability to work or live in the UAE and other Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries.

Additionally, these extended stay options reflect the UAE’s commitment to being a welcoming and flexible environment for the global workforce.

UAE Visa Cancellation Rules 2026

In 2026, specific regulations govern the grace period after visa cancellation and the use of Emirates ID post-cancellation. For example, you need to know:

Grace Period After Cancellation

The grace period following employment visa cancellation UAE is a critical timeframe for expatriates. This period allows individuals to either exit the UAE or arrange for an alternative legal status without facing penalties.

  • Firstly, it is important to note that the UAE authorities typically offer a 30-day grace period after visa cancellation. During this time, individuals are legally allowed to stay in the country without accruing fines.

Furthermore, during this grace period, individuals have the opportunity to seek new employment, apply for a different type of visa, or make arrangements to leave the country. It is crucial to use this time efficiently to avoid legal complications.

  • To extend this grace period, one might consider applying for a tourist visa, which can provide additional time in the UAE. However, this requires careful planning and timely application to ensure continuity of legal status.

Additionally, for those intending to leave the UAE, it is advisable to confirm travel plans and ensure that all legal and financial obligations in the country are settled. This includes closing bank accounts, settling utility bills, and fulfilling any rental agreements.

Using Emirates ID Post-Cancellation

The Emirates ID is a vital identity card that serves multiple purposes in the UAE, from accessing government services to banking. After employment visa cancellation UAE, the validity and usability of the Emirates ID come into question.

  • So, upon the cancellation of an employment visa, the Emirates ID is technically no longer valid for official transactions. However, it may still be required for certain processes, such as closing bank accounts or finalizing other formalities before leaving the country.

Also, it is essential to understand that while the Emirates ID may still be physically in your possession, its digital validity is linked to your visa status. Therefore, attempting to use it for official purposes post-cancellation may result in complications or legal issues.

  • For those who secure a new visa or employment within the grace period, it is necessary to apply for a new Emirates ID linked to the new visa status. The process involves submitting a new application and undergoing biometric capturing, similar to the initial application process.

Therefore, individuals should be aware that retaining the Emirates ID after leaving the UAE is not advisable. The Emirates ID becomes electronically invalid once the residency visa is cancelled to ensure compliance with UAE laws and regulations.

In this article, we will direct you via the obtaining procedure of an employment visa UAE. We will teach you the eligibility requirements, the Dubai employment visa cost, and also the essential documents that you will need. Furthermore, we will certainly resolve frequently asked inquiries and offer useful sources to aid you browse your trip to operating in the Emirates.

Benefits of Employment Visa UAE

Having an Employment Visa UAE is a secret key that has multiple advantages for people who want to dwell and work in the country.

  • One of the most substantial advantages is a chance to carry out a business and a personal life in a legality way in the UAE. This gives a possibility to people to establish a career, gain valuable work experience.
  • Moreover, the employment visa holders get the opportunity to use the country first-rate healthcare network. Such assistance provides not only the public finance healthcare institutions but private health insurance companies too. This makes sure that people get proper medical treatment.
  • In addition, employment visa UAE gives people rights to open bank accounts and to get other range of financial services. Therefore, it gives them the power to handle their finances, invest in the UAE. Also, gives the power to build a secure financial future that can endure over time.
  • On the top of it all, employment sponsorship is another advantage of workers having employment visas in UAE; this includes accompanying his/her spouse and children. This strengthens the families bond which in turn make the whole family live in a friendly environment.
  • The driving license becomes a lot feasible while the work permit in extended. They give ample freedom to see and travel regularly across different terrains and captivating metropolises of the UAE.
  • Employees under employment visa Dubai can travel to named destinations without obtaining additional visas.

Despite the fact that employment visas bring into the light a number of good sides, it is imperative to remember that in UAE laws and regulations dominate. Therefore, these arrangements are satisfactory and pleasant for both employees and their enterprises.

Types of Employment Visa in UAE

The United Arab Emirates visa arrangements include various types of employment visas for different needs and circumstances.

  • The most common type they grant is a Standard Work Visa. This type of visa is uphold by an employer. This employer needs to be a candidate from private sector, public sector or free zones. Small Businesses can obtain this financial assistance from the government for a period of two to three years as long as certain criteria are met.
  • The new UAE government has introduced the Green Visa that is a long-lasting residence permit. This visa is in favor of highly qualified profiles, as well as investors and business owners. It is a five-year-validity permit. Besides, it lets you apply for adding on your family members.
  • The Golden Visa is a long-term residency program that was started by the UAE. These visas are reserved for people who are interested in investing, creating a startup business or demonstrating exceptional talents. It provides a ten year validity and it is more suitable than other visa options.
  • Besides these general categories there are also some visas specific for work like for domestic workers and short-running projects.

Consulting with relevant authorities or Employment Visa processing agencies in order to get the most convenient job visa would be critical in this case. They will act as a guide and help with making the application less complex.

Application Process for the Employment Visa in UAE

The application process for an employment visa UAE started by the employer.

  • Employers should request an entry visa quota approval from the Ministry of Labour before the process can start. Such a condition is common in case the job vacancy is not inside of any of the UAEs free zones.
  • This enables the employer to move on to the next step of the visa application once the quota has been approved. The employer must hand in one of the employees passports, a contract that has been signed up to, and some other important papers.
  • Whether it is for a work visa, student visa, or the visitor visa, the main requirements that may be request will differ.
  • This process will conclude with the completion of the workers medical checkup as well as the medical fitness test. If successful, it will be grant an employment entry visa. This visa allows them to enter the UAE just to complete the application process for the visa.
  • On arrival in the Emirates, the employer is subjected to another series of medical procedures and will need to apply for a UAE residence visa. This visa will give them the opportunity to stay and work in UAE.
  • The whole procedure may last for several weeks or until when the last call for applications will be complete.

To obtain a self employment visa, you will need to meet the self employment visa UAE requirements:

  • Freelance permit.
  • Education certificates.
  • Income proof.
  • Financial solvency.

Such criteria permits to get Green Visa job. This visa has the residence allowance for five years with the opportunity of renewal.

What are the eligibility criteria for Employment Visa in UAE?

To obtain an employment visa UAE, you must meet an specific eligibility criteria:

  • First of all, make sure that you have a passport. This passport have to be valid for minimum of six months before your travel date. On this one, you can be assured that your passport will not expire before
  • Then, seek and obtain an offer for the job with a UAE-based organization. Only a company holding a valid license to operate within the territory of the UAE by the relevant regulatory authorities is permit to operate.
  • Apart from that, make sure that you satisfy the educational qualifications request by the available position. The employer visa UAE requirements are very individual in each case based on the specific practice and level of the request skill.
  • Fourthly, you need a medical fitness test by a certified UAE medical center. Such is indispensable to satisfy the health and work requirements in the UAE.
  • Besides the ones we said, you would need a few more documents based on your particular case. These are documents proving experience in the capacity of a service provider, relevant qualifications, and proof of their financial credentials.

For the most recent data and visit UAE authorities or visa processing agency. They will contribute through offering current information and support applicants during application procedure. Make sure you have all the employment visa UAE requirements before applying.

Do not forget to find out about employment visa cost in UAE before getting one.

UAE Employment Visa Rules

The Employment Regulations Visa of UAE is a bundle of rules that allows foreign citizens to get a employment visa UAE and maintain it. This is to guarantee that foreign migrant workers are legally permit to work in the country.

Some of the rules are:

  • Companies that would like to employ foreign nationals bear the responsibility of sponsoring the visas of their employees.
  • Visa Application. The required approval to receive a work visa in the UAE includes medical tests which would ensure that individuals are in a good shape to work.
  • The visa terms of UAE usually are grant for a certain limited period of time and the renewal is conditional on the individuals employment and underlying regulations.
  • In addition to the work visa, work permit and residence permit, the workers will be permit to legally work and stay in the UAE.
  • Employers are typically responsible to meet visa related expenditures for their workers whenever it is time for either renewal or initial application of the work visa.
  • For those with Visa violations in the UAE will pay penalization which may be fines, deportation, and banning re-entry into the country.
  • Sponsorship of dependents. Visa holders of UAE could, for instance, include their dependents, like spouses or children, to live with them and vice versa.
  • Job changes. Obtaining a work visa in the UAE means that the individual needs a visa sponsorship from a new employer in transit.

It is crucial for UAE residents to take time to understand and practice the UAE Employment Visa Rules. In this way, they make sure that they are abiding the law and avoid any problems from occurring later.

How long is a UAE employment visa valid

The period validity of the employment visa UAE is dependent on the type of visa. There are three main types of Visa in UAE

  • Job Offer Visa. This visa defeats the object of 30-days stay. You can devote this period to take care of technicalities related to your residence visa, such as its application and issuance, for example.
  • Contract Employment Visa. This visa is stamp exactly for the duration of your employment contract, but not more than a 3-year. You can extend the period if your work relationship do not end.
  • Green Visa. This the residency for workers with more expertise and freelancers. Also, you can do a renewal of this type of visa.

Nevertheless, the duration is subject to the discretion of the particular employment contract agreement and the terms of sponsorship designated by the employer.

Do not forget that the following recommendations are general. Find out from the relevant authorities before obtain an employment visa Dubai without problems. Likewise, find out about the Dubai employment visa cost

Difference between Employment Visa and Work Permit

Employment visa and work permit allow foreign workers operate in UAE. The former is specific for a working category of a foreign worker and the latter is a permission of the job category requested.

  • The work permit provides the employer with an opportunity to recruit such workers from foreign countries. The company manages and finances all, as well as include a conditional employment proposition.
  • Residing in UAE and doing your job is possible with the assistance of an employment visa. This is grant on the same work permit and will serve as a document to prove that the holder is legally permit to live and work in the country.

Both is an integral part of foreign expatriation in the United Arab Emirates

Meanwhile, the costs among each document are also different. Currently, this are the employment visa cost in UAE:

  • Depending on the organization he/she is working for (classes A, B, C), a work permit is charged on like that. It has prices that vary from AED 250 to AED 3450.
  • Employment visa cost depends on its type (Labor certificate, fixed-term, Green visas). The price is from 956 AED to 1479 AED.

As an example, the initial phase may cost from AED 3,000 to AED 8,450; the fees might be higher.

Please note that the cost also varies by additional fees. This costs can be: medical tests, Emirates ID fees, and various miscellaneous fees might lead to even higher total cost.

Conclusion

To sum up, getting the employment visa UAE is a two stage procedure. First, the employer must secure a work permit, authorizing them to hire you. Once obtained, you can apply for an employment visa based on the work permit. This visa allows you to reside and work legally in the UAE.

Remember, visa costs can vary depending on factors like company classification and visa type. Please note that if you need to obtain a self employment visa, you need to have on hand all the self employment visa requirements. Consult the UAE authorities or visa processing companies for the latest information and exact costs.

If you have any questions concerning visas in UAE, please feel free to contact us at any time.

Some of the rules are:

  • Companies that would like to employ foreign nationals bear the responsibility of sponsoring the visas of their employees.
  • Visa Application. The required approval to receive a work visa in the UAE includes medical tests which would ensure that individuals are in a good shape to work.
  • The visa terms of UAE usually are grant for a certain limited period of time and the renewal is conditional on the individuals employment and underlying regulations.
  • In addition to the work visa, work permit and residence permit, the workers will be permit to legally work and stay in the UAE.
  • Employers are typically responsible to meet visa related expenditures for their workers whenever it is time for either renewal or initial application of the work visa.
  • For those with Visa violations in the UAE will pay penalization which may be fines, deportation, and banning re-entry into the country.
  • Sponsorship of dependents. Visa holders of UAE could, for instance, include their dependents, like spouses or children, to live with them and vice versa.
  • Job changes. Obtaining a work visa in the UAE means that the individual needs a visa sponsorship from a new employer in transit.

It is crucial for UAE residents to take time to understand and practice the UAE Employment Visa Rules. In this way, they make sure that they are abiding the law and avoid any problems from occurring later.

How long is a UAE employment visa valid

The period validity of the employment visa UAE is dependent on the type of visa. There are three main types of Visa in UAE

  • Job Offer Visa. This visa defeats the object of 30-days stay. You can devote this period to take care of technicalities related to your residence visa, such as its application and issuance, for example.
  • Contract Employment Visa. This visa is stamp exactly for the duration of your employment contract, but not more than a 3-year. You can extend the period if your work relationship do not end.
  • Green Visa. This the residency for workers with more expertise and freelancers. Also, you can do a renewal of this type of visa.

Nevertheless, the duration is subject to the discretion of the particular employment contract agreement and the terms of sponsorship designated by the employer.

Do not forget that the following recommendations are general. Find out from the relevant authorities before obtain an employment visa Dubai without problems. Likewise, find out about the Dubai employment visa cost

Difference between Employment Visa and Work Permit

Employment visa and work permit allow foreign workers operate in UAE. The former is specific for a working category of a foreign worker and the latter is a permission of the job category requested.

  • The work permit provides the employer with an opportunity to recruit such workers from foreign countries. The company manages and finances all, as well as include a conditional employment proposition.
  • Residing in UAE and doing your job is possible with the assistance of an employment visa. This is grant on the same work permit and will serve as a document to prove that the holder is legally permit to live and work in the country.

Both is an integral part of foreign expatriation in the United Arab Emirates

Meanwhile, the costs among each document are also different. Currently, this are the employment visa cost in UAE:

  • Depending on the organization he/she is working for (classes A, B, C), a work permit is charged on like that. It has prices that vary from AED 250 to AED 3450.
  • Employment visa cost depends on its type (Labor certificate, fixed-term, Green visas). The price is from 956 AED to 1479 AED.

As an example, the initial phase may cost from AED 3,000 to AED 8,450; the fees might be higher.

Please note that the cost also varies by additional fees. This costs can be: medical tests, Emirates ID fees, and various miscellaneous fees might lead to even higher total cost.

Conclusion

To sum up, getting the employment visa UAE is a two stage procedure. First, the employer must secure a work permit, authorizing them to hire you. Once obtained, you can apply for an employment visa based on the work permit. This visa allows you to reside and work legally in the UAE.

Remember, visa costs can vary depending on factors like company classification and visa type. Please note that if you need to obtain a self employment visa, you need to have on hand all the self employment visa requirements. Consult the UAE authorities or visa processing companies for the latest information and exact costs.

title: Reasons to be an Entrepreneur in the UAE
content:
Becoming an entrepreneur is making a crucial decision that will change your life and bring you many benefits. In some cases, it’s uncertain if it’s a good idea to choose entrepreneurship over a regular job. However, there are several reasons to be an entrepreneur in the UAE and here you will discover them.

In this article, you will learn everything you need to know about being an entrepreneur in the UAE. For example, here you can find information about the benefits it can bring and how to become an entrepreneur. Besides, you will also discover some top reasons why being an entrepreneur in this country is favorable. Let’s observe:

What is an Entrepreneur?

Entrepreneurs are people who create their own profitable businesses in a specific location, and in this case, the UAE. They come up with ideas for a good or service and sell their products or services to different consumers. In some other cases, entrepreneurs also make improvements upon an existing service or product, generating competition in the market.

But why is entrepreneurship important to the UAE? Thanks to the many successful entrepreneurs, the UAE and other countries made their economies stronger and more stable. In other words, the existence of good entrepreneurs is a vital element in the society and economy. Because of them, all people have access to many innovative services and products.

Being an entrepreneur has its advantages, which are the main reasons to be an entrepreneur in the UAE. However, a person should have certain skills in order to become a successful entrepreneur. For example, all entrepreneurs must be innovative, problem solvers, change-makers, and must not be afraid of failure.

There are many ways in which entrepreneurs can impact the economy of a country. For instance, they increase employment since their creations can also help other people to find a job. Subsequently, that fact decreases poverty in society since many individuals can get employment, which is thanks to entrepreneurs.

Ways in which entrepreneurship impacts the economy of a country.

Besides increasing employment and reducing poverty, entrepreneurship can benefit the economy in many other ways. For example, entrepreneurs can create new businesses, and thanks to that, it’s possible to open up new markets. When new markets are opened up, it stimulates the national economy, helps it grow, and keeps it balanced.

Another good way in which entrepreneurship helps the economy grow is by increasing the national income. The gross national income (GNI) is the total amount of money that the people and businesses of a nation earn. If entrepreneurs help to increase employment, it also increases the national income as consequence.

And lastly, entrepreneurship can also push the economy in new directions every day. This is because entrepreneurs develop new products and services that replace the old and obsolete ones. Besides, they can also identify weak spots in society and contribute to the reduction of these weak spots by bringing more awareness to them.

Why Should You Become An Entrepreneur in the UAE?

Besides being a benefit for the country’s economy and society, entrepreneurs also benefit themselves in a country like the UAE. Those advantages and benefits that they obtain can be valid reasons to become an entrepreneur. You can find many reasons to be an entrepreneur in the UAE, and here we’ll briefly explain some of them.

Before we get started, you must be aware that some of these reasons are benefits that the country offers. For example, tax exemptions, world-class infrastructure, efficient facilities, and many other similar elements are benefits provided by the UAE. Nonetheless, other advantages are created by the entrepreneurs themselves, such as having a flexible routine, personal goals, etc.

Here are some of the reasons to be an entrepreneur in the UAE that we’ll explain below:

  • Entrepreneurs can enjoy favorable tax policies in the UAE.
  • A wide range of available licenses, free zones, and company formation options.
  • A strategic business location that ensures a profitable business.
  • Efficient infrastructure and facilities to manage a company correctly.
  • Access to high-qualified professionals to hire.
  • Power to create wealth and build a legacy.
  • Freedom to be your own boss and make your own business decisions.

Entrepreneurs Can Enjoy Favorable Tax Policies in the UAE.

One of the main reasons why entrepreneurs decide to set up in the UAE is because of tax exemptions. If you choose a UAE free zone as your business location, you can enjoy several of these tax exemptions. For example, you will not need to pay corporate tax, income tax, or personal income tax.

Even if you choose to set up in the UAE Mainland, you will not have to pay personal income tax. Due to these tax policies, the UAE is a successful business place with one of the best tax systems. Subsequently, there are new entrepreneurs and investors every day looking forward to reaching success in this country.

A wide range of available licenses, free zones, and company formation options.

Among the reasons to be an entrepreneur in the UAE, you can also find different options to establish a company. Firstly, entrepreneurs can choose between many business locations to set up their businesses, including free zones and mainland areas. After deciding to become an entrepreneur in this country, you can choose any of the 45 free zones available.

Besides, you are free to select your type of company formation after selecting your business location. For example, if you chose a free zone, you can choose between an FZE, an FZC, and a branch office. On the other hand, if you chose a mainland, you can set up an LLC or a branch office. Furthermore, all entrepreneurs can freely choose their business activities and licenses.

A Strategic Business Location that Ensures a Profitable Business.

Another reason why it’s worth it to be an entrepreneur in the UAE is because of the geographical location. The UAE is basically the center of global trade since it’s located in the middle of Asia, Africa, and Europe. At this very point, the UAE has a global reach and entrepreneurs can do business with millions of potential customers.

Besides, this country is also a very popular touristic destination, which means that many businesses are profitable here. For example, food-related businesses and tourism agencies are very successful in the UAE. Other industries and sectors are also profitable in this country, like the textile industry and many others.

Efficient infrastructure and facilities to manage a company correctly.

The UAE authorities also guarantee the best infrastructure, so entrepreneurs can enjoy it and run their companies efficiently. This is possible since the UAE government is an investor-friendly authority, and it develops new technological advancements every day. Moreover, entrepreneurs can also request warehouse services, office space, and many other similar elements to fulfill their business requirements.

As for the facilities that entrepreneurs can access, there are efficient mass transport systems available to corporate spaces. Besides, they can also access several health centers, business parks, and many other facilities to fulfill their needs. On the other hand, there is also the advantage of having advanced telecommunication systems to operate a business better.

Access to High-Qualified Professionals to Hire.

Another reason why entrepreneurs choose the UAE as their business location is the easy access to employees. Recruiting new workers is a task that can take valuable time, but it can be easier in this country. All entrepreneurs will find countless high-qualified professionals to hire to operate their businesses in a more efficient way.

Besides, they can also find several recruitment agencies that help them complete this task easily. For instance, let’s say that you’re building your company and you don’t have time to hire employees. In this case, you can request the services of this type of agency to do this activity without wasting your time.

Power to Create Wealth and Build a Legacy.

This country has indeed the advantages that all entrepreneurs need to boost their businesses and make them profitable. Therefore, these benefits can ensure a bright future for all companies and industries in the long term. In other words, you will create a long-lasting wealth with a profitable business that can become your own legacy.

The more your company grows, the greater the impact it will have on society. You can even create a whole empire after laying the foundation stones. One of the impacts that your legacy can have on society is creating employment for hundreds or thousands of people. Besides, a successful entrepreneur can also become a brand recognized globally.

Freedom to be Your own Boss and make your own business decisions.

Among other reasons to be an entrepreneur in the UAE, you will not have to report to anyone. This is because you’ll be your own boss and no one will tell you how to reach your goal. Besides, you’ll also have a flexible routine and a greater enthusiasm for work, but that doesn’t mean you won’t work.

Many success stories of UAE entrepreneurs also reveal that entrepreneurs can freely make their own decisions. However, you must think carefully about your alternatives before making decisions because your company’s future will depend on it. That is the main reason why entrepreneurs must have decision-making skills, so they can decide the direction of their businesses.

How can Connectfz help you to become an entrepreneur in the UAE?

If these reasons to be an entrepreneur in the UAE have convinced you, you can start building your company today. You can count on Connectfz to complete all the business setup process in your desired free zone. Besides, you will get the guidance you need to make your business more profitable and successful.

Firstly, we will help you to select a free zone that suits your kind of business and fulfills your needs. After that, you’ll be able to choose between different packages that we offer, which contain licenses, visas, and facilities. Once you choose your options, the company setup process will start and we’ll be there to support you.

Besides, you can request our other support services after setting up your company in the UAE. For example, if you request our recruitment services, we will hire new employees for your company in an efficient way. Among other services, you can find business trade license in UAE, Visa Service in UAE etc.

Would you like to contact Connectfz to obtain more information about the advantages of being an entrepreneur in the United Arab Emirates ? If you have any questions, call us on +97143316688. You can email us at info@connectfz.ae, and you will talk to one of our representatives who will answer your questions.

title: Establishment card UAE: All you need to know about it
content:
The Establishment Card UAE is an essential document for any foreign investor that wants to conduct business in this country. Learning about the stages for establishing your company is crucial, but you also need to know which other requirements you need to fulfill so you can offer your services or products without any trouble.

There are several steps you have to take further once you set up your company and one of this the Establishment card check. Before you can hire employees, as well as receive payments and many other activities, you need to obtain this important document.

In this article, you’re going to learn everything you need to know about how to get the establishment card for your business. In addition, you can gain some understanding of why it’s so important to get it. Let’s observe:

Establishment card UAE: All you need to know about it

Many entrepreneurs and foreign investors that look at the UAE as a promising place to conduct business may want to start their operations as soon as possible.

They may learn how to set up a company fast in the UAE, but it’s important to know that once you have carried out this process, you still need to fulfill certain requirements before starting operations.

Getting your business trade license it’s crucial to conduct business, but if you’re planning on hiring employees or issuing invoices, you must have an Establishment card UAE to do it.

Why do you need to learn about the establishment card?

It’s essential to learn about the Labour establishment card UAE before you begin the incorporation process of your company because this will allow you to be prepared to anything you have to face once you have set up your business.

In addition, it will allow you to gather all the necessary documents so you can speed up the process and begin to offer your services as soon as possible.

If you already know how to get the Establishment card MoHRE but you want to get assistance in this matter, you can contact a business setup agency that can assist you in this process.

What is an establishment card?

Before starting to learn about how to carry out the process for obtaining the Establishment Card UAE, you need to know what it is.

Establishment Cards prove a company’s registration and authorization. The card contains the company’s name, card number, and expiration date. The establishment card is required for all visa applications.

Here we can observe the content of an establishment card:

  • Company’s name
  • Card number
  • Expiry date

The content is written both in English and Arabic, and on the back side of the card, you can find some instructions to the holder as well as the information to contact the AMER Service. The most important information in this document is the Establishment card number.

Is the Establishment Labor Card the same as the Establishment Immigration Card?

Another important fact you should know about this document is that it has several names. It can receive the following names:

  • CEC or company establishment card
  • CIC or company immigration card
  • Establishment labor card
  • Establishment immigration card

Therefore, whenever you see one of the previous name, you should know that it’s the same document.

Who issues the Establishment card in UAE?

Before you establish your company, you must know who the authority responsible of issuing this crucial document is. It’s important to note that the registration authority isn’t in charge of it, since the immigration authority is in charge of issuing it instead.

The immigration authority is the General Directorate of Residency & Foreigners Affairs.

This may cause confusion to business owners because they may think that if they register the company in any Free Zone, said Free Zone will be in charge of issuing it. Thus, they may think that the issuing process could take 2 days and they choose a Free Zone for this reason. However, this isn’t the case and they may have to wait for 8 to 14 days after setting up the company because the immigration authority will process it and issue it.

So, once you establish your company, you must wait until the immigration authorities issue your establishment card. For this reason, you should be prepared to wait.

What is the validity of the Establishment card?

When you get your establishment card you must know that is has a validity date and you must renew it before it expires.

Regarding validity, Free Zone companies receive a card with a 1-year validity, while local companies get a three-year validity card. In this case, you must carry out the Establishment card renewal so you don’t get fined.

Why do you need an Establishment card?

Perhaps you may be wondering why your business needs to count on an Establishment card UAE.

This is an important document that allows you to do the following:

  • Apply for the residence visa for you and your employees
  • Obtain work permits for your employees
  • Apply for partners and investors visas
  • Recruit staff from abroad
  • It’s a requirement for some state service providers (internet, water and electricity for your office)

Why do you need the establishment card for obtaining visas?

If you don’t have your Establishment card check, you’re not going to be able to hire employees from abroad. When you submit the visa application for your employees you have to submit a copy of your company’s establishment card along with the other documents.

Since it’s a crucial document, you’re not able to obtain the necessary visas if you don’t have it.

How much is an establishment card in the UAE?

Another important aspect regarding the Establishment Card UAE is the fees you must pay to get it. As any other important document in the UAE, its cost may vary depending on the jurisdiction where you have set up your company.

Therefore it may range from AED 650 to AED 1500 per year from Free Zone to Free Zone. When it comes to mainland companies, the fee may range from AED 4940 to AED 5000 in Dubai for example.

As you can see, you must be prepared to pay the fees to obtain your Labour establishment card in UAE. In addition, you must take into consideration the renewal costs once the expiry is near.

What is the process to Obtain the Establishment card?

To obtain the Establishment Card UAE you must fulfill a prerequisite, gather the necessary documents, and carry out the procedure established by the authorities.

What are the prerequisites to obtain an establishment card?

The only prerequisite to obtaining the establishment card is that the company must have already obtained its trade license.

In this regard, you must carry out your company registration process and wait until you collect your trade license. Once you collect it, you can start the application to obtain your establishment card.

Which documents do you need for your establishment card in UAE?

Here we have the list with the necessary documents you must submit along with your application:

  • Copy of your company’s trade license
  • Partners list (for LLC Companies)
  • Copy of Memorandum of Association (for LLC companies)
  • Passport of local service agent or UAE national sponsor
  • Copies of passports of partners (for LLC companies)
  • Passport photos of partners and sponsors
  • Location map in Arabic
  • Copy of the tenancy contract
  • E-signature card copy of the sponsor and authorized signatories (if any)
  • Owner’s degree certificates (notarized and legalized)

What is the procedure to apply for the establishment card?

Once you have all the documents you need to apply for the establishment card. You must fill the application form and submit it to the relevant immigration authority.

You must follow the next steps:

  • Visit the Tasheel typing center with your documents and get the application form. Fill it and get the form translated to Arabic
  • Get your company seal and signature from your partners
  • Collect your card

You can submit it to the Ministry of Labour too. Once you got your card, you must keep it safe to avoid losing it. In case you lose it you’ll have to pay for replacement charges and apply for a new one.

What is the Renewal Process for the Establishment card?

It’s important to take care of the renewal for the Establishment card MoHRE because if your document expires you must face repercussions.

In addition, it’s important to carry out the process for renewal several weeks in advance before the expiry date, but after you have renewed the company’s registration.

Therefore, you must pay attention to these two dates so you can organize everything, gather your documents and begin the process. You can carry out the renewal process online or through AMER Service.

How to renew the establishment card online?

It’s pretty straightforward to renew your document online, you just have to follow the next steps:

  • Fill out the online form
  • Make the payments through Naqodi
  • Attach the printed receipt along with the documents
  • Submit immigration branch
  • Get your card the same day if it’s urgent, otherwise, it could take 2 to 3 working days

How to renew the establishment card through AMER Service?

If your company doesn’t have an online facility, you can carry out the renewal through AMER Service by following the next steps:

  • Get your online application typed at AMER Center
  • Take the following documents with you:
    • Original establishment card
    • Copy of your trade license
    • Location map in Arabic
    • Valid tenancy contract
    • Passport copies and copies of Emirates ID of Authorized signatory

How can Connect Freezone assist you with the establishment card?

Here in Connect Freezone, we want to help your business obtain its Establishment Card UAE. Our team of specialists is readily available to help you solve any inquiries you may have about the process.

We can assist you obtain your Establishment card number, and even if you need to carry out the Establishment card renewal process we can help you deal with the hassles of it. You just have to contact us to get a service adapted to your requirements.

In this article, you’re going to learn everything you need to know about how to get the establishment card for your business. In addition, you can gain some understanding of why it’s so important to get it. Let’s observe:

Establishment card UAE: All you need to know about it

Many entrepreneurs and foreign investors that look at the UAE as a promising place to conduct business may want to start their operations as soon as possible.

They may learn how to set up a company fast in the UAE, but it’s important to know that once you have carried out this process, you still need to fulfill certain requirements before starting operations.

Getting your business trade license it’s crucial to conduct business, but if you’re planning on hiring employees or issuing invoices, you must have an Establishment card UAE to do it.

Why do you need to learn about the establishment card?

It’s essential to learn about the Labour establishment card UAE before you begin the incorporation process of your company because this will allow you to be prepared to anything you have to face once you have set up your business.

In addition, it will allow you to gather all the necessary documents so you can speed up the process and begin to offer your services as soon as possible.

If you already know how to get the Establishment card MoHRE but you want to get assistance in this matter, you can contact a business setup agency that can assist you in this process.

What is an establishment card?

Before starting to learn about how to carry out the process for obtaining the Establishment Card UAE, you need to know what it is.

Establishment Cards prove a company’s registration and authorization. The card contains the company’s name, card number, and expiration date. The establishment card is required for all visa applications.

Here we can observe the content of an establishment card:

  • Company’s name
  • Card number
  • Expiry date

The content is written both in English and Arabic, and on the back side of the card, you can find some instructions to the holder as well as the information to contact the AMER Service. The most important information in this document is the Establishment card number.

Is the Establishment Labor Card the same as the Establishment Immigration Card?

Another important fact you should know about this document is that it has several names. It can receive the following names:

  • CEC or company establishment card
  • CIC or company immigration card
  • Establishment labor card
  • Establishment immigration card

Therefore, whenever you see one of the previous name, you should know that it’s the same document.

Who issues the Establishment card in UAE?

Before you establish your company, you must know who the authority responsible of issuing this crucial document is. It’s important to note that the registration authority isn’t in charge of it, since the immigration authority is in charge of issuing it instead.

The immigration authority is the General Directorate of Residency & Foreigners Affairs.

This may cause confusion to business owners because they may think that if they register the company in any Free Zone, said Free Zone will be in charge of issuing it. Thus, they may think that the issuing process could take 2 days and they choose a Free Zone for this reason. However, this isn’t the case and they may have to wait for 8 to 14 days after setting up the company because the immigration authority will process it and issue it.

So, once you establish your company, you must wait until the immigration authorities issue your establishment card. For this reason, you should be prepared to wait.

What is the validity of the Establishment card?

When you get your establishment card you must know that is has a validity date and you must renew it before it expires.

Regarding validity, Free Zone companies receive a card with a 1-year validity, while local companies get a three-year validity card. In this case, you must carry out the Establishment card renewal so you don’t get fined.

Why do you need an Establishment card?

Perhaps you may be wondering why your business needs to count on an Establishment card UAE.

This is an important document that allows you to do the following:

  • Apply for the residence visa for you and your employees
  • Obtain work permits for your employees
  • Apply for partners and investors visas
  • Recruit staff from abroad
  • It’s a requirement for some state service providers (internet, water and electricity for your office)

Why do you need the establishment card for obtaining visas?

If you don’t have your Establishment card check, you’re not going to be able to hire employees from abroad. When you submit the visa application for your employees you have to submit a copy of your company’s establishment card along with the other documents.

Since it’s a crucial document, you’re not able to obtain the necessary visas if you don’t have it.

How much is an establishment card in the UAE?

Another important aspect regarding the Establishment Card UAE is the fees you must pay to get it. As any other important document in the UAE, its cost may vary depending on the jurisdiction where you have set up your company.

Therefore it may range from AED 650 to AED 1500 per year from Free Zone to Free Zone. When it comes to mainland companies, the fee may range from AED 4940 to AED 5000 in Dubai for example.

As you can see, you must be prepared to pay the fees to obtain your Labour establishment card in UAE. In addition, you must take into consideration the renewal costs once the expiry is near.

What is the process to Obtain the Establishment card?

To obtain the Establishment Card UAE you must fulfill a prerequisite, gather the necessary documents, and carry out the procedure established by the authorities.

What are the prerequisites to obtain an establishment card?

The only prerequisite to obtaining the establishment card is that the company must have already obtained its trade license.

In this regard, you must carry out your company registration process and wait until you collect your trade license. Once you collect it, you can start the application to obtain your establishment card.

Which documents do you need for your establishment card in UAE?

Here we have the list with the necessary documents you must submit along with your application:

  • Copy of your company’s trade license
  • Partners list (for LLC Companies)
  • Copy of Memorandum of Association (for LLC companies)
  • Passport of local service agent or UAE national sponsor
  • Copies of passports of partners (for LLC companies)
  • Passport photos of partners and sponsors
  • Location map in Arabic
  • Copy of the tenancy contract
  • E-signature card copy of the sponsor and authorized signatories (if any)
  • Owner’s degree certificates (notarized and legalized)

What is the procedure to apply for the establishment card?

Once you have all the documents you need to apply for the establishment card. You must fill the application form and submit it to the relevant immigration authority.

You must follow the next steps:

  • Visit the Tasheel typing center with your documents and get the application form. Fill it and get the form translated to Arabic
  • Get your company seal and signature from your partners
  • Collect your card

You can submit it to the Ministry of Labour too. Once you got your card, you must keep it safe to avoid losing it. In case you lose it you’ll have to pay for replacement charges and apply for a new one.

What is the Renewal Process for the Establishment card?

It’s important to take care of the renewal for the Establishment card MoHRE because if your document expires you must face repercussions.

In addition, it’s important to carry out the process for renewal several weeks in advance before the expiry date, but after you have renewed the company’s registration.

Therefore, you must pay attention to these two dates so you can organize everything, gather your documents and begin the process. You can carry out the renewal process online or through AMER Service.

How to renew the establishment card online?

It’s pretty straightforward to renew your document online, you just have to follow the next steps:

  • Fill out the online form
  • Make the payments through Naqodi
  • Attach the printed receipt along with the documents
  • Submit immigration branch
  • Get your card the same day if it’s urgent, otherwise, it could take 2 to 3 working days

How to renew the establishment card through AMER Service?

If your company doesn’t have an online facility, you can carry out the renewal through AMER Service by following the next steps:

  • Get your online application typed at AMER Center
  • Take the following documents with you:
    • Original establishment card
    • Copy of your trade license
    • Location map in Arabic
    • Valid tenancy contract
    • Passport copies and copies of Emirates ID of Authorized signatory

How can Connect Freezone assist you with the establishment card?

Here in Connect Freezone, we want to help your business obtain its Establishment Card UAE. Our team of specialists is readily available to help you solve any inquiries you may have about the process.

We can assist you obtain your Establishment card number, and even if you need to carry out the Establishment card renewal process we can help you deal with the hassles of it. You just have to contact us to get a service adapted to your requirements.

title: Know everything about: Jafza Company Formation | Cost | Timeline | Benefits | Activities
content:
Are you seeking seamless international trade options in the UAE? Do you know about JAFZA company setup opportunities and offshore setup solutions? JAFZA Free Zone also offers offshore company setup solutions for international trade and commerce.

Dubai is renowned for its premier geographic location and as a global business hub. The Emirate offers varied choices for company setup and business startups. However, JAFZA company formation and offshore setup provide various solutions for international traders, ultimate security of assets, and multiple business-friendly policies for maximum profitability.

This article lets you delve into the details about Jafza company formation, Offshore setup procedure, criteria, and considerations to ensure a smooth setup for a successful business venture in 2026.

Requirements for JAFZA Business Setup

The following are the main criteria that must be met for Jafza company formation:

  • A minimum of two individual directors is required. The nationality of a shareholder is irrelevant when it comes to their ability to serve as a director. A secretary, who may also be a shareholder or director, must also be a natural person.
  • Any offshore business based in JAFZA must have its registered agent’s location as its official registered address. Since these firms do not have a trade license but rather a certificate of establishment, they are unable to engage in business with local firms in the UAE
  • Anyone, including legal organizations, may have an investor or a partner in a JAFZA offshore corporation. There are no limits based on country for partners, and the least amount of capital is required.

Simple and Easy Process: JAFZA Business Setup

A JAFZA Offshore Company may be quickly and easily established using this methodical procedure:

  • Hiring a registered agent for handling JAFZA’s regulatory affairs is a must. On the investor’s behalf, the agent verifies periodic renewal and paperwork adherence.
  • Determine your goal, whether it is international trading, share ownership, or asset maintenance. If your business plans do not include dealing with UAE residents, an offshore company is the best way to expand globally.
  • Choose an individual business title that follows JAFZA’s guidelines. A suffix of “Limited” is required in the registered company name for Jafza company formation.
  • Prepare your MOA and gather relevant papers, such as passports, evidence of residence, investor and director details, and more.
  • Include any required paperwork, information on your company’s structure and ownership capital, and the name of your registered agent when you submit your application for Articles of Incorporation to JAFZA.
  • The incorporation procedure cannot be completed without the payment of this charge and the minimum share capital in AED.
  • JAFZA authorities will issue a certificate of incorporation upon approval. It should be noted that Offshore companies are not authorized to engage in the UAE businesses as they do not have a UAE trade license.

 

Primary Benefits of Offshore Company Setup 

The primary reasons for choosing a Jafza offshore company formation are as follows:

  • A workplace or physical presence is not necessary for a JAFZA offshore firm. The registered agent’s location serves as the company’s headquarters.
  • The offshore structure provides an affordable choice for foreign holding and trading due to the reduced setup and upkeep requirements.
  • Under specific circumstances, offshore firms based in JAFZA may engage in overseas trade and even own real estate in Dubai.

Legislation for Offshore Company Setup

The Offshore company formation is subject to its regulations:

Commercial Activities Inside the UAE:

 The offshore corporation has non-resident status and is unable to get involved in business operations inside the United Arab Emirates.

Overseas Trading:

The offshore corporation is set up to get involved in holding and overseas trading. It lacks the authority to conduct business within the UAE. However, it may have interests in mainland or free zone enterprises in the UAE, along with further regulatory clearances.

Updated Documents:

The business must comply with regulations set forth by JAFZA for offshore formation and keep all corporate documents updated. It’s essential to renew the licenses annually before the expiry date to prevent legal sanctions and ensure smooth continuity.

How Connect FZ Can Guide You with Seamless JAFZA Company Setup?

We at Connect FZ are proud to provide full-service assistance for the establishment of UAE companies. From starting with the consultation, paperwork, to registration, and continuing compliance, our competent team is here to assist you in Jafza company formation.

Get started on your path towards global commercial success in 2026 with a JAFZA Offshore Company. Contact Connect FZ for further details right now.

FAQs

Q1. Why is JAFZA a popular free zone in Dubai?

It’s one of the largest free zones, strategically located near Jebel Ali Port, offering world-class infrastructure and global connectivity.

Q2. What types of companies can be formed in JAFZA?

You can set up a Free Zone Establishment, Free Zone Company, or branches.

Q3. Can JAFZA companies trade within Dubai mainland?

Yes, but only through a local distributor or agent.

Q4. What are the licensing options in JAFZA?

Trading, industrial, service, e-commerce, and national industrial licenses are the available options.

Q5. How long does it take to establish a JAFZA company?

 Company formation usually takes between 1 to 2 weeks depending on approvals.

Q6. Can I own property under a JAFZA company?

Yes, JAFZA companies can own property in designated freehold areas in Dubai.

 

Conclusion

To wrap it up, firms that intend to leverage foreign markets, tax breaks, and favorable regulations may set up a JAFZA offshore corporation with a competitive edge. There is no better alternative than JAFZA for investors and entrepreneurs alike who are searching for a safe and profitable place to save their funds or grow their businesses internationally.
