title: Freelance Visa Requirements in the UAE: A Comprehensive Guide
content:
Meeting all Freelance visa UAE requirements ensures a smooth and fast process for your work aspirations. In this case, the authorities of the nation allow independent activities to be carried out from a large list of possibilities. Furthermore, working independently in one of the free zones guarantees you some relevant benefits.

In this article, we will show you what the essential requirements to qualify for this type of visa from the nation are. Likewise, we will give you some tips and advice to make the process easier to execute.

The Essential Checklist to Meeting Freelance Visa Requirements in the UAE

Freelance visas are a document that allows people to work and reside legally in the country. In this way, foreigners who meet the Freelance visa UAE requirements will be able to apply for it easily. Thus, they will be able to carry out the activities permitted for this type of worker independently, without the need for sponsorship.

In this case, applicants will only be able to carry out activities such as design, education, and others that we will detail later. In addition, they must be governed by the conditions established by the nation’s authorities and by those specific to each free zone.

Eligibility Criteria

As we mentioned, there are certain freelance visa requirements in UAE that applicants must meet, which are as follows:

  • They must obtain a freelance permit from the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratization or MOHRE.
  • The applicant must possess the appropriate educational qualifications, which may be a bachelor’s degree or a specialist diploma.
  • They must have an annual income during the previous 2 years of at least AED 360,000. However, you can provide proof that you have the financial solvency to remain in the country during the visa period.

Business Plan

Another of the freelance visa UAE requirements is to have a well-structured business plan to serve as proof of your work aspirations. Hence, a good work plan tells the authorities that the work you want to do meets the parameters established in the nation. Therefore, we offer you some details of what you should do to properly plan your activities in the nation:

  • Identify your niche. To begin, you must work in one of the activities allowed for this permit, which must be consistent with your academic and professional qualifications.
  • Research the local market. In this case, you should investigate the most in-demand services in the place where you want to establish yourself. Likewise, you should investigate how saturated the market is in your niche and which with the characteristics of your direct competition.
  • Set clear goals. You can think about both your short-term and long-term goals, such as how far you want to go in your work. Therefore, you will be able to stay motivated but only if you set realistic goals.
  • Financial planning. You should be clear about the costs of your services, and operating costs, and investigate if you can make additional profits.
  • You must be clear about the legal aspects of setting up as a freelancer so that you can remain compliant at all times.
  • This is an important part of your activities since will help you get clients, and promote yourself professionally so they can find you easily.
  • Changes to your business plan. As you grow, there may be changes or other priorities, so you should always update your business plan.

Legal Structure

There are no freelance visa requirements that involve creating a legal structure like with other businesses. Thus, an applicant only needs to obtain a freelance permit from the relevant authorities to carry out work activities. Therefore, by obtaining the permit, the permit holder can operate under his name instead of having a brand name.

Free Zone Selection

Aspiring to work independently in the UAE can choose from a wide range of Free Zones. However, each of them may have different Freelance visa UAE requirements for permitted activities. Therefore, we will show you details of some of the Free Zones in which you can decide to work as a freelancer:

  • RAKEZ free zone: In this case, it is a free zone that allows activities that have to do with media and education. Nevertheless, you will only be able to select one activity that you can work on in this area.
  • Fujairah Creative City Freezone: There you can choose from a wide variety of activities, there is even a Freelancer Business Package for emerging companies with 4 Visas.
  • Ajman Free Zone: In this case, you can obtain all the facilities to obtain a freelance permit.
  • Tecom Business Center: Thanks to the Go Freelance program, freelancers will be able to have access to this business center, as well as educators and media workers.
  • Dubai Technology Entrepreneur Campus (DTEC). This is a hub for technology specialists, where you can find flexible desktop options and more.
  • Twofour54 Abu Dhabi: In this case, it is a center for media and entertainment professionals where you will not have to pay income taxes.

Finance Requirements

Applicants must meet one of the freelance visa requirements that have to do with the financial aspect. Thus, to obtain the visa, you must provide evidence of having earned an annual income in the two years before applying for AED 360,000. However, you can also demonstrate that you are financially sound enough to remain in the country for the duration of the visa.

Health Insurance

Freelancers in the UAE must have health insurance that covers their entire stay in the country. This is because these types of workers do not have the benefits of a company worker. Also, depending on the health insurance you apply for, it may cover the following:

  • Emergencies
  • Basic health care services
  • Maternity services
  • Preventive services

Residency Proof

Proof of residency is one of the Freelance visa UAE requirements for those who are already residents of the country. Thus, this is for people who have obtained it through the sponsorship of a spouse, parent, or employer. In this case, they must obtain an independent worker permit from the authorities.

Educational Qualifications

To obtain a freelance visa in the United Arab Emirates, the applicant must have the necessary qualifications. Therefore, you must present educational certifications according to the requirements of the authorities. Hence, you need to present proof of having obtained a bachelor’s degree or a diploma in a specialty.

No Objection Certificate (NOC)

This is another of the freelance visa requirements in UAE for those who already have a job in a company. In this case, this document certifies that the employer has no objection to the worker carrying out activities independently. However, in some free zones of the nation, it is not an essential requirement to obtain a freelance permit.

Background Checks

Although it is not among the mandatory requirements to obtain a freelance visa, it does not hurt to obtain a document that certifies your good conduct. Thus, authorities can verify that you have no criminal record and could make it easier to obtain a permit. It also helps companies that hire your services verify that you are a trustworthy person.

Visa Processing Fees

The Freelance visa UAE requirements also include a series of fees according to the duration of the document. However, this is a general view of the rates, as they may vary according to the free zone and the activity you will carry out. The breakdown of the fees for obtaining the visa is as follows:

Freelance permit

  • The visa issuance costs approximately AED 7,500, which is also the renewal price.

Establishment Card

  • The renewal card costs AED 2000

Employment Visa UAE

  • A 3-year employment visa costs AED 2750
  • 5-year employment visa costs AED 5000

UAE Residence Visa

Applying for a 3-year residence visa from outside the country costs AED 3,330. However, if you require an express service, you must pay AED 3,900.

Applying for a 3-year residence visa from within the country will cost you AED 4,960. Nonetheless, applicants requiring express service will have to pay up to AED 6,340.

Professional License

The self-employed license or permit is sufficient to work in the UAE in activities permitted by the authorities. The professional license is for those who want to establish and operate a service business in the UAE.

The Road to Success: Overcoming Challenges of Freelance Visa Requirements in the UAE

To obtain this document, you must meet the Freelance visa UAE requirements that we mentioned at the beginning. Without them, the applicant cannot work in this way in the country, so, before applying, they must know these requirements. If you meet the eligibility criteria, you will need to worry about meeting the other application requirements.

The UAE authorities facilitate the application for freelance visas to encourage this type of activity for entrepreneurs. However, it can be difficult to start your freelancing if you do not have the right tools. That is why it is important to have a good business plan and clear and realistic short and long-term objectives.

In addition, you will be able to obtain support from the authorities thanks to plans to encourage entrepreneurs and independent workers. In this case, you can find forums and accelerators designed for small businesses and freelancers.

Freelance Visa UAE: Requirements and Best Practices for Smooth Application Process

You already know the freelance visa requirements in the country, so make sure you have everything covered. Next, we will show you some of the aspects you should consider for a smooth and uncomplicated process:

  • Choose a field of work that should not only match your profession and skills, but also the permitted activities.
  • Choose the appropriate free zone according to the type of activity and the potential it offers for your professional and employment aspirations.
  • Have specific application documents on hand, such as a valid passport, NOC, and work portfolio, among others.
  • Make sure to validate your professional certifications at the relevant authority in your home country and at the UAE embassy.
  • Apply once you have everything prepared so you do not have to repeat the process, delay it, or even receive a denial.
  • Please try to obtain appropriate health insurance to cover any unexpected incidents during your stay in the UAE. You can also get insurance that covers unforeseen events in your freelance activities to avoid incidents that affect your finances or reputation.

FAQs

What are the specific eligibility criteria for obtaining a freelance visa in the UAE?

Applicants must meet the following Freelance visa UAE requirements to be eligible:

  • Obtain a freelance permit from the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratization (MOHRE).
  • Possess a bachelor’s degree or a specialization diploma.
  • Prove that you earned an annual income of AED 360,000 for the last 2 years or proof of financial solvency to support yourself.

What is the process for applying for a freelance visa in the UAE?

If you meet the freelance visa requirements, can start the process to obtain it. The process is simple and includes each of the steps that we list below:

  1. Apply for a freelancer permit in the chosen field of work in the free zone of your choice.
  2. Gather the necessary documents for smooth processing.
  3. Next, send the request to the corresponding authority.
  4. Once approved, the authorities will issue the freelancer permit.
  5. Then, apply for a freelance visa.
  6. Pass medical tests and obtain adequate health insurance.
  7. Finally, pay the fees for you to receive the visa.

How long is a freelance visa valid for in the UAE?

Normally, freelance visas, which are residence visas for independent workers, are valid for 3 renewable years.

What happens if my freelance visa expires while I’m still in the UAE?

After your freelance visa expires, you must leave the country and apply for its renewal. Otherwise, you will have to pay a fine if you remain in the country after the expiration date. The overstay fine accrues daily until you leave the country, which you can only do until you pay the penalty.

Is there a minimum income requirement for freelancers applying for a visa in the UAE?

One of the Freelance visa UAE requirements is to have earned at least AED 360000 annually for two years before application. However, if you have sufficient evidence that you can adequately support yourself during your stay, you also qualify for the visa.

What are the restrictions on the types of freelance activities permitted in the UAE?

The authorities of the UAE and the different free zones offer freelance visas only for certain activities. In this case, the lists of activities that you can carry out are those that we will mention below:

  • Actor
  • Animator
  • Artist
  • TV or radio presenter
  • Producer
  • Audio/sound engineer
  • Cameraman
  • Lighting specialist
  • Choreographer
  • Commentators
  • Aerial photographer
  • Brand consultant
  • Composer
  • Content provider
  • Editor
  • Creative director
  • Music, film, and theater critic
  • Director of music, film, television, and theater
  • Audio and video editor
  • Post Editor
  • Graphic designer
  • Illustrator
  • Event planner
  • Furniture designer
  • Journalist
  • Market analyst
  • Marketing specialist
  • Media planner
  • music director
  • Musician
  • New media specialist
  • Photographer
  • Photojournalist
  • Public Relations Specialist
  • Print media specialist
  • Screenwriters
  • Set and Exhibition Designer
  • Social Media Specialist
  • Social media influencer
  • special effects producer
  • Translator
  • Wardrobe stylist
  • Web developer
  • Web designer
  • Writer
  • Employee in education
  • Education Advisor
  • eLearning Advisor
  • Executive Coaching
  • Investigator
  • Coach
  • Technology employee
  • Freelancer Web, Mobile, Software Development and Architecture
  • Freelancer IT and Telecommunications Networks
  • Data science and analytics freelancer
  • Customer service freelancer
  • Design employee
  • Clothing designer
  • Conceptual designer
  • Costume designer
  • Fashion artist
  • Fashion designer
  • Image advisor
  • Fashion stylist
  • Stylist
  • Interior designer
  • Jewelry designer
  • Makeup artist
  • Object designer
  • Personal shopper
  • Textile designer
  • Visual Merchandiser
  • Wedding planner

However, remember that the permitted activity depends on the free zone in which you want to establish yourself as a freelancer.

Are there any specific documentation requirements for freelancers from certain countries?

Among the freelance visa requirements in UAE are the following documents that you must submit to the authorities:

  • Copy of your passport valid for at least 8 months
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Recent photography
  • Bank reference letter
  • NOC from your sponsor if you are employed in the country
  • Academic qualifications certified by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or the UAE Consulate in your home country
  • Portfolio or sample of your work for certain specialties

Are there any additional permits or licenses required for certain freelance activities in the UAE?

There are no additional requirements within the Freelance visa UAE requirements that include licenses or permits. This is because government authorities limit the activities that you can carry out as an independent worker. If you want to carry out activities that do not correspond to those permitted by a freelance work permit, you should apply for a professional license.

If you want more information regarding free zones and labor aspects in the UAE, just contact us.

title: How to Get a Freezone Trade License in Dubai?
content:
What if we told you that you could start your business in Dubai with 100% ownership, zero taxes, minimal hassle, and just one document? That golden ticket is called a freezone trade license. It’s opening doors for thousands of entrepreneurs across the UAE in 2026.

Dubai’s freezones are booming. They’re not just for massive corporations anymore. Freelancers, small business owners, and startups are diving in headfirst. Why? Because the process of getting a freezone trade license in Dubai is now faster, simpler, and more affordable than ever.

But here’s the catch: not everyone knows how to get it right the first time. In this guide, we’ll break it down for you, step by step. Whether you’re launching a tech startup or setting up a one-person consultancy, this is your blueprint.

What Is a Freezone Trade License?

A freezone trade license is an official document that allows businesses to operate legally in the freezone. It is issued by a Dubai freezone authority. Holding this license means you’re legally authorized to conduct business activities as per the trade license category, whether it’s trading, professional services, manufacturing, or other permitted business operations.

Unlike mainland licenses, a freezone license offers significant benefits:

  • 100% foreign ownership
  • Zero personal and corporate tax
  • Repatriation of capital and profits
  • Access to UAE and international markets
  • Full control without needing a local sponsor

For entrepreneurs and global investors looking for flexibility and minimal regulatory burdens, the Dubai freezone trade license is the ideal path.

Why Choose a Freezone in Dubai in 2026?

Dubai’s freezones have evolved dramatically. What started as hubs for big corporations has now become accessible to startups, freelancers, and remote entrepreneurs. Here’s why 2026 is the perfect time to apply for a freezone trade license Dubai:

1. Digitized Services

Freezone authorities now offer 100% digital processes from renewal applications. Licensing and company formation can be completed online within days.

2. More Affordable Packages

Freezones now offer scalable packages suitable for solo entrepreneurs, SMEs, and remote businesses. You can start with minimal capital and upgrade as you grow.

3. Flexible Office Options

Choose from virtual desks, flexi-desks, co-working spaces, or private offices. Many zones support virtual operations.

4. Sector-Specific Benefits

Certain freezones are optimized for industries like tech, media, e-commerce, finance, or logistics, giving access to relevant facilities and networking.

Types of Freezone Licenses You Can Get

When applying for a freezone trade license, it’s important to choose the type that matches your business activity. This ensures that your operations are legal and recognized by relevant authorities.

License Type Best For Common Activities
Commercial License Traders and e-commerce startups Import, export, distribution
Professional License Consultants and freelancers IT, marketing, education, design
Industrial License Manufacturing businesses Fabrication, processing, assembly
Media License Creative professionals and agencies Filmmaking, publishing, advertising
Tech Startup License Tech founders and digital entrepreneurs SaaS, development, AI, blockchain

Choosing the right license defines what you can legally offer or sell. Picking incorrectly may lead to fines or business restrictions.

Steps to Get a Freezone Trade License in Dubai

The process of acquiring a freezone trade license Dubai is straightforward if you know what to expect. Here are the key steps:

Step 1: Choose the Right Freezone

Dubai has over 30 active freezones, each tailored for different industries. Examples include:

  • Dubai Internet City: Ideal for tech and IT businesses
  • Dubai Media City For media, PR, and content firms
  • Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC): Best for trade and commodities
  • International Free Zone Authority (IFZA): Popular with SMEs and freelancers

Each zone has its authority, pricing, and benefits. Choose one that aligns with your business model and future goals.

Step 2: Define Your Business Activity

Pick from a list of approved activities provided by the chosen freezone authority. Your trade license will be based on this selection. Most zones allow more than one activity under a single license, which adds flexibility.

Step 3: Reserve Your Business Name

Register a trade name that is:

  • Relevant to your activity
  • Non-offensive and compliant with UAE naming laws
  • Unique and available in the registry

This reservation is usually valid for 60 days and must be completed before proceeding with licensing.

Step 4: Submit Required Documents

Commonly required documents include:

  • Passport copies of all shareholders
  • Passport-size photographs
  • Visa copy (if applicable)
  • Application form
  • Business plan (only for some activities)

Some freezones may ask for proof of residence or bank reference letters. Check with your zone authority.

Step 5: Pay the License Fees

Costs vary depending on:

  • Chosen freezone
  • Number of visas required
  • Office type (virtual, flexi, or private)

Basic packages with no visas can start from AED 5,750, while comprehensive ones with office space and multiple visas can go beyond AED 25,000.

Step 6: Get Your License Issued

After review and payment, your freezone trade license will be issued in 1 to 3 working days. You’ll also receive your establishment card and can start business operations immediately.

Getting a Freezone License Without Office Space Is Now Possible

 In 2026, setting up a business in Dubai without a physical office is more practical than ever. Freezones now offer virtual packages that allow entrepreneurs to run their companies entirely online. This approach is especially beneficial for:

  • Freelancers working from home
  • E-commerce stores
  • Digital service providers

You receive:

  • Official business address
  • Mail and document handling
  • Virtual desk assignment

This dramatically reduces overhead costs while maintaining full business legality.

How Much Does a Freezone Trade License Cost in 2026?

Here’s an updated cost breakdown to help you plan your budget:

Package Approx. Cost (AED) Includes
Basic (No visa) 5,750 – 9,000 License only, virtual office
Solo Entrepreneur (1 visa) 10,000 – 14,000 License + visa + shared desk
Startup Package (2-3 visas) 14,000 – 25,000 License + visas + office + PRO services

Promotional deals are often available during major business events such as Ramadan, GITEX, and year-end campaigns. Always ask your agent or consultant about available offers.

Can Expats and Foreigners Apply?

Yes, expats can apply for and own 100% of a business under a freezone trade license Dubai. This makes it a highly attractive option for international entrepreneurs looking to set up shop in the UAE.

You don’t need a local sponsor. You don’t even need to be in the country if you’re opting for a virtual package.

Do You Need a Visa with Your License?

It depends on your needs. You can apply for:

  • License without visa: Good for holding a company legally without residing in the UAE
  • Investor visa: For the license holder/owner
  • Employee visas: Based on quota and office space size

If you’re planning to live in Dubai, you’ll need to convert your license into a residency visa-supported license.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Setting up a business is exciting, but you should steer clear of these common pitfalls:

  • Picking a license that doesn’t match your actual business activity
  • Overpaying for office space you don’t need
  • Not checking visa eligibility before choosing a package
  • Choosing a freezone without comparing multiple options

Working with an expert team or consultancy can save you from delays and surprise expenses.

FAQs: Quick Answers You Need

Q: Can I open a bank account with a freezone license?
Yes. Most banks in Dubai accept license holders from reputable freezones. Documentation requirements may vary.

Q: Can I operate outside the freezone?
You can operate internationally. However, to sell products or services directly in the UAE mainland, you’ll need a distributor or a mainland license.

Q: How long is the license valid?
Typically, it’s valid for one year and can be renewed annually.

Why Connect FZ Is the Smartest Way to Get Licensed

Skip the stress, and go straight to success. That’s what Connect FZ does best.

When it comes to getting a freezone trade license, Connect FZ is your go-to business launch partner in Dubai. Their services go beyond just paperwork:

  • Personalized advice for your specific industry and goals
  • Package comparison across all major freezones
  • Fast-track processing in as little as 24 hours
  • Expert help with visas, banking, and renewals

They help you make smart decisions, avoid costly mistakes, and save time. Whether you’re a solopreneur or launching a new startup, Connect FZ has the insight and access to get you up and running.

Final Thoughts

The path to owning a business in Dubai is clearer and more rewarding than ever. With a freezone trade license, you can access global markets, enjoy full ownership, and grow your business in a city that thrives on innovation.

Whether you’re building an app, launching a consultancy, or running an e-commerce store, this is your time.

title: GDRFA Application Status
content:
Embarking on the journey to check the GDRFA application status and ascertain the status of your UAE visa is a pivotal step in navigating the intricacies of immigration processes. The General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA) plays a crucial role in managing visa-related matters in the UAE, and understanding how to monitor your application status online is essential.

In this article, we will guide you through the seamless process of checking your GDRFA visa status, offering a comprehensive overview of the steps involved and ensuring you stay well-informed about the progression of your UAE visa application. Whether you are a resident awaiting visa renewal or an expatriate monitoring a new application, knowing the ins and outs of the GDRFA application status system empowers you to stay in control of your immigration journey in the dynamic landscape of the United Arab Emirates.

GDRFA Smart Services

The General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA) seamlessly facilitates navigating the realm of visa applications and renewals in the United Arab Emirates. These digital platforms not only streamline the application process but also provide a user-friendly avenue to check your GDRFA approval status and your GDRFA application status.

  • Accessing GDRFA Application Status: Firstly, utilizing GDRFA Smart Services allows applicants to monitor their visa application status with ease. Upon submitting an application, individuals can actively track its progress in real-time through the online portal. This transparency fosters a sense of control and clarity in understanding where the application stands in the processing pipeline.
  • GDRFA Approval Status: Once the application undergoes evaluation, the GDRFA extend to offering a detailed insight into the approval status. This feature is invaluable, especially for individuals eagerly awaiting confirmation of their visa approval. By accessing the portal, applicants can promptly determine whether their application has received the coveted approval. It helps eliminating uncertainty and providing a definitive status update.
  • User-Friendly Interface: Moreover, one of the notable strengths of GDRFA Smart Services is the user-friendly interface. The platform has a simple design. This helps ensuring that individuals can effortlessly navigate through the various sections to check their GDRFA visa status. Good instructions and great design contribute to a perfect experience.
  • Efficiency and Time-Saving: GDRFA Smart Services are synonymous with efficiency, significantly reducing the time traditionally spent on manual processes. The digital nature of these services expedites the application and approval status checks. It allows individuals to stay informed without unnecessary delays.

As you can see, leveraging the GDRFA Smart Services for monitoring your application and approval status is a transformative experience in the landscape of immigration processes.

How To Check Your Online Dubai Visa Status Enquiry On The GDRFA Website?

Doing a GDRFA application status check is a straightforward process facilitated by the official website. To stay informed about the progress of your visa application, including the GDRFA application status and approval status, do this.

  • Navigate to the Visa Section: Moreover, locate the dedicated visa section on the GDRFA website. Typically, users find this in the main menu or navigation bar. Click on the relevant section to proceed.
  • Select “GDRFA Application Status Check”: Furthermore, within the visa section, you will find an option for checking the status of your application. Look for a link or button that mentions “GDRFA Application Status Check” or a similar phrase. Click on it to begin.
  • Enter Required Information: Once on the GDRFA application status check page, you’ll be prompted to enter specific details related to your application. This usually includes your application reference number, passport information, and other relevant details.
  • Submit the Inquiry: After entering the required information, submit your inquiry through the designated button. The system will process your request, and you will receive real-time information about your GDRFA visa status.
  • Check GDRFA Approval Status: Following the application status check, explore the portal further to determine your GDRFA approval status. Look for a section that specifically provides details on whether your visa application has been approved.
  • Monitor Updates: GDRFA frequently updates its systems, so it is advisable to monitor the website for any changes or additional information. Regularly checking your GDRFA visa status ensures you stay informed throughout the processing period.

Users can verify the details of their visa, including validity and approval status, through the designated online portal. This feature is particularly beneficial for those keen on ensuring their visa information aligns with their current circumstances.

Moreover, the GDRFA’s commitment to user convenience is evident in the simple navigation structure of its public services. Individuals can seamlessly explore various sections related to visa services. This makes it easy to check application status and conduct a GDRFA visa check without unnecessary complexities.

Furthermore, one of the key advantages of utilizing GDRFA public services is the availability of real-time updates. As users check their application status or perform a visa check, the system provides instant information. It helps ensuring that individuals are well-informed about the current status of their residency matters.

By offering these public services, GDRFA actively enhances user engagement in visa-related processes. Residents and expatriates can actively participate in monitoring their applications, conducting necessary checks, and staying updated on any developments. This helps fostering a sense of control and transparency in their immigration journey.

How to Check Application Status in GDRFA

To stay well-informed about the progression of your visa application, including both the GDRFA application status and approval status, you can follow these straightforward steps on the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA) website.

Firstly, start by visiting the official GDRFA website, where a user-friendly interface awaits. This platform serves as a comprehensive hub for various residency and visa-related services.

Next, locate the dedicated visa section on the GDRFA website. The main menu or navigation bar often prominently displays this section. Click on the relevant section to proceed with your inquiry.

Moreover, within the visa section, look for a specific option that mentions “Check Application Status.” Clicking on this option is your gateway to the intricacies of your visa application.

Furthermore, upon selecting the application status check option, the system will prompt you to input specific details related to your application. These details typically include your application reference number, passport information, and other pertinent details. Take a moment to make sure the information is accurate.

After providing the necessary details, submit your inquiry through the designated button. The system will efficiently process your request, offering you real-time insights into your GDRFA visa status.

Beyond the application status check, explore further within the GDRFA website to conduct a comprehensive visa check. This additional feature empowers you to verify various aspects of your visa, including its validity and approval status.

In addition, by actively utilizing the GDRFA platform, revel in the assurance of receiving real-time updates about your application and visa status. Designed to offer instant information, it ensures that you stay well-informed throughout the processing period.

Furthermore, upon selecting the application status check, the system will prompt you to input specific details related to your application. These details typically include your application reference number, passport information, and other pertinent details. Ensure the accuracy of the information entered.

Moreover, extend your exploration beyond application status by actively engaging in a comprehensive GDRFA visit visa status. This feature empowers you to verify crucial aspects, including the validity and approval status of your visa.

For those specifically concerned with visit visa status, continue your journey within the GDRFA website. Look for dedicated sections or options that explicitly provide insights into the status of your visit visa.

Utilizing the platform ensures that you receive real-time updates about your application and GDRFA visit visa status. Designed to offer instant information, it enables you to stay well-informed throughout the processing period.

How Can I Do A Dubai Visa Check By Passport Number Only?

Getting on a Dubai visa check solely through your passport number is a streamlined process facilitated by the GDRFA. To navigate through your GDRFA application status and GDRFA visit visa status effortlessly, begin by visiting the official GDRFA website. This centralized platform offers a plethora of services catering to residency and visas, making it the ideal starting point.

Look for the specific option that invites you to Check Visa Status – a crucial feature for initiating your inquiry. As you enter the visa status check section, you’ll encounter a prompt to input your passport number. This will serve as the unique identifier for your visa-related inquiry.

Moreover, upon submitting your passport number, the system efficiently redirects you to a page displaying your GDRFA application status. It will offer you comprehensive details about the processing status of your visa application. To delve even further, explore the portal to check your GDRFA visit visa status. In there, you will gain valuable insights into the approval and validity of your visit visa.

Furthermore, this approach ensures that you can perform a visa check seamlessly, utilizing your passport number as the sole credential. The user-friendly interface of the GDRFA website enhances the experience. It allows you to stay well-informed about both your application status and visit visa status without the need for additional information. By actively engaging with this process, individuals can take charge of monitoring and managing their visa-related matters in Dubai, fostering a more informed and empowered experience.

Process to Cancel the Visa Online With GDRFA Portal

Canceling a visa online through the GDRFA portal is a streamlined process. Firstly, begin by accessing the GDRFA website and navigating to the visa services section. Moreover, after checking your GDRFA application status, proceed to the specific option for cancelation. Input the required details, including your visa information.

Once submitted, the system provides real-time updates, allowing you to monitor both your GDRFA visit visa status seamlessly. This user-friendly approach empowers individuals to efficiently manage their visa matters online, ensuring a hassle-free experience.

title: What is General Trading in the UAE? All You Need to Know
content:
When setting up a company in any UAE jurisdiction, investors will have the option to apply for a license. Although there is a wide range of them, each license covers different business activities. The general trading in the UAE can only be covered by the general trading license. If you desire to trade a variety of goods, this is the license you need.

In this article, you will learn everything you should know about this special license and the benefits it offers. Besides, you can discover relevant information about the steps of the application process for this license in the UAE. Moreover, you will find other important details regarding this document that you should be aware of. Let’s observe:

What is a General Trading License and How Does it Work in the UAE?

One of the most important elements that all companies in the UAE need to operate is a business license. This is a legal document that permits companies and businesses to trade and offer their services in the country. However, there are many types of business licenses available, and each of them has different functions.

If you’re looking forward to setting up a trading business in the UAE, you will need a  UAE general trading license. This license will allow you to trade a variety of products and goods within the country. Nonetheless, you can only obtain this license after applying for a commercial or trading license.

Although the trading license has similar functions as the general trading license, there are some key differences between them. Firstly, the license for general trading in the UAE allows investors to trade a larger number of goods. Besides, it also allows them to trade different kinds of products, which means that they don’t have to be related.

However, there are certain products that you cannot trade with this license because it does not cover them. Some of those goods could be medical or healthcare products, alcoholic drinks, vehicles, among many others. Therefore, it is essential to know what is general trading in the UAE and what products are allowed.

Why You Should Apply for this Type of Business License?

Obtaining this license for general trading in the UAE can bring you several advantages that you should know about. The main function of this license is already a huge benefit compared to the normal trading license. Nonetheless, here you will learn some valid reasons why you should apply for a general trading license:

  • Firstly, you must know that the application process for this license is quite easy. Besides, the setup process is also a straightforward procedure that you can complete without hassles. And the best part is that you can select your ideal business location and get a license there.
  • Secondly, it is possible to apply for this license at an affordable price. However, this will mostly depend on the business location you choose, which could be a free zone or mainland.
  • Another great advantage of having this license is that it makes easier the acquisition of several visas. Not to mention that it also allows investors and entrepreneurs to sponsor dependents.

You’ll be able to see more benefits below and with brief explanations to understand them better.

You can Set Up Anywhere with Ease.

Setting up your company in any location in UAE is a simple process, and it can be even easier. Due to many different initiatives, the business setup process and the application process for a license became straightforward procedures. One of the advantages of this is that investors can meet the eligibility criteria for a license.

Besides, it is possible to complete the registration process within a few minutes without committing to a lease agreement. On the other hand, investors can freely choose their business location in the UAE. Furthermore, the license for general trading in the UAE allows them to take on both warehouse and office space anywhere in the country.

The Setup Costs are Affordable.

Obtaining this license is also an affordable option that allows your business to operate efficiently. Depending on the location you select, a general trading license can be obtained starting from AED 17,000 approximately. However, it could depend on other details of your company, such as its requirements or other elements.

The total business setup cost is unlikely to exceed AED 100,000 in popular locations like free zones. Nonetheless, you can obtain more information with a specialist if it is necessary.

It Allows You to Apply for Multiple Visas.

Understanding the general trading meaning and the license benefits will allow you to find more advantages of it. For instance, large companies with great numbers of workers might need several visas to cover their needs. By having a general trading license, investors with mainland companies can obtain multiple visas for their employees.

However, it is important to consider the required office space that depends on the number of visas. There is a rule that requires having at least 100 square feet of office space or warehouse space per visa.

Investors Can Sponsor Dependents Easily.

Besides getting visas for your employees, this license also permits you to sponsor your dependents to obtain their visas. Investors can obtain visas for their spouses, children, maids, and drivers by following a simple process. This process involves the following steps:

  • Obtaining an entry permit.
  • Completing the status adjustment procedure.
  • Completing a medical fitness test.
  • Registering for the Emirates ID.
  • And completing the visa stamping procedure.

Barriers to Entry are Lower with this License.

Besides the previous benefits, having a license for general trading in the UAE also provides low barriers to business ownership. And it could be in many different ways, including minimal upfront costs, no paid-up share capital requirement, and many more. Moreover, general trading companies do not need to undergo an audit per year.

Nonetheless, you can request special business services from professionals to enter the market in an easier way. But that is an unrelated matter when it comes to the general trading license.

You’ll be Able to Set Up with Multiple Shareholders.

And lastly, there is another huge reason why this license is so popular among entrepreneurs that own large companies. This is regarding the possibility of setting up their businesses with multiple shareholders at the same time. Generally, the accepted number of allowed shareholders is 50, though there is not an official upper limit on it.

On the other hand, it is also possible to count on different types of shareholders when operating a business. You are free to choose between individuals and corporate entities as shareholders of your company. As we have mentioned before, it’s always highly recommendable to consult with a specialist to obtain better results for your business.

How Can You Apply for a General Trading License in Dubai, UAE?

There are two main ways in which you can obtain a license for general trading in the UAE. The first one is obtaining your license from the Dubai Economy, which is the ideal option for mainland companies. And the second one is from the Free Zone Authority, which is your option if you’re in a free zone.

In any case, this is the process you must complete:

  • Choose a jurisdiction and business activities. Remember to consider the activities under general trading license in Dubai or other emirates.
  • Select a trade name for your business.
  • Fill out the initial approval and then submit it to the relevant authorities.
  • Obtain the necessary approvals to continue the process.
  • Gather all required documents and submit them to the authorities.
  • Get the Tenancy Contract and Ejari.
  • Obtain your trade license after submitting all documents and paying all fees.
  • And lastly, apply for a residence visa and open a business bank account.

Dubai General Trading License: What Documents are Needed?

Before you start the application process to obtain a general trading license in Dubai, you need to gather certain documents. Some of the most important documents that you will have to submit are the following ones:

  • A signed and duly filled application for the general trading license.
  • Passport copies of all the shareholders involved.
  • The shareholder agreement.
  • The MOA (Memorandum of Association).
  • Your trade name approval letter after the pertinent authorities attested it.

There could be other additional requirements too, but that will depend on the business location you set up in. Also, it could depend on the kind of business that you establish in Dubai.

How much can cost this Type of Business License in Dubai?

Many different elements could influence the cost of a general trading license in Dubai. For example, the most outstanding element that tends to be relevant is the location. Depending on the free zone you choose, the cost could range between AED 15,000 and AED 40,000. Nonetheless, there are other elements that might influence too, such as your business activities.

You must keep in mind that this license is only valid for one year, which means you must renew it annually. Having said that, you need to consider the cost of the renewal process and cover it. Similarly, this cost will vary according to several elements, including the ones we previously mentioned. The renewal cost is approximately between AED 8,000 and AED 15,000.

Applying for a general trading license in the UAE can be a lot easier if you request help from professionals. With Connectfz, you’ll be able to select your business location and apply for this license at affordable prices. Besides, you can also choose between different packages that contain a variety of elements, including visas, Flexi-desks, and more.

Moreover, you can also obtain the guidance and recommendations you need to select the most suitable choices. For instance, our team can help you select the business location that suits your business better. After that, we will complete your company setup process on your behalf, allowing you to focus on more important things.

Furthermore, you are free to request other different services to make your company more efficient and operate it easily. For example, we will help you for company formation in Dubai Mainland and also in the freezones, Visa Services in Dubai and all over the UAE, UAE Business Consultancy, and other related services.

title: Procedure to get a general trading license in dubai
content:
Any entrepreneur who wants to set up a business in the UAE should have a general trading license. If you have multiple trading activities in the same or different industries, this license comes in handy, since it covers it all. However, you still need to know the basics about it and how to get one. There´s a certain number of steps and procedures needed to get a general trading license in Dubai.

Getting a general trading license in Dubai doesn´t necessarily have to be a difficult procedure. It can be made simpler by working with the help of a company formation specialist. The specialist you work with should be able to handle your application for you. Nonetheless, most licenses in Dubai/UAE are pretty self-explanatory.

In this article, we´ll cover just that. We´ll talk about the basics of a general trading license in Dubai, and the procedures needed to get one. We´ll cover:

1. What is a general trading license?

As mentioned before, a general trading license in Dubai allows you to cover multiple trading activities. A general trading license allows a company to export, re-export, import, or trade different types of products. Some examples of these types of products are foodstuff, electronics, electrical items under one roof, furniture, etc.

Usually, this type of license is expensive in the mainland. However, if you´re a businessman that sells different products or goods, it´s recommended for you to apply for one. This will make you able to enjoy all these benefits without needing to apply for separate licenses.

Trading of alcohol, medicine, cars, chemicals, etc. cannot be done through this type of license. In the UAE, you require special approval from concerned government authorities or municipalities. However, the DED (Department of Economic Development) can approve these kinds of activities through a commercial trade license.

As said before, a general trading license can be expensive. The minimum investment you need to set up an LLC company is AED 300.000. You don´t need to show a bank guarantee but you do need to mention it in the MOA (Memorandum of Association). During the 1rst year, the approximate government cost for the license is AED 25.000, from the second year onwards it will be around AED 15.000.

2. How to obtain a general trading license in Dubai

Now you know what a general trading license is; however, you might be left wondering how to get a general trading license. There are 9 simple steps you need to do to apply and get a general trading license in Dubai. These are:

  • Trading business location.
  • Company structure.
  • Business activities.
  • Application and approvals.
  • Documentation.
  • Tenancy contract.
  • The final application to the DED.
  • License fee payments.
  • Submission of original documents.

2.1. Trading business location

You´ll need to choose your business location. In Dubai, there are 3 options to choose from; mainland, free zones, or offshore, each one with its own benefits. Your first step is to choose the location.

Firstly, there is the mainland. The main benefit of setting up a company in Dubai mainland is the freedom it gives you. It gives you the authorization to trade across Dubai and the UAE, as well as trade internationally and expands your presence. In addition to this, it also gives you the ability to deal with the UAE government, giving you the scope to tender bids for lucrative government contracts.

Secondly, there are the free zones. They have plenty of benefits that tempt entrepreneurs. The main benefit is that a free zone company gives you 100% foreign ownership. In addition to this, it also gives 100% repatriation of capital and profits and corporate and personal income tax exemptions. Lastly, it exempts you from import and export duties, though you can´t import into UAE Mainland

Last but not least, there´s the offshore. In this location, you won´t pay corporate tax, and like the free zone, it gives you 100% foreign ownership. It also ensures your protection, as it gives you protected assets and lawsuit protection, and complete privacy. You´ll need to take each location´s benefits into account and choose where you want to do business.

2.2. Company Structure

After you choose your location, you´ll need to choose an appropriate trade name and the legal structure for your company. However, you need to follow the regulations to choose each one.

Firstly, there´s your trade name. Before you choose one, there are many regulations to take into account. For example, the name of your business can´t contradict the activities it does and shouldn´t be already reserved by another company.  In addition to this, the name can´t contain obscene or curse words or religious content, etc. Follow these regulations accordingly and choose your trade name.

Secondly, there is the business structure of your company. There are many types of businesses structure you can go for. The most common ones are an LLC, sole proprietorship, partnership, and civil company.

2.3. Business Activities

After choosing your business´ name and structure, you´ll need to choose and specify which activities your business will do. You´ll choose the activities that you wish to include in the business license. Nevertheless, you need to take into account that you have a maximum of 10 business activities per license.

For example, here are some businesses activities that you can include in a general trading license in Dubai:

  • Sales.
  • Marketing.
  • Finance.
  • Accounting.
  • Customer service.

title: Grace Period After Visa Cancellation in the UAE: Complete 2026 Guide
content:
If you’re an expat, knowing your UAE grace period after visa cancellation is essential. The investors, students, and families should also be aware of it. Beneficial when your job ended, your visa expired, or you’re planning a status change. Staying updated on your legality helps you avoid fines. You no longer face unnecessary bans and stress.

The UAE has introduced more flexible post-cancellation timelines. Now, you’ll enjoy the grace periods from 30 to 180 days. It’s enough time to think about your future plans. But it depends on your visa type.

What Is the Grace Period After Visa Cancellation?

The grace period after visa cancellation is the legal time to stay. It is allowed for individuals to stay in the UAE after their residence visa has been officially canceled/expires. During this window, they can either:

  • Exit the country
  • Change their visa status, or
  • Apply for a new residency without penalties.

The grace period begins only after the cancellation is approved in the immigration system. It does not work when the individuals resign or stop working. Any stay is considered illegal after the grace period ends. It is subject to daily fines and additional consequences.

Grace Period Duration by Visa Type – 30 to 180 Days Explained

The UAE grace periods after visa cancellation start from one month to six months. The duration depends on your visa type. Standard work visas typically offer around thirty to ninety days’ grace. The time is given by the UAE to renew or exit the country. However, Golden and Green Visa holders often get up to six months’ time to change status or leave. On the other hand, Visit/tourist visas usually don’t have a grace period. It means that on your visa expiration or cancellation, you’ll face the fines immediately.

Grace Period After Employment Visa Cancellation:

The grace period after employment visa cancellation falls between one month and six months. Standard work visas usually offer ninety days. However, higher-skilled roles or specific categories may receive extended periods. Shorter grace periods may apply in limited circumstances. On the other hand, longer durations are common for professionals transitioning to new roles.

Investor, Partner & Business Owner Visas:

Investor and partner visa holders generally receive a six-month grace period. This extended timeframe allows business owners to renew their existing visa. They can restructure their company and switch to another long-term residency option. During this period, status changes can often be completed without exiting the UAE.

Golden Visa & Green Visa Holders:

Golden Visa and Green Visa holders benefit from maximum flexibility. Both visa types come with six month grace period. It gives ample time for renewal or transition. Family members sponsored under these visas also receive aligned grace periods. This makes sure that dependents remain legally resident during the process.

Family, Dependent & Student Visas:

Grace periods differ based on sponsorship:

  • Family and dependent visas usually allow up to 180 days
  • Students sponsored by parents receive a similar six-month window
  • Institution-sponsored students typically have a shorter grace period after graduation

Always verify individual visa conditions to avoid confusion.

Tourist / Visit Visas – No Grace Period Rule:

UAE tourist and visit visas do not offer any grace period after they expire. Overstay fines begin immediately from the first day after expiry. You have to pay the fines daily. As a traveler, you must exit the UAE before your visa expires. However, you have another option to extend your visa. So that you skip penalties. Only rare exceptions may temporarily waive fines. Official flight cancellations or airport closures are included.

Overstay Fines After Grace Period Ends:

Daily fines of 50 dirhams are charged for overstaying. The fines must be paid after the grace period ends. If you overstay, be ready to pay an exit permit fee. Pay around 250 to 300 dirhams as an exit permit fee. Continuing overstays may lead to travel bans. You may also face difficulties in future visa approvals. You should clear fines promptly to avoid legal complications and delays at exit.

Daily Fine Structure & Exit Permit Fees:

Overstaying in the UAE leads you to pay fines for extended illegal stay and exit permit fees. You will face fines of around 50 dirhams per day for each day overstayed. While the exit permit fee will also be charged between 250 and 300 dirhams when leaving the UAE. Overstay fines continue to accumulate until you exit or regularize your status.

Travel Ban & Re-Entry Consequences:

Extended overstays or improper exits may result in immigration holds. You’ll be restricted from re-entry, which will cause you to face re-entry restrictions. The consequences can be more severe and may lead to the potential future visa rejection. Planning ahead helps avoid long-term consequences.

Steps to Check Grace Period After Visa Cancellation:

Knowing how to check the grace period after visa cancellation assures you don’t rely on assumptions. It gives you a clear idea of how much time you have to stay in the UAE. You can plan ahead if you are aware of the timeframe left. Planning makes it easier for you to take further steps. We’ve shared the procedure involved to check your grace period after your visa expires or is canceled.

Check Your Status via ICP / GDRFA Platforms:

Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official ICP or GDRFA portal
  2. Select visa status inquiry
  3. Enter passport or Emirates ID details
  4. Complete verification and submit

You’ll see and check your visa status along with “allowed days to stay”. This reflects your remaining grace period.

Common Reasons Your Grace Period May Differ:

Grace periods may vary due to visa category and profession, sponsorship type, policy updates, special cases, and individual immigration history. It is suggested that one always rely on official records rather than assumptions.

Can You Extend or Change Status During the Grace Period?

You can extend or change your visa status during the grace period. You can do so even without leaving the UAE. Switch to a new employment, freelance, investor, or family visa if eligibility requirements are met. Most status changes can be completed in-country through ICP or GDRFA. Submit your application with the required documents. However, you must exit the UAE before the grace period ends if a status change isn’t approved in time. If you don’t exit the UAE within the given timeframe, you’ll face fines.

Changing Visa Type Without Leaving the UAE:

Most visa holders are permitted to change or renew their visa status. They can do so while they are inside the UAE during the grace period. The steps that are taken in a timely manner will save them from exit fees and unnecessary travel.

When Exit + Re-Entry Is Required:

Exit and re-entry may be required if documentation is incomplete. It is also required when eligibility criteria aren’t met, and immigration rules require external processing. Consulting early prevents last-minute complications.

What Happens If You Don’t Cancel Your Visa Properly?

Leaving the United Arab Emirates without proper visa cancellation can result in serious issues. This happened especially in the case of employment visas. Employers may file an absconding report. This leads to immigration bans, legal complications, and arrest upon re-entry. Always make sure you officially cancel the visa in uae before departure. So that you can save yourself from serious consequences.

What to Do After Visa Cancellation: Your Next Options

Various options are available for you if your visa is cancelled. However, it depends on your budget, requirements and other crucial factors. If your employment visa is canceled, you can find another job and obtain a new work visa. There’s also a possibility that you can switch to another visa type. But if nothing works, you only have one option left: to leave the UAE before your grace period ends. This will save you from fines and penalties. Early departures will skip the future complications.

Apply for a New Job or Sponsorship:

Secure a new employer and process a fresh residence visa within your grace period.

Switch to a Freelance or Investor Visa:

Independent professionals and entrepreneurs can transition to self-sponsored residency options.

Exit the UAE Before the Grace Period Ends:

If no alternatives apply, leaving before expiry prevents fines and future complications.

FAQs:

How many days of grace period do I get after visa cancellation?

You will get around 30 to 180 days’ grace period after your visa is cancelled. The duration depends on your visa type.

Does everyone receive 180 days grace period?

Extended periods apply mainly to:

  • Investors
  • Golden Visa
  • Green Visa, and
  • Certain family visas.

Can I stay in the UAE without a job during the grace period?

You can stay in the UAE as long as you remain within your permitted grace period.

How to check the grace period after visa cancellation online?

Check the grace period online by using the ICP or GDRFA portals. This way, you can view your allowed days to stay.

How much is the fine for overstaying in the UAE for a canceled visa?

Overstaying in the UAE will cost you around 50 dirhams per day. An exit permit fee of 250 to 300 dirhams is also charged.

Can I cancel a visa in one day?

In rare cases (emergencies, VIP services), yes—for a premium fee.

What if the employee is on vacation during cancellation?

Submit their passport copy and flight itinerary. No need to recall them.

Can I rehire someone after canceling their visa?

Absolutely! Apply for a new residence visa in UAE like any fresh hire.

Final Thoughts: Plan Your Next Step Before the Grace Period Ends

The grace period after visa cancellation is your opportunity to reset. You should not waste this time and plan wisely. There are plenty of options to think about. Plan to switch visas, find a new job, or leave the UAE. Acting early helps you avoid fines. You can skip unusual bans and roam stress-free.

Unsure about timelines, status changes, or next steps? Hire professional guidance today. They can make the process smooth and risk-free. Connect with Connnectfz for expert support. We will manage your visa journey from start to finish confidently.

Switch to a new employment, freelance, investor, or family visa if eligibility requirements are met. Most status changes can be completed in-country through ICP or GDRFA. Submit your application with the required documents. However, you must exit the UAE before the grace period ends if a status change isn’t approved in time. If you don’t exit the UAE within the given timeframe, you’ll face fines.

Changing Visa Type Without Leaving the UAE:

Most visa holders are permitted to change or renew their visa status. They can do so while they are inside the UAE during the grace period. The steps that are taken in a timely manner will save them from exit fees and unnecessary travel.

When Exit + Re-Entry Is Required:

Exit and re-entry may be required if documentation is incomplete. It is also required when eligibility criteria aren’t met, and immigration rules require external processing. Consulting early prevents last-minute complications.

What Happens If You Don’t Cancel Your Visa Properly?

Leaving the United Arab Emirates without proper visa cancellation can result in serious issues. This happened especially in the case of employment visas. Employers may file an absconding report. This leads to immigration bans, legal complications, and arrest upon re-entry. Always make sure you officially cancel the visa in uae before departure. So that you can save yourself from serious consequences.

What to Do After Visa Cancellation: Your Next Options

Various options are available for you if your visa is cancelled. However, it depends on your budget, requirements and other crucial factors. If your employment visa is canceled, you can find another job and obtain a new work visa. There’s also a possibility that you can switch to another visa type. But if nothing works, you only have one option left: to leave the UAE before your grace period ends. This will save you from fines and penalties. Early departures will skip the future complications.

Apply for a New Job or Sponsorship:

Secure a new employer and process a fresh residence visa within your grace period.

Switch to a Freelance or Investor Visa:

Independent professionals and entrepreneurs can transition to self-sponsored residency options.

Exit the UAE Before the Grace Period Ends:

If no alternatives apply, leaving before expiry prevents fines and future complications.

FAQs:

How many days of grace period do I get after visa cancellation?

You will get around 30 to 180 days’ grace period after your visa is cancelled. The duration depends on your visa type.

Does everyone receive 180 days grace period?

Extended periods apply mainly to:

  • Investors
  • Golden Visa
  • Green Visa, and
  • Certain family visas.

Can I stay in the UAE without a job during the grace period?

You can stay in the UAE as long as you remain within your permitted grace period.

How to check the grace period after visa cancellation online?

Check the grace period online by using the ICP or GDRFA portals. This way, you can view your allowed days to stay.

How much is the fine for overstaying in the UAE for a canceled visa?

Overstaying in the UAE will cost you around 50 dirhams per day. An exit permit fee of 250 to 300 dirhams is also charged.

Can I cancel a visa in one day?

In rare cases (emergencies, VIP services), yes—for a premium fee.

What if the employee is on vacation during cancellation?

Submit their passport copy and flight itinerary. No need to recall them.

Can I rehire someone after canceling their visa?

Absolutely! Apply for a new residence visa in UAE like any fresh hire.

Final Thoughts: Plan Your Next Step Before the Grace Period Ends

The grace period after visa cancellation is your opportunity to reset. You should not waste this time and plan wisely. There are plenty of options to think about. Plan to switch visas, find a new job, or leave the UAE. Acting early helps you avoid fines. You can skip unusual bans and roam stress-free.

title: Everything you need to know About Gratuity Law UAE
content:
Years of dedicated service in the UAE are rewarded through an end-of-service benefit known as gratuity. Saying goodbye to your years of hard work comes with a financial reward, known as the gratuity. This is an end-of-service benefit, entitled to every employee who has passed a certain number of years working with an organization. This right is effective under the UAE gratuity law. No matter what industry you have been a part of, take advantage of this law. If you are new to hearing this term, this simplified version has got you covered, minus all complexities and stress. 

What you will unfold in this guide;

  • Understanding the end-of-service law 
  • The eligibility criteria
  • The accurate calculation as per the law
  • Rules and responsibilities of both employers and employees
  • The latest update to the law 2025

Understanding UAE Gratuity Law: What It Means for You

The UAE gratuity law is designed to support employees financially when their service ends. Gratuity entitlement is governed by Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations.

Employees who complete one full year of continuous service are entitled to a lump sum payment. This payout is calculated based on your basic salary and the number of years you’ve worked.

It’s important to note that gratuity is separate from your salary or any other benefits. It’s meant to help you transition smoothly into your next phase, whether you’re switching jobs or returning to your home country.

Who Is Eligible for Gratuity in the UAE?

Gratuity is not for everyone. The law sets clear rules about who qualifies. Here’s a quick breakdown:

  • You must have completed at least one year of continuous service.
  • You should be on a limited or unlimited employment contract.
  • You must not have been terminated for disciplinary reasons under Article 44 of the UAE Labour Law.

If you resigned before completing a full year, you won’t be eligible. But once you hit the one-year mark, the benefit kicks in, and it grows with time.

How Is UAE Gratuity Calculation Done?

Being an employee, you should understand the UAE gratuity calculation beforehand. This helps you plan your finances for the future better. 

Gratuity Calculation as per UAE Labour Law

Under the current UAE Labour Law, all private-sector employment contracts are fixed-term contracts. The previous distinction between limited and unlimited contracts no longer applies.

Manual Method to Calculate UAE Gratuity

If you prefer to calculate your end-of-service benefits manually instead of using an online calculator, here’s a simple 3-step method:

Step 1:
 Calculate your daily basic salary:
 Basic Salary ÷ 30

Step 2:
 Multiply by 21 or 30 (based on your years of service):
 Daily Salary × 21 (for 1–5 years)
 Daily Salary × 30 (for over 5 years)

Step 3:
 Multiply by the number of years you’ve worked:
 Annual Gratuity × Total Years of Service

Limited and Unlimited Contracts: What’s the Difference?

Here’s a quick comparison of how gratuity is handled under each type of contract in the UAE:

Feature Unlimited Contract Limited Contract
Gratuity on Completion Full gratuity paid if employee resigns after 5 years Full gratuity paid if the full term is completed
Contract Duration No fixed end date Fixed term (e.g., 2 years)
Early Resignation Gratuity may be reduced based on service years May lead to reduced or no gratuity
Termination (Without any reason) Entitled to gratuity based on service duration Entitled to gratuity based on service duration
Employee-Friendly Flexibility More flexible for resignations and job changes Less flexible, bound to the contract term

Always review your employment contract closely. Understanding these differences ensures you know exactly what to expect when your job ends.

Key Employer and Employee Obligations under UAE Gratuity Law

Both employees and employers, both parties should understand and practice their roles and responsibilities towards each other at work. This leaves no room for confusion and indifference in end-of-service gratuity calculation and processing. The UAE Labour Law represents: 

Employee Rights:

  • Employees have the right to access complete disclosure. They can request a breakdown of their gratuity calculation and understand how the final figure is derived.
  • Employees can file a complaint with the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE). If the employer fails to pay the gratuity.
  • Employees can choose to opt into the Gratuity Savings Scheme, where gratuity is deposited in an investment fund for better returns or savings. (2025 law)

Employer Responsibilities:

  • Employers need to take care of timely payment. They must calculate and pay the gratuity within 14 days after the employee’s last working day.
  • The gratuity must be calculated accurately, based solely on the employee’s last basic salary, excluding bonuses, commissions, and allowances.
  • The employer has to define the type of contract (limited or unlimited) in writing to avoid disputes.
  • Employers cannot deduct gratuity without providing any explanation. The termination must fall under Article 44 (disciplinary dismissal), or there must be proven financial losses caused by the employee.

Both parties are encouraged to keep thorough documentation — contracts, salary slips, and communication records. This ensures clarity and legal compliance throughout the employment relationship.

Recent Updates to UAE Gratuity Regulations

The most significant update to UAE gratuity regulations came into effect in February 2022 under Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021. The law standardized employment contracts into fixed-term agreements and confirmed full gratuity entitlement after one year of continuous service. Another change is;

  • Gratuity Savings Scheme 

An employee can decide not to take a lump sum amount and deposit the gratuity amount into a savings or investment plan. The employer agrees to it. This way, employees can grow their end-of-service benefits over time.

What Can Affect Your Gratuity Payout?

Several factors can impact the final amount. The foremost is unpaid leave, which is usually excluded from your total service duration. Employees dismissed for gross misconduct under Article 44 of the UAE Labour Law may lose their entitlement to gratuity. If the termination occurs based on poor discipline, the employee can lose the right to gratuity.

If you leave the company before the agreed contract period, this may reduce your chances of getting a payout. Also, the amount is dependent upon the type of contract, i.e., limited vs. unlimited contracts, as they both are treated differently.

Always keep your records safe, like payslips and contract copies. These can help in case of any disputes.

Gratuity Payment Timeline

Once you leave a job, your employer must settle your gratuity quickly. The UAE Labour Law mandates payment within 14 days of your end date. If the employer delays, you can file a complaint with the MOHRE.

Your final settlement may also include pending salary. The unused leave balance and any overtime dues are considered too.  

Know Your Rights and Plan Ahead

Gratuity is the deserving reward of your time, commitment, endless efforts, and sincere service. The UAE gratuity law helps you move forward and plan your future in a better way while avoiding any unpleasant surprises. You can manage your expenses even after your job ends with this beneficial payout, whether you were employed under a limited or unlimited contract. T

The new gratuity law in the UAE 2025 adds more transparency and flexibility. It’s now easier than ever to take control of your end-of-service benefits.

If you’re unsure about your rights or need help calculating your gratuity, consult an HR expert or legal advisor. It’s your money, make sure you get every dirham you’ve earned.

FAQs

Can I get gratuity if I’m on a part-time contract?

Yes. Part-time employees are entitled to gratuity on a pro-rata basis, calculated according to their working hours compared to full-time employment..

Is there a cap on gratuity?

Yes. The total gratuity amount cannot exceed the equivalent of 24 months of the employee’s basic salary.

Do bonuses and commissions count?

No. The gratuity is calculated based on your basic salary only.
