content:
Are you seeking a real estate agent career in Dubai? You must acquire the RERA license and certificate to enter this prosperous property market and establish a flourishing career.

There is a maximum potential for success in the UAE market, which is now growing at a rapid pace. Although this is a usual trend in the Dubai market, multiple authorities have imposed diverse restrictions on specific industries. RERA regulates the Dubai real estate market. To practice real estate brokerage or establish a real estate company in Dubai, you must first acquire a RERA license and certificate.

This article explores the essential information about the RERA certificate in Dubai from each perspective and its importance.

RERA License and Certificate for Real Estate Business in Dubai: An Overview

You could gain new business prospects, increase your standing, and legitimize your expertise with a RERA license and certificate in Dubai. The country’s property listing websites strictly forbid postings from unauthorized or unqualified brokers. It implies that obtaining a license is an essential initial step for every real estate agent or broker.

Otherwise, there might be legal ramifications and hazards. You can reach more prospects, close more property deals, and make more commissions by getting your RERA license and certificate. Additionally, sellers are more inclined to trust you as an RERA-licensed and accredited agent, which leads to more listings for you to handle.

Dubai RERA License Explained:

By regulating the real estate industry and ensuring that all transactions are executed ethically and openly, RERA influences the property market. Real Estate businesses operating in Dubai must have an RERA certificate. Their dedication to ethical conduct, skill level, and expertise are all apparent.

You need to fulfill the requirements given by the RERA to get a certificate in Dubai. In addition to passing a rigorous test, you need to have the necessary job experience and meet the minimum educational level. Furthermore, businesses must adhere to standards that require them to be actually present, hire competent agents, and maintain accurate financial records.

What is the RERA Certificate in Dubai?

The RERA certificate is a property business license. Real estate professionals can acquire this certificate by passing a specific RERA test. This certificate is a legal requirement for all real estate agents and business owners to operate legitimately in Dubai’s lucrative property sector. This test clearance ensures that the professionals have sufficient knowledge of the real estate sector’s legislation and ethical standards to secure property clients and investors through stable business practices.

RERA Significance: Its Primary Role in the Real Estate Market in Dubai

The Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA) is operating under the Dubai Land Department (DLD) to supervise the property market in terms of regulation, licensing, and enforcement of laws. Transparency, investment protection, and transaction monitoring are RERA’s responsibilities.

The objectives of RERA in Dubai include the establishment of a real estate market framework, the abolition of fraud, and the enforcement of ethical practices. Builders, leasing agents, landlords, and property brokers in Dubai are all required to register with RERA to stay in compliance with the rules while maintaining market transparency.

RERA in Dubai: Major Responsibilities and Functions

Responsibilities of RERA in the Real Estate Sector:

RERA has significant responsibilities and functionality to control and regulate real estate sector transactions. They ensure legal adherence for property sale and purchase, leasing or tenancy, and real estate ownership transfer.

They are liable to issue licenses and monitor property transactions. They are also responsible for conducting financial audits on real estate firms. They enforce tenancy registration and authorize property agreements that legally abide by the law to secure investors and tenants in the Emirates.

Functions of RERA in the Dubai Real Estate Sector:

Let’s dive into the details of RERA functions for the real estate sector in Dubai.

Regulation and Registration:

Ensures that real estate agents, builders, and management firms are properly licensed and certified. To get their license, real estate agents and brokers must complete a course recognized by RERA and pass a test to get the RERA certificate in Dubai.

Supervision of Off-Plan Projects:

Establishes escrow accounts as a means to protect investors’ capital.

Market Governance for Rentals: 

Maintains the RERA Rental Index fair by monitoring prices.

Agreements Standards:

Enforces the use of obligatory RERA forms to ensure the authenticity of property transactions.

Dispute Settlement: 

RERA directs the Dubai Rental Dispute Settlement Center for the resolution of conflicts and disputes.

What are the Primary Prerequisites to Get a RERA Certificate in Dubai?

A high school diploma is required, and you must be twenty-one or older, to apply for a broker card or a RERA certificate in Dubai.

The required procedure comprises:

Acquiring a current UAE resident visa for foreign nationals living abroad.

Participating in and effectively completing DREI’s certified training for property brokers program.

Acquiring the necessary information to pass the RERA exam, which assesses ethics and regional laws.

Applying for the broker card using the DLD’s system and submitting an appropriate Character Certificate from the Dubai Police.

Get the RERA Certificate with Simple Steps without Hazards

How to get the RERA certificate in Dubai? To prove one’s competence in the real estate industry, RERA requires a formal procedure. Follow these simple steps to acquire the RERA certificate in Dubai. 

Resident Security:

A valid UAE resident visa is required for non-GCC citizens before they may apply.

Fulfill the Requirements:

Get your high school diploma or its equivalent and ensure you’re at least twenty-one years old.

Get your Certification:

Get yourself enrolled in the Dubai Real Estate Institute-accredited certified real estate training program and complete it to get the RERA certificate in Dubai.

Become RERA Certified:

The Dubai real estate standards, ethics, and processes are covered in the official RERA assessment, and you must take and pass this test.

Status of Fair Character Certificate:

Get a clean record verified by obtaining a Certificate of Fair Character from the Dubai Police.

DLD’s System for Application:

You may apply for an authorized practice card or a RERA certificate and pay the associated costs using the DLD’s online portal.

Obtain Permission:

Your formal real estate license, the RERA certificate, will be provided to you after the DLD reviews and approves your application.

Cost of RERA Certificate in Dubai (2026 Update)

The cost of obtaining a RERA certificate in Dubai depends on several factors, including your educational background, experience level, and whether you are applying as an individual broker or as part of a real estate company.

The certification process is regulated by the Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA), which operates under the Dubai Land Department (DLD). Training is conducted through the Dubai Real Estate Institute (DREI).

Typical Cost Breakdown

While fees may be updated periodically, the general cost structure includes:

  • Certified training course fee (DREI) – Varies depending on qualification level

  • RERA examination fee

  • Broker card (BRN) issuance fee

  • DLD registration and administrative fees

In most cases, the total cost ranges between AED 3,000 and AED 7,000 for individual brokers.

If you are establishing a real estate brokerage company, additional costs apply, including:

  • Trade license fees

  • Office space (Ejari-registered tenancy contract)

  • Company registration fees

  • Immigration and visa costs (if applicable)

Because fees may change based on regulatory updates, it is always advisable to verify the latest pricing directly through the Dubai Land Department or consult with a professional business setup advisor before applying.

Flourish in Dubai Real Estate Lucrative Market with RERA Certificate

Achieving the status of RERA-certified real estate agent in Dubai might open gateways to numerous opportunities.

Unrestricted Access to DLD: 

DLD provided services, such as property registration and title deed transfers. These are only accessible to RERA-certified agents.

Access to Accredited Listings:

Listing properties on large portals generally requires certification, giving certified brokers an incredible edge over non-certified agents.

Powerful Negotiations:

Certified agents have more negotiating power for the advantage of their customers due to their verified status and commitment to ethical standards.

Law Mandates:

To avoid having your firm shut down or penalized, the only legal option for real estate professional operations is to adhere to regional law mandates.

Investor Satisfaction:

Foreign and local investors are interested in conducting business with regulated, ethical providers.

Boost Your Career as a RERA Certified Real Estate Agent with the Connect FZ 

Get a head start in the real estate industry! From enrolling in training all the way through to submitting your final application. Connect FZ is there to help you every step throughout the process as you pursue your RERA certificate. Get your official broker Identification and breeze through the RERA test with our professional guidance. Rely on one competent partner to guarantee your legal compliance.

FAQs

Is a bachelor’s degree essential to earn a RERA certificate?

You do not need to have a bachelor’s degree, but you are required to have passed the RERA test and finished a training course that was recognized by DREI to get the certificate.

What is the maximum score needed to pass the RERA certification test?

To become a certified real estate agent and get your official broker card, you need to get a score of 75 percent or above on the RERA test.

Should a specific ID be necessary to function as a property agent in Dubai with a RERA certificate?

A Broker Registration Number (BRN) card and an official RERA license are yours to keep after you’ve been approved.

Conclusion

You must complete the required DREI training, pass the RERA test, and then submit all of your paperwork to the DLD to get your RERA certificate in Dubai. To legally and professionally practice real estate in Dubai, you must have this license and certificate. Establish a flourishing career in the Dubai real estate market and begin your journey right now! 

Are you looking forward to getting in touch with us? Contact us! By calling us, you will be in contact with an amazing team that is ready to assist you with anything you need. Do it now at +971 43 316 688. On the other hand, email us at contact@connectfz.com. We will be happy to answer your questions.

title: How to Choose the Right UAE Residence Visa for Your Needs
content:
The UAE is a preferred place to live and is considered a dream destination. Across the globe, professionals, investors, and families choose UAE for residency. This Emirate is a haven for living, and its comprehensive incentives include a progressive economy and tax-friendly environment. Not only the health facilities are excellent in his country but the education system is also top-notch. You can only enter and attain residency in this futuristic city by holding a residency visa. However, there are many types of UAE residence visas, each one specific for different goals. If you have a vision and a purpose to fulfill, opt for the kind of visa that matches suitably. This guide takes you to the simplest pathway so you can easily decide and select the type of residence visa that works for you.

Understanding the Types of Residence Visas in UAE

First things first, explore all the options available for a visa that allows living in the UAE. Each visa is ideal for specific categories of residents. Doors of living are open for every business owner, retiree, or freelancer looking for a flexible option.

1. Employment Visa – Best for Job Seekers and Employees

To attain an employment permit in the UAE, you need to successfully secure a job. Your employer will manage everything about your employment visa. Expatriates mostly move to the country by this means. However,  if you switch your company in the future, you must find new sponsorship to continue staying in the country.

2. Investor Visa – Ideal for Business Owners and Entrepreneurs

Planning to start your own business? The investor visa, also called a partner visa, allows entrepreneurs to live and work in the UAE. The best part? It’s a pathway to long-term residency and business growth.

3. Dubai Freelance Visa – Perfect for Independent Professionals

Foreign nationals who work independently as freelancers are eligible for a Dubai freelance visa. They don’t require any sponsorship. Professionals belonging to digital marketing, IT, design, and media can connect to clients globally.

4. Retirement Visa UAE – For Those Seeking a Relaxed Lifestyle

Spend your crucial time If you’re 55 or older and looking for a peaceful, sun-kissed retirement, the UAE’s retirement visa is a great option. You’ll need to meet certain financial requirements, such as having savings or a property investment.

5. Golden Visa – Long-Term Security for Investors, Professionals, and Students

This type of visa brings long-term opportunities. By obtaining the UAE’s Golden Visa, you can access residency for 5 to 10 years. This one is perfect for high-net-worth investors, distinctive students, doctors, and more highly skilled professionals. It’s ideal for those looking for long-term stability in the country.

Benefits of Different Types of UAE Residence Visa

Each type of UAE residence visa comes with its own set of advantages. Here’s what you gain from each option:

  • Employment Visa

Provides job security and access to UAE’s healthcare and banking services. The company takes care of visa processing, making it hassle-free.

  • Investor Visa

Grants business owners full control over their companies, offers long-term residency, and can lead to a Golden Visa opportunity.

  • Dubai Freelance Visa

Offers independence, allowing professionals to work with multiple clients while enjoying the benefits of UAE residency.

  • Retirement Visa UAE

Provides a peaceful lifestyle with access to premium healthcare, world-class amenities, and visa renewability every five years.

  • Golden Visa

The ultimate long-term residency option with multiple perks like no need for a sponsor, extended stay periods, and ease of travel within the UAE.

Latest Trends Regarding UAE Residence Visas

The policies for residency in the UAE are evolving with the growing unique needs. These amendments encourage global talent and investors to choose to live in the country. Have a look at the following trends that transform the UAE residence visas in 2026 for you:

  • Expansion of the Golden Visa Program: the eligibility has been extended. Now more professionals, entrepreneurs, and students can apply for 5 to 10-year residency options. This has made long-term settlement easier.
  • Rise of the Dubai Freelance Visa: freelance visa applications have been on the rise with the surging demand for remote work. This opens the door to endless flexibility for the professionals.
  • Streamlined Digital Visa Services: The visa process in the UAE can be conducted digitally. This ultimately saves time and reduces the need for paperwork.
  • Retirement Visa Growth: More retired individuals are choosing UAE as their retirement destination. People aged over 55 prefer a high-quality lifestyle and tax-friendly environment in the UAE to spend their retirement phase.
  • Investor-Friendly Policies: The UAE is actively encouraging business owners and startups by offering more flexible residency options and reducing bureaucratic hurdles.

Staying updated on these trends will help you make an informed decision when choosing the right visa for your UAE journey.

Who Can Apply for a Dubai Residence Visa?

Fulfill the following criteria to be eligible and apply for the specific residency visa. You are just one step away from successfully accessing the visa. Here’s what you need to know:

  • Employment Visa – you need a valid job offer to get this one. The UAE-based employer will sponsor your visa.
  • Investor Visa – You must invest in a business or own shares in a UAE company, meeting the minimum investment requirements.
  • Dubai Freelance Visa – Requires proof of expertise in a freelancing field, an established portfolio, and a freelance permit from a free zone authority.
  • Retirement Visa UAE – Applicants must be at least 55 years old and show proof of savings, investments, or property ownership in the UAE.
  • Golden Visa – Reserved for high-net-worth individuals, skilled professionals, and top students, requiring proof of income, investment, or exceptional talent.

Meeting the eligibility requirements is the first step toward securing your UAE residence visa and enjoying the benefits of living in one of the most dynamic cities in the world.

Required Documents for Each Type of Dubai Residence Visa

Each UAE residence visa category has specific documentation requirements. Having the right paperwork ready can help streamline the application process. Here’s a breakdown:

●      Employment Visa:

  • Passport copy (valid for at least six months)
  • Recent passport-size photograph
  • Offer letter or employment contract
  • Medical fitness test report
  • Emirates ID application form
  • Entry permit (provided by employer)
  • Visa application form

●      Investor Visa:

  • Passport copy
  • UAE trade license copy
  • Proof of investment or shareholding
  • Bank statement
  • Memorandum of Association (MOA)
  • Medical fitness test results
  • Emirates ID application

●      Dubai Freelance Visa:

  • Passport copy
  • Recent passport-size photograph
  • Freelance permit from a free zone
  • Bank statement
  • Proof of work experience or portfolio
  • Medical test results
  • Emirates ID application

●      Retirement Visa UAE:

  • Passport copy
  • Proof of age (55+ years)
  • Proof of savings or investment (minimum AED 1 million)
  • Property ownership documents (if applicable)
  • Health insurance
  • Medical fitness test results

●      Golden Visa:

  • Passport copy
  • Proof of investment, exceptional skills, or academic excellence
  • Sponsorship letter (if applicable)
  • Bank statement
  • Health insurance
  • Medical fitness test results

Ensuring all necessary documents are in place will make the application process smooth and hassle-free.

Find the Perfect UAE Residence Visa with Connect FZ

If you’re still unsure about which visa suits you best, Connect FZ has got you covered. Offering specialized visa services in UAE, you can choose the option that suits you best. Whether you are a professional, investor, or retiree, take assistance every step of the way. The smooth process will successfully lead you to a Dubai freelance visa, an investor visa, or a retirement visa in the UAE.

Your UAE Journey Starts Here!

Why get lost in paperwork when you can focus on your new life in the UAE? Let Connect FZ handle the details while you enjoy the opportunities this dynamic country has to offer. Start your UAE adventure today!

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  1. How long does it take to process a UAE residence visa? The processing time varies by visa type, but most visas take between 2 to 4 weeks.
  2. Can I switch from an employment visa to a Golden Visa? Yes, if you meet the Golden Visa eligibility criteria, you can apply for an upgrade.
  3. Is health insurance mandatory for a UAE residence visa? Yes, having health insurance is a requirement for most visa types.
  4. Can I sponsor my family with a freelance visa? Yes, freelance visa holders can sponsor their spouse and children under certain conditions.
  5. What happens if my residence visa expires? You have a grace period (usually 30 days) to renew it, after which fines may apply.

First things first, explore all the options available for a visa that allows living in the UAE. Each visa is ideal for specific categories of residents. Doors of living are open for every business owner, retiree, or freelancer looking for a flexible option.

1. Employment Visa – Best for Job Seekers and Employees

To attain an employment permit in the UAE, you need to successfully secure a job. Your employer will manage everything about your employment visa. Expatriates mostly move to the country by this means. However,  if you switch your company in the future, you must find new sponsorship to continue staying in the country.

2. Investor Visa – Ideal for Business Owners and Entrepreneurs

Planning to start your own business? The investor visa, also called a partner visa, allows entrepreneurs to live and work in the UAE. The best part? It’s a pathway to long-term residency and business growth.

3. Dubai Freelance Visa – Perfect for Independent Professionals

Foreign nationals who work independently as freelancers are eligible for a Dubai freelance visa. They don’t require any sponsorship. Professionals belonging to digital marketing, IT, design, and media can connect to clients globally.

4. Retirement Visa UAE – For Those Seeking a Relaxed Lifestyle

Spend your crucial time If you’re 55 or older and looking for a peaceful, sun-kissed retirement, the UAE’s retirement visa is a great option. You’ll need to meet certain financial requirements, such as having savings or a property investment.

5. Golden Visa – Long-Term Security for Investors, Professionals, and Students

This type of visa brings long-term opportunities. By obtaining the UAE’s Golden Visa, you can access residency for 5 to 10 years. This one is perfect for high-net-worth investors, distinctive students, doctors, and more highly skilled professionals. It’s ideal for those looking for long-term stability in the country.

Benefits of Different Types of UAE Residence Visa

Each type of UAE residence visa comes with its own set of advantages. Here’s what you gain from each option:

  • Employment Visa

Provides job security and access to UAE’s healthcare and banking services. The company takes care of visa processing, making it hassle-free.

  • Investor Visa

Grants business owners full control over their companies, offers long-term residency, and can lead to a Golden Visa opportunity.

  • Dubai Freelance Visa

Offers independence, allowing professionals to work with multiple clients while enjoying the benefits of UAE residency.

  • Retirement Visa UAE

Provides a peaceful lifestyle with access to premium healthcare, world-class amenities, and visa renewability every five years.

  • Golden Visa

The ultimate long-term residency option with multiple perks like no need for a sponsor, extended stay periods, and ease of travel within the UAE.

Latest Trends Regarding UAE Residence Visas

The policies for residency in the UAE are evolving with the growing unique needs. These amendments encourage global talent and investors to choose to live in the country. Have a look at the following trends that transform the UAE residence visas in 2026 for you:

  • Expansion of the Golden Visa Program: the eligibility has been extended. Now more professionals, entrepreneurs, and students can apply for 5 to 10-year residency options. This has made long-term settlement easier.
  • Rise of the Dubai Freelance Visa: freelance visa applications have been on the rise with the surging demand for remote work. This opens the door to endless flexibility for the professionals.
  • Streamlined Digital Visa Services: The visa process in the UAE can be conducted digitally. This ultimately saves time and reduces the need for paperwork.
  • Retirement Visa Growth: More retired individuals are choosing UAE as their retirement destination. People aged over 55 prefer a high-quality lifestyle and tax-friendly environment in the UAE to spend their retirement phase.
  • Investor-Friendly Policies: The UAE is actively encouraging business owners and startups by offering more flexible residency options and reducing bureaucratic hurdles.

Staying updated on these trends will help you make an informed decision when choosing the right visa for your UAE journey.

Who Can Apply for a Dubai Residence Visa?

Fulfill the following criteria to be eligible and apply for the specific residency visa. You are just one step away from successfully accessing the visa. Here’s what you need to know:

  • Employment Visa – you need a valid job offer to get this one. The UAE-based employer will sponsor your visa.
  • Investor Visa – You must invest in a business or own shares in a UAE company, meeting the minimum investment requirements.
  • Dubai Freelance Visa – Requires proof of expertise in a freelancing field, an established portfolio, and a freelance permit from a free zone authority.
  • Retirement Visa UAE – Applicants must be at least 55 years old and show proof of savings, investments, or property ownership in the UAE.
  • Golden Visa – Reserved for high-net-worth individuals, skilled professionals, and top students, requiring proof of income, investment, or exceptional talent.

Meeting the eligibility requirements is the first step toward securing your UAE residence visa and enjoying the benefits of living in one of the most dynamic cities in the world.

Required Documents for Each Type of Dubai Residence Visa

Each UAE residence visa category has specific documentation requirements. Having the right paperwork ready can help streamline the application process. Here’s a breakdown:

●      Employment Visa:

  • Passport copy (valid for at least six months)
  • Recent passport-size photograph
  • Offer letter or employment contract
  • Medical fitness test report
  • Emirates ID application form
  • Entry permit (provided by employer)
  • Visa application form

●      Investor Visa:

  • Passport copy
  • UAE trade license copy
  • Proof of investment or shareholding
  • Bank statement
  • Memorandum of Association (MOA)
  • Medical fitness test results
  • Emirates ID application

●      Dubai Freelance Visa:

  • Passport copy
  • Recent passport-size photograph
  • Freelance permit from a free zone
  • Bank statement
  • Proof of work experience or portfolio
  • Medical test results
  • Emirates ID application

●      Retirement Visa UAE:

  • Passport copy
  • Proof of age (55+ years)
  • Proof of savings or investment (minimum AED 1 million)
  • Property ownership documents (if applicable)
  • Health insurance
  • Medical fitness test results

●      Golden Visa:

  • Passport copy
  • Proof of investment, exceptional skills, or academic excellence
  • Sponsorship letter (if applicable)
  • Bank statement
  • Health insurance
  • Medical fitness test results

Ensuring all necessary documents are in place will make the application process smooth and hassle-free.

Find the Perfect UAE Residence Visa with Connect FZ

If you’re still unsure about which visa suits you best, Connect FZ has got you covered. Offering specialized visa services in UAE, you can choose the option that suits you best. Whether you are a professional, investor, or retiree, take assistance every step of the way. The smooth process will successfully lead you to a Dubai freelance visa, an investor visa, or a retirement visa in the UAE.

Your UAE Journey Starts Here!

Why get lost in paperwork when you can focus on your new life in the UAE? Let Connect FZ handle the details while you enjoy the opportunities this dynamic country has to offer. Start your UAE adventure today!

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  1. How long does it take to process a UAE residence visa? The processing time varies by visa type, but most visas take between 2 to 4 weeks.
  2. Can I switch from an employment visa to a Golden Visa? Yes, if you meet the Golden Visa eligibility criteria, you can apply for an upgrade.
  3. Is health insurance mandatory for a UAE residence visa? Yes, having health insurance is a requirement for most visa types.
  4. Can I sponsor my family with a freelance visa? Yes, freelance visa holders can sponsor their spouse and children under certain conditions.
  5. What happens if my residence visa expires? You have a grace period (usually 30 days) to renew it, after which fines may apply.

title: Obtaining a restaurant license in Dubai
content:
Do you know that Dubai has the most diverse culinary scene? It has a flourishing food market, and the restaurant business is the most profitable investment in this city.

The Emirate is the culinary hub and is famous for its vibrant lifestyle and dynamic culture, drawing in food lovers to taste various cuisines of Asia. It’s an ideal spot for aspiring eateries, cafes, and open restaurants.

If you are planning to start a restaurant business, you must get a restaurant license in Dubai and additional permits for compliance. You need to understand the legal framework, requirements, and key considerations to adapt to evolving food trends and ensure the successful establishment in this thriving food market.

This blog post shares detailed information on how to acquire a restaurant license to open a restaurant in Dubai, and discusses influencing aspects and concerns for this business.

Establishing a Restaurant with a Food Code: Food and Health Security Measures in Dubai

If you want to start a restaurant in Dubai, you must comply with the Food Code. The food code is a project by the Food Control Department of Dubai Municipality to ensure that food is secure from production until consumption. 

It also helps the main individual in charge of the restaurant and sets standards for food security in the restaurant business.

Wellness & Hygiene:

  • Keep the kitchen, dining spaces, and restrooms tidy and free of germs.
  • To avoid infection, learn how to handle food safely.
  • Clean and sterilize surfaces, appliances, and equipment regularly.
  • To keep food from rotting, keep it at the right temperature.

Food Security:

  • Use ingredients that are fresh and of good quality.
  • To destroy harmful germs, cook meals to the appropriate internal temperatures.
  • To store prepared food adequately to avoid cross-contamination.
  • Mark precise expiry dates on food products and meals.

Staff Hygiene:

Ensure that your staff maintain proper personal hygiene by washing their hands often and wearing clean outfits. Teach your staff how to implement food security best practices.

Controlling Pests:

Use efficient pest control techniques to prevent pests from getting into the restaurant space. Check the property often for indications of pests.

Handling Waste:

  • Dispose of food waste and other garbage in the right way.
  • Ensure that trash cans are clean.
  • According to the restaurant category and its activities, the specific needs may be different.

Dubai Municipality checks eateries on a regular basis to ensure they are following food safety standards. If they fail to comply with the regulations, they might be penalized, sanctioned, or even have their business shut down.

Exploring Restaurant License Types in Dubai

Once you’ve found the perfect spot for your restaurant in Dubai, you need to get all the permissions you require to operate it. When establishing a restaurant, you mostly need to have two different types of restaurant licenses in Dubai:

Food Hygiene License:

The Municipality’s Food Security Department issues this license only to enterprises that deal with food. It ensures that your restaurant complies with the regulations for hygiene and food security in your area.

Restaurant Trade License:

A license for a restaurant in Dubai is necessary for all restaurant businesses in Dubai. The DED permits doing business in the city. 

You may also need various licenses and authorizations based on the distinctive characteristics or services your restaurant offers:

Food Products Moving Vehicle Permission:

A restaurant that uses delivery vehicles must have a valid vehicle authorization.

License To Sell Alcohol:

You must get a liquor license if you intend to offer alcohol at your restaurant. The Dubai Police are in charge of this license and ensure that severe regulations are observed.

License to Release Food Shipment:

Restaurants that import food products from other countries need this authorization.

Getting these restaurant permits is the initial and most significant phase in opening a restaurant in Dubai. They will help you comply with the rules and succeed in the city’s thriving culinary scene.

Dubai Restaurant License Cost: Influencing Factors and Considerations

The restaurant license cost in Dubai is usually between AED ten thousand and AED twenty-five thousand. It depends on the size and location of the restaurant. You should also think about other expenses, like:

  • Approval for food security from the Dubai Municipality and expenses for registering a trade name.
  • Lease or rental contract.
  • Fees for preliminary approval and rent for the space.

Various things that can affect the cost of a restaurant license in Dubai, such as:

Food License Type:

License for a food truck, Dine-in, takeout, or alcohol.

The Dimensions of The Restaurant: 

Fees tend to increase when the establishment becomes larger.

Location of the Restaurant:

The location of your restaurant in Dubai may affect the fees you have to pay.

Additional Permissions: 

The total cost is going to rise due to the fees for permits like musical performances or alcohol licenses.

A restaurant license in Dubai costs are usually lower than those in larger cities throughout the globe.

Obtaining a Food License in Dubai: Simplified Process with Requirements

You may approach the Food Security Department to get your food license after getting initial permission from the DED. In Dubai, the Food Security Department is in charge of issuing the Food Security License. You need to obtain your trade license from the DED before you can apply for this license. 

It is a simple way to process further:

  • Get the DED’s first permission and the trading license.
  • Send your application and the necessary documentation to the Food Security Department.
  • Give the required paperwork:
  1. A trade license copy or the main permission from the DED or the freezone entity that is in charge.
  2. The plan of the inside of the building, which includes:
  3. Passages for getting in and out.
  4. Space for cooking and eating food, storage space for food, windows, and the air conditioning system.
  5. The meal preparation tools space
  6. Dishwashers and other helpful tools.

By fulfilling these criteria and getting your Food Security License, you can be guaranteed that your restaurant meets Dubai’s high food safety and hygiene regulations.

You may open your restaurant in the city-state after you acquire the food and commerce permits. But you may need to get more licenses based on your activities.

Conclusion

Starting a restaurant company in Dubai may be very profitable and successful, and the favorable environment can be beneficial for the restaurant business. However, it can also be quite expensive, and the licensing procedure involves extra formalities to ensure the restaurant follows the UAE’s Food Code.

These steps are important to ensure that the food business and associated services in the nation are of excellent standards. Reach out to the right authorities or local experts before applying for a restaurant license in Dubai or launching a food-related business to prevent legal and financial complications.

Connect FZ can help you navigate smoothly and establish a restaurant in Dubai successfully. Contact us today!

FAQs

What’s the distinction between a restaurant license and a cafeteria license in Dubai?

A cafeteria license is usually for modest, self-service eateries where clients take out their meals and pay at the counter. For more spacious, full-service establishments with table service and an extensive menu, you need a restaurant license.

How can you define the Food Code in Dubai?

The Food Security Department of the Dubai Municipality ensures that food safety standards are observed. The food code is what people generally refer to as these rules. They encompass numerous aspects of cooking, processing, storing, and serving food.

Who gives the No Objection certificate for setting up a restaurant in Dubai?

The No Objection certificate for setting up a restaurant in Dubai comes from the Dubai Municipality.

title: Advantages of Setting Up a Business in SAIF Zone in Sharjah
content:
Investors and entrepreneurs who desire to set up their companies in the UAE are free to choose between many jurisdictions. And when it comes to free zones, you can find more than 40 available locations, with SAIF Zone among the most popular. But before making a decision, it is vital to get information about it and learn about the advantages of this location.

In this article, you will learn everything you need to know about SAIF Zone in Sharjah and its benefits. On the other hand, we will mention the available licenses, company structures, and required documents for the company formation process. And with this information, it will be easier for you to make the right decisions and start your setup process. Let’s observe:

  1. What is the SAIF Zone in the Sharjah emirate?
  2. How many facilities are available in the SAIF Zone for business setup?
  3. What types of business licenses are available in the SAIF Zone?
  4. What advantages can you get by setting up your business in the SAIF Zone?
  5. How can Connect FZ help you establish your company in the SAIF Zone?

1. What is the SAIF Zone in the Sharjah emirate?

In the third most popular UAE emirate, which is Sharjah, you can find the most dynamic free zone in the country. The Sharjah Airport International Free Zone or SAIF Zone is among the favorite business locations due to many reasons. For example, it provides a wide range of benefits and allows a variety of business activities.

On the other hand, many foreign investors and entrepreneurs who have chosen this free zone confirm how beneficial it is. For instance, this jurisdiction allows them to easily connect with a potential customer base thanks to its strategic location. Below, you will discover many other advantages that this free zone provides.

1.1. Company structures allowed in SAIF Zone

When setting up companies in SAIF Zone, investors and entrepreneurs need to select a company structure that suits their businesses. And in this free zone, the authorities allow the company formation of three main types of entities or company structures. Now, let’s take a brief look at these structures:

  • Free Zone Establishment (FZE): this legal structure requires one shareholder.
  • Free Zone Company (FZC): an FZC requires more than one shareholder. And shareholders can be individuals or other corporate entities.
  • Branch of an existing company: if you own a company in or outside the UAE, you can open a branch office in SAIF Zone.

1.2. Steps to set up your company in SAIF Zone

In order to complete the company formation process, you must follow a number of easy steps. Firstly, you should know that each of the SAIF Zone companies has a particular company structure, which can be any of the ones we mentioned before. Therefore, you will first need to select the option that best suits your business.

Secondly, you must determine your business activities so you can apply for a license that covers them. After that, you will receive your license, and your residency process will begin. During this process, the authorities will process and stamp your residency permit. Once all these steps are completed, you can start your operations in the free zone.

1.3. Required documents for the company formation process

Apart from following the steps we previously mentioned, you must also provide these documents to set up in SAIF Zone:

  • The required application form. Remember that you must duly fill and enclose it.
  • A summary of your business project.
  • A few passport copies of the owners or managers of the business.
  • In case you are setting up a branch, a certificate of incorporation or registration will be necessary.
  • And if it is a foreign branch, the Memorandum and Articles of Association will be required.
  • For both local and foreign branches, investors must provide their Board Resolution and Power of Attorney appointing the individual(s) in charge.

2. How many facilities are available in the SAIF Zone for business setup?

Choosing a suitable facility to operate their businesses is one of the decisions that investors find the most complicated. And also, this is one of the most vital elements that they must carefully choose during the company formation process. Therefore, it is recommendable to seek advice from local experts before making a final decision.

On the other hand, it is also essential to be aware of the available options. In SAIF Zone, you will find modern, world-class facilities designed for different purposes. For example, you can find customizable warehouses, flexible office space alternatives, plots of land, labour accommodation, and more.

2.1. Office spaces

In this free zone, you will find three main types of office space options to choose from, which are:

  • SAIF Suite: it consists of an executive suite office with modern IT and telecommunication infrastructure. Besides, this option comes with the offer of an 8-visa quota.
  • Executive SAIF Office: this option offers unfurnished but fully customizable office space. Plus, it also covers all utility charges. In addition, this option comes with advanced IT and telecommunication infrastructure plus a 5-visa quota.
  • SAIF Office: this last option consists of a fully furnished executive desk space. And just like the previous option, it includes modern IT and telecommunication infrastructure. Furthermore, it comes with a 3-visa quota.

2.2. Labour accommodation

This is an additional benefit that all investors/entrepreneurs can get after the incorporation of their companies in the SAIF Zone. And this element includes well-maintained and fully-furnished spaces that allow them to accommodate their employees. In addition, the labour accommodation space also includes air conditioning and a choice of recreational facilities. And it may include additional amenities to cater to the different needs of their employees.

2.3. Warehouses

Using a warehouse is essential for many types of businesses, especially the ones related to the industrial sector. And in SAIF Zone, you can find state-of-the-art warehouses designed for multiple purposes, including manufacturing, trading, assembling, and logistics-related activities.

In this location, warehouses also include an ample power capacity for running heavy-duty equipment. And their facilities come with built-in offices with a pantry and lavatories, as well as industrial exhaust to control the temperature inside.

Moreover, with a SAIF warehouse, you have an additional benefit, which is the proximity to retail districts. Also, you can access major logistical hubs and manpower for loading and cargo duties.

2.4. Plot of land

You can also construct your own facilities on the available land plots. And you will also benefit from the proximity to outstanding logistical hubs, on-site labour accommodation provision, utility supplies, and 24-hour security. Therefore, land plots in the Sharjah Airport International Free Zone are also perfect for manufacturing, trading, and service industry projects.

3. What types of business licenses are available in the SAIF Zone?

During your company formation process in Sharjah SAIF Zone, you will need to select a license to perform your activities. In fact, this is probably the most important documentation that you will need in order to legally operate your business. And depending on the business activities that you want to carry out, you must choose one of the following licenses:

  • Trade license (standard or general trading license).
  • Service license.
  • Industrial license.

3.1. Trade or commercial license

This license will cover your commercial activities, which can be exporting, importing, and distributing items, among others. However, you should know that there are two types of trade licenses that you should be aware of.

The first one is a standard commercial license. In the meantime, the second one is a general trading license, which can provide additional benefits. Below, we will further explain the functions and benefits of each of these licenses.

3.1.1. Standard commercial license

While setting up their companies in SAIF Free Zone, investors and entrepreneurs can apply for a standard commercial license. With this license, they can carry out the business activities we previously mentioned, which are exporting, importing, and distributing items. In addition, this license can also cover other activities, such as consolidation, storage, and warehousing of products.

However, this license has a limit of 3 similar product lines. And your license will specify the products you will trade. Therefore, when applying for this document, you must mention the products or items you desire to trade.

3.1.2. General trading license

Apart from the standard commercial license, you can also apply for a General Trading license, which can cover additional products. In fact, with this other type of license, you can sell a larger number of allowed products.

And, of course, you can perform the commercial activities we mentioned before. Therefore, if your goal is to establish a commercial business in SAIF Zone, a General Trading license is your best option.

3.2. Service license

On the other hand, if you want to establish a business to provide services, you will need a service license. A SAIF Zone company with this license can offer all types of services that are allowed in the free zone. Nonetheless, keep in mind that this license will not cover those services restricted by Federal or local authorities.

Among the services or activities that this type of license covers, you can find the ones related to these areas:

  • Business consultancy.
  • E-commerce.
  • Shipping and freight forwarding.

3.3. Industrial license

Those who desire to set up an industrial business in SAIF Zone must apply for an industrial license. And with this permit, they can carry out activities like importing raw materials, processing, manufacturing, assembling, packaging, and more. In addition, this license allows them to export their finished products. And also, with an industrial license, investors and entrepreneurs can perform jewelry manufacturing activities.

4. What advantages can you get by setting up your business in the SAIF Zone?

Among the most outstanding advantages that investors/entrepreneurs like you can get in this free zone, you will find the following:

  • General free zone benefits, including 100% of foreign ownership, full exemption from corporate and personal income tax, and repatriation of profits and capital.
  • A variety of world-class facilities for companies, such as office space options, temporary storage, container parking, warehousing, and more.
  • No restrictions on the nationality of the employees you want to hire.
  • No restrictions on the import and export of products and goods.
  • Investors can easily open their bank accounts locally or internationally.

5. How can Connect FZ help you establish your company in the SAIF Zone?

With Connect FZ by your side, setting up your dream company in this free zone will be an easy process. Besides, we can help you find other locations in case you do not find SAIF Zone attractive or convenient enough. And this way, it will be possible for our specialists to provide the best services and ensure your company’s success.

And apart from Sharjah free zones, you can also find many favorable free zones in Dubai, such as the following:

  • Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO)
  • Dubai Multi-Commodity Center (DMCC)
  • Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA)

But before making a decision, it is vital to get information about it and learn about the advantages of this location.

In this article, you will learn everything you need to know about SAIF Zone in Sharjah and its benefits. On the other hand, we will mention the available licenses, company structures, and required documents for the company formation process. And with this information, it will be easier for you to make the right decisions and start your setup process. Let’s observe:

  2. How many facilities are available in the SAIF Zone for business setup?

  5. How can Connect FZ help you establish your company in the SAIF Zone?

1. What is the SAIF Zone in the Sharjah emirate?

In the third most popular UAE emirate, which is Sharjah, you can find the most dynamic free zone in the country. The Sharjah Airport International Free Zone or SAIF Zone is among the favorite business locations due to many reasons. For example, it provides a wide range of benefits and allows a variety of business activities.

On the other hand, many foreign investors and entrepreneurs who have chosen this free zone confirm how beneficial it is. For instance, this jurisdiction allows them to easily connect with a potential customer base thanks to its strategic location. Below, you will discover many other advantages that this free zone provides.

1.1. Company structures allowed in SAIF Zone

When setting up companies in SAIF Zone, investors and entrepreneurs need to select a company structure that suits their businesses. And in this free zone, the authorities allow the company formation of three main types of entities or company structures. Now, let’s take a brief look at these structures:

  • Free Zone Establishment (FZE): this legal structure requires one shareholder.
  • Free Zone Company (FZC): an FZC requires more than one shareholder. And shareholders can be individuals or other corporate entities.
  • Branch of an existing company: if you own a company in or outside the UAE, you can open a branch office in SAIF Zone.

1.2. Steps to set up your company in SAIF Zone

In order to complete the company formation process, you must follow a number of easy steps. Firstly, you should know that each of the SAIF Zone companies has a particular company structure, which can be any of the ones we mentioned before. Therefore, you will first need to select the option that best suits your business.

Secondly, you must determine your business activities so you can apply for a license that covers them. After that, you will receive your license, and your residency process will begin. During this process, the authorities will process and stamp your residency permit. Once all these steps are completed, you can start your operations in the free zone.

1.3. Required documents for the company formation process

Apart from following the steps we previously mentioned, you must also provide these documents to set up in SAIF Zone:

  • The required application form. Remember that you must duly fill and enclose it.
  • A summary of your business project.
  • A few passport copies of the owners or managers of the business.
  • In case you are setting up a branch, a certificate of incorporation or registration will be necessary.
  • And if it is a foreign branch, the Memorandum and Articles of Association will be required.
  • For both local and foreign branches, investors must provide their Board Resolution and Power of Attorney appointing the individual(s) in charge.

2. How many facilities are available in the SAIF Zone for business setup?

Choosing a suitable facility to operate their businesses is one of the decisions that investors find the most complicated. And also, this is one of the most vital elements that they must carefully choose during the company formation process. Therefore, it is recommendable to seek advice from local experts before making a final decision.

On the other hand, it is also essential to be aware of the available options. In SAIF Zone, you will find modern, world-class facilities designed for different purposes. For example, you can find customizable warehouses, flexible office space alternatives, plots of land, labour accommodation, and more.

2.1. Office spaces

In this free zone, you will find three main types of office space options to choose from, which are:

  • SAIF Suite: it consists of an executive suite office with modern IT and telecommunication infrastructure. Besides, this option comes with the offer of an 8-visa quota.
  • Executive SAIF Office: this option offers unfurnished but fully customizable office space. Plus, it also covers all utility charges. In addition, this option comes with advanced IT and telecommunication infrastructure plus a 5-visa quota.
  • SAIF Office: this last option consists of a fully furnished executive desk space. And just like the previous option, it includes modern IT and telecommunication infrastructure. Furthermore, it comes with a 3-visa quota.

2.2. Labour accommodation

This is an additional benefit that all investors/entrepreneurs can get after the incorporation of their companies in the SAIF Zone. And this element includes well-maintained and fully-furnished spaces that allow them to accommodate their employees. In addition, the labour accommodation space also includes air conditioning and a choice of recreational facilities. And it may include additional amenities to cater to the different needs of their employees.

2.3. Warehouses

Using a warehouse is essential for many types of businesses, especially the ones related to the industrial sector. And in SAIF Zone, you can find state-of-the-art warehouses designed for multiple purposes, including manufacturing, trading, assembling, and logistics-related activities.

In this location, warehouses also include an ample power capacity for running heavy-duty equipment. And their facilities come with built-in offices with a pantry and lavatories, as well as industrial exhaust to control the temperature inside.

Moreover, with a SAIF warehouse, you have an additional benefit, which is the proximity to retail districts. Also, you can access major logistical hubs and manpower for loading and cargo duties.

2.4. Plot of land

You can also construct your own facilities on the available land plots. And you will also benefit from the proximity to outstanding logistical hubs, on-site labour accommodation provision, utility supplies, and 24-hour security. Therefore, land plots in the Sharjah Airport International Free Zone are also perfect for manufacturing, trading, and service industry projects.

3. What types of business licenses are available in the SAIF Zone?

During your company formation process in Sharjah SAIF Zone, you will need to select a license to perform your activities. In fact, this is probably the most important documentation that you will need in order to legally operate your business. And depending on the business activities that you want to carry out, you must choose one of the following licenses:

  • Trade license (standard or general trading license).
  • Service license.
  • Industrial license.

3.1. Trade or commercial license

This license will cover your commercial activities, which can be exporting, importing, and distributing items, among others. However, you should know that there are two types of trade licenses that you should be aware of.

The first one is a standard commercial license. In the meantime, the second one is a general trading license, which can provide additional benefits. Below, we will further explain the functions and benefits of each of these licenses.

3.1.1. Standard commercial license

While setting up their companies in SAIF Free Zone, investors and entrepreneurs can apply for a standard commercial license. With this license, they can carry out the business activities we previously mentioned, which are exporting, importing, and distributing items. In addition, this license can also cover other activities, such as consolidation, storage, and warehousing of products.

However, this license has a limit of 3 similar product lines. And your license will specify the products you will trade. Therefore, when applying for this document, you must mention the products or items you desire to trade.

3.1.2. General trading license

Apart from the standard commercial license, you can also apply for a General Trading license, which can cover additional products. In fact, with this other type of license, you can sell a larger number of allowed products.

And, of course, you can perform the commercial activities we mentioned before. Therefore, if your goal is to establish a commercial business in SAIF Zone, a General Trading license is your best option.

3.2. Service license

On the other hand, if you want to establish a business to provide services, you will need a service license. A SAIF Zone company with this license can offer all types of services that are allowed in the free zone. Nonetheless, keep in mind that this license will not cover those services restricted by Federal or local authorities.

Among the services or activities that this type of license covers, you can find the ones related to these areas:

  • E-commerce.
  • Shipping and freight forwarding.

3.3. Industrial license

Those who desire to set up an industrial business in SAIF Zone must apply for an industrial license. And with this permit, they can carry out activities like importing raw materials, processing, manufacturing, assembling, packaging, and more. In addition, this license allows them to export their finished products. And also, with an industrial license, investors and entrepreneurs can perform jewelry manufacturing activities.

Among the most outstanding advantages that investors/entrepreneurs like you can get in this free zone, you will find the following:

  • General free zone benefits, including 100% of foreign ownership, full exemption from corporate and personal income tax, and repatriation of profits and capital.
  • A variety of world-class facilities for companies, such as office space options, temporary storage, container parking, warehousing, and more.
  • No restrictions on the nationality of the employees you want to hire.
  • No restrictions on the import and export of products and goods.
  • Investors can easily open their bank accounts locally or internationally.

With Connect FZ by your side, setting up your dream company in this free zone will be an easy process. content:
The UAE is a country in which many industries and business sectors are successful. Sharjah is one of the most popular business hubs in the country. Many business ideas are very profitable for all new investors, like opening a salon in Sharjah. However, having a basic knowledge of this business in Sharjah is important.

In this article, you will learn everything about this kind of business in the emirate of Sharjah. Firstly, you will find information about how profitable this business is in Sharjah. Secondly, you will learn how to open a salon in this location. And lastly, we will explain some important details about it, such as benefits, costs, etc. Let’s observe:

1. Sharjah as an efficient business location for investors.

Sharjah is an emirate known as one of the most famous business hubs in the UAE. Its reputation relies on its efficiency and favorable business environment for setting up any kind of business. Therefore, many local and foreign entrepreneurs decide to invest their money, time, and resources in this location.

Besides offering great opportunities to establish a business, this place also offers the benefits that all investors need. However, these would vary depending on the jurisdiction that they choose. For instance, the benefits for free zone companies are different from the ones for mainland companies. Let’s take a look at some of the benefits of Sharjah free zones.

1.1. Benefits investors can obtain in Sharjah Free Zones.

All types of businesses can receive several benefits to boost their efficiency, including a business like a salon in Sharjah. Among the most common benefits for all free zone businesses are the following ones:

  • 100 percent of ownership of the company.
  • 100 percent of repatriation of capital and profits.
  • Full exemption from personal and corporate tax.
  • Full exemption from export and import customs duty.
  • There is access to world-class infrastructure and the necessary facilities to develop business activities.
  • Investors are free to trade with other local or international companies without restrictions. In other words, there are no trade barriers.
  • They also have the opportunity to apply for visas for their relatives and staff.
  • There is easy access to a pool of talent and high-qualified employees. Besides, the recruitment process is easygoing and efficient.
  • Investors have also access to important ports, including the Sharjah International Airport and many others.
  • All entrepreneurs and investors can receive support services to make improvements for their businesses.

Besides, there might be additional benefits depending on the free zone you choose to set up your business. Now let’s see what benefits Sharjah Mainland offers to investors like you.

1.2. Benefits investors can obtain in Sharjah Mainland.

Although free zones are favorable, the mainland also offers many advantages for investors, especially for a salon in Sharjah. Some of these benefits are the following ones:

  • Freedom to target retail market directly across the UAE.
  • Business-friendly environment and regulations.
  • Investors can expand their offices and the number of visas for employees.
  • Access to world-class infrastructure and facilities.
  • Having minimum capital is not a requirement for setting up a business.

2. The Importance of the Beauty Sector in the Country.

Having healthy and beautiful hair is an important feature for people in modern society. Therefore, opening a salon in Sharjah can be a very profitable business for an investor. And even more profitable if it is located in a place with a large population. The main reason for this is that this service is high in demand in crowded locations like Sharjah.

Since people constantly need beauty treatment and similar services, this business can guarantee success in the short term. Therefore, opening your own salon in this emirate will help you create a stable and profitable business. However, you must learn all relevant details before start operating in Sharjah.

3. Why Should you Set up a Salon in the Emirate of Sharjah?

The main reason why this kind of business is a good idea is because of the exponential growth and success. These services are in demand currently, which is why having a beauty salon is a worthy investment. Besides, you can expand your business in the short term and do other activities. For example, you can offer extra services such as make-up courses and training, which are also lucrative.

Besides being an easygoing business, the registration and incorporation process is simple and does not require much. And with different corporate advantages from the government, your business will be even more productive. Moreover, you can make it even easier with a business setup partner by your side.

4. What are the requirements for setting up a salon in Sharjah?

Make sure to meet the following requirements before opening your beauty salon:

  • The location of the salon requires approval from the planning department of Sharjah Municipality.
  • The investor must display a Sign Board in front of the salon.
  • There must be proper usage of the lighting. Similarly, the furniture must be clean and fitting.
  • Make sure that the height between the ceiling and the floor is higher than 2.3 meters.
  • Dressing seats must be of a specific size, which is 3.0m wide X 3.5m in length. They must not be less than that.
  • Beauty treatments need a separate area for hair removal, pedicure, manicure, and henna design. This space must be greater than 2.5m X 1.5m.
  • Facial treatment services require a washbasin near its location.
  • A water heater is also necessary for your beauty salon.
  • Fireproof materials are necessary for preparing hair removal materials.
  • You will also need cabinets, drawers, and storage to store towels and cosmetics.

5. How can investors set up this type of business in Sharjah?

Some simple steps must be followed when setting up a salon in Sharjah. Let’s take a look at them to start building your business:

  • Firstly, you must submit some passport and visa copies of the shareholders investing in the salon.
  • Secondly, you need to select a proper name for your beauty salon. After this, you will receive the initial approval from the pertinent authorities.
  • Thirdly, it is important to draft and sign the Memorandum of Association or a Local Service Agent.
  • After completing those steps, you’ll need to rent a salon shop according to the mandatory design. Hence you must agree with the tenant to obtain a tenancy contract along with the Ejari number.
  • You also need to obtain certain approvals. For instance, you’ll need approval from the Planning Section and the Health and Safety Division of the Sharjah Municipality.
  • And lastly, you must submit all necessary documents to obtain the final approval and your license.

To Start a Salon, What License Do You Need?

Evidently, opening a beauty salon requires a specific license, which is the salon business permit or salon license. However, you can find two types of salon licenses available in Sharjah. Therefore, it is important to determine the type of beauty salon you want before applying for a license.

If you want to open a beauty salon in Sharjah for women, you have to apply for a women’s salon license. Or in case you want to set up a salon for men, you’ll need the men’s salon license. In any case, it is essential to be aware of the activities and services that each of them covers.

6.1. Women’s Salon License.

A women’s beauty salon meets some basic concepts, which are transformation and hair care. These elements are the ones that approve this type of salon and make it need a women’s salon license. However, it is also important to know the activities and services that this license covers. Therefore, let’s take a look at them.

Firstly, hair care includes washing, straightening, waving, hair-fixing, trimming, coloring, and henna services. Secondly, cosmetic treatments or procedures can include other activities and services for female customers. For example, they include skin cleaning, facial aesthetic, makeup, skin hair removal, foot care, nail manicures, among other services.

6.2. Men’s Salon License.

On the other hand, having a men’s salon requires a different license, which is the men’s salon license. This license allows the investor to carry out similar activities and services. The only difference is the customers who receive these services, which in this case would be male customers.

Now, let’s see what kind of services this license covers. First of all, this license covers remodeling treatments, hairdressing, and hair care. However, each of these elements includes several services. Cosmetic treatments include hair removal, skin purification, facial aesthetic, and foot care. Meanwhile, hair care and dressing include cutting, trimming, dyeing, straightening, waving, and other similar services.

7. How Much Can Cost to Setup a Beauty Salon in this Emirate?

The cost for setting up this type of business can vary depending on certain factors. For example, the salon license cost in Sharjah is approximately AED 7,900. However, other elements must be taken into consideration when setting up a salon. For instance, some approvals, documents, and other fees are important during this process.

These are some key elements you must consider for setting up a salon:

  • The initial approval.
  • The name approval.
  • The typing and notarization of the Memorandum of Association.
  • The sponsorship fees.

If you sum up these elements plus the license, the total cost would be approximately AED 21,380. Besides, you should also remember to include other essential costs to open your salon. For example, salon furniture, tools, visas, and many other details will be important costs during the setup process.

8. How can Connectfz Help You Setup Business in Sharjah?

Besides having the opportunity to open a salon, you can also try other business ideas. Whatever you choose, you can count on Connectfz to get your business started and guarantee your success. With our help, you can obtain the guidance you need to select the most convenient options for you. Besides, the registration process gets easier and faster.

Moreover, there’s a variety of packages for you to choose from in Sharjah and many other locations. All of them are affordable and include the elements you need, like licenses, visas, facilities, etc. However, prices could vary depending on these details and the location you select.

On the other hand, we also offer some high-qualified support services to boost your business. For example, we offer banking services, payroll services, HR consultancy, and many more to improve your company. Feel free to contact us and get the information you need to start achieving your goals.

Would you like to contact Connectfz to obtain more information about the business setup process in the emirate of Sharjah? If you have any questions, call us on +97143316688. You can email us at info@connectfz.ae, and you will talk to one of our representatives who will answer your questions.

content:
Many investors and professionals spend a lot of time and money trying to make their businesses grow, but if you are an investor too and you don’t want to spend too much time or money on it, you can efficiently set up a company in the UAE, specifically on the free zones.

Here we will show you how to set up a company in the UAE and what kind of benefits you will get once you start making your dreamed business come true. However, it is about not only getting benefits, but also knowledge and the required services to help you settle in. Let’s observe:

  • Why set up your company in the UAE?
  • What do you need to start setting up your company in the UAE?
  • How to get a License Notification?
  • What is Visa Processing and Stamping about?
  • What documents will you need to set up your company in the UAE?

1. Why set up your company in the UAE?

Setting up your company in the UAE is the decision you can make and we will tell you the reasons. The UAE is known for being an economically developed zone that offers many benefits and advantages to its clients, new investors, and entrepreneurs, such as flexible government norms, a world-class infrastructure, favorable business environment, efficient quality services, and more.

1.1. Reasons to start your business in the UAE

  • As a growing, diversified market, the UAE has a high global demand for imports and exports, and wide opportunities for suppliers.
  • In the UAE, there are countless favorable conditions for doing business, and it ranked the country as one of the most beneficial business environments in the GCC region.
  • The UAE has global connectivity and easy access to more than 90 airlines and 170 shipping lines.
  • The UAE possesses a strategic geographic location in a resource-rich region.
  • Commerce and businesses in this country are based on free trade barriers, which means no quotas or exchange control.
  • As for taxes, there are no personal, capital, or corporate income taxes, and you can get 100% repatriation of capital and profits. There are no currency restrictions either.
  • In this country, you will find world-class infrastructure and amenities in terms of business parks, warehousing, office spaces, connectivity, transportation, utilities, and more.
  • There is health insurance for all UAE residents, and there are well-known universities around the country.

2. What do you need to start setting up your company in the UAE?

We’ll show you here a step-by-step guide to successfully set up your company in the UAE:

2.1. Choose your business activity.

You have to decide what will your company be about in order to set it up in a free zone in the UAE. Keep in mind that each free zone has a determined kind of business, as you can see in Dubai Healthcare City, which has companies related to the medical category. If your company will be about import and export, choosing a free zone near airports and ports will be very convenient.

2.2. Choose your company’s name.

Before giving a name to your company, you have to make sure it will not contain offensive content. There are strict naming conventions in the UAE you must follow. If the company will be named after a person, it has to be after an important member of the company (don’t use initials nor abbreviations, only full name).

2.3. Prepare your incorporation paperwork and get a License Notification.

You will have to complete an application for your selected company name and activity, which you will obtain along with copies of shareholders’ passports to the pertinent government authorities. With a business set-up advisor, you will complete this step rapidly and easily. Right after processing the incorporation paperwork, the government will provide you with your license notification.

2.4. Open a bank account.

With all the documentation you have gathered so far, you will now be able to open a corporate bank account. You can choose a local or an international bank, or you can also ask your business set-up partner to help you arrange meetings and to evaluate the most appropriate option.

2.5. Process your visa.

You can apply for your own visa or for staff and dependants if you so desire, but we recommend you seek expert advice first. The visa processing lies in five main steps: entry permit, status adjustment, medical fitness test, Emirates ID registration, and finally, visa stamping.

3. Types of companies

Once all the paperwork is done, the next step will be to get a license notification, which depends on the type of company you are setting up. Remember to choose the one that suits you better according to your business activity and zone your company will be set up in. Here is a list of different companies available for you to incorporate:

3.1. Types of companies available

  • Limited Liability Company (LLC): it is like this when the owner of the company is not personally liable for the company’s debts or liabilities.
  • Professional License Company (no limited liability): only able to conduct business in the specific area of expertise of the license owner.
  • Free Zone Company: may trade only within the specified free zone and elsewhere in the world.
  • Offshore Company: only able to trade outside of the UAE.

4. What free zones are available to set up your company in?

There are 45 free zones currently available, but the most recommended ones are in the city if Dubai. Some of these free zones are:

  • Dubai Media City (DMC).
  • Dubai Healthcare City (DHCC).
  • Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC).
  • Dubai International Financial Center (DIFC).
  • Dubai Airport Free Zone (DAFZA).
  • Dubai Silicon Oasis Authority (DSOA).

However, Dubai is not the only perfect place to set up your company in the UAE, because you can also discover other efficient cities such as Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Jebel Ali, Fujairah, and more. Therefore, other good options could be the Ras Al Khaimah Economic Zone (RAKEZ), Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), and RAK International Corporate Centre (RAK ICC).

With millions of apps available now in the different stores to help you track a trip, monitor your diet, sleep routine, diet, hail a cab, listen to music or read a book; the mobile industry has thrived massively around the world in the last decade. Similarly, the setup of a mobile app company in the UAE is the first step to start.

In this article, we will ensure you understand the entire mobile app business setup in the UAE and how can you carry it smoothly with us. Due to incorporation ease, most mobile app development organizations choose to set up in a free zone. As a result, they gain access to Flexi-desk services and several benefits.

  1. Where is the best location to set up your mobile app business?
  2. How can you set up a mobile app company in the UAE with more than one shareholder?
  3. What is the process for starting a mobile app business in the UAE?
  4. How can you benefit from starting a mobile app company?
